* test(cli): isolate the suite from the operator's settings home (#12513)

The autofix verification gate runs the packages/cli suite with the host's
real HOME on a machine shared with other jobs. A malformed
$HOME/.qwen/settings.json there (observed content: "X") makes every
operator-settings reader fail closed at once — readOperatorSettingsScopes
is designed to refuse a corrupted policy file — and one such file failed
408 tests across 15 files in the measured gate rejection.

Pin a private empty QWEN_HOME per test-file process in the suite setup
when the environment did not select one, following the file's existing
doctrine for operator-owned environment. Tests that exercise QWEN_HOME
set, stub, or delete it themselves. settings.test.ts keys every
user-settings and .env path off a mocked os.homedir, so it now deletes
an ambient QWEN_HOME explicitly; with any ambient value set, 13 of its
tests fail regardless of this change.

* test(cli): harden the QWEN_HOME suite pin and batch maxima test (#12513)

- Pin on truthiness so an ambient empty QWEN_HOME no longer falls
  through to $HOME/.qwen, matching every production reader.
- Sweep the pinned home from afterAll instead of an 'exit' listener
  that vitest workers never fire (51 leaked dirs on src/config -> 0).
- Restore QWEN_DEBUG_LOG_FILE around loadCliConfig tests so the debug
  logger's fire-and-forget writes stop racing the sweep.
- Witness that the suite never resolves settings from the ambient
  $HOME/.qwen, and assert member shape in the 20-selector maxima half
  so twenty failed members cannot read as twenty snapshots.

* test(cli): keep AppContainer store work off the pinned per-file QWEN_HOME (#12513)

* test(managed-agent): settle fresh group leaders before age-judged sweeps (#12513)

A just-forked process can read in ps with procps's negative-elapsed
wraparound (e.g. 441077234-00:18:40), which parsePsElapsed deliberately
leaves undatable. An undatable leader judges every worker/group identity
'unknown', so an unwitnessed sweep conservatively holds the live process
and rejects unproven — flaking the real-process sweep tests within
milliseconds of the spawn. settledGroupTable now also waits for the
leader's row to be datable, and the four sweep sites that judged a fresh
process without the guard use it.

* fix(cli): keep the QWEN_HOME test pin unconditional and alive for the process lifetime (#12513)

The conditional pin honored an ambient QWEN_HOME, so agent-gate vitest
runs read and wrote the operator's live settings home; the teardown
sweep then deleted the live pin while un-awaited extension-store work
was still reading it, turning Test (ubuntu-latest) red on ENOENT. Pin
unconditionally, keep the pin for the process lifetime, reap stale pins
by age at setup, await the floated extensions-list handler, and add
teardown, pin, reaper, and memory-only-contract witnesses.

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* fix(cli): keep the QWEN_HOME teardown witness inside test-setup.ts (#12513)

The previous commit registered the pin teardown witness as a second
setupFiles entry in packages/cli/vitest.config.ts, which deterministic
verification rejects as CI/verification machinery outside the PR
footprint. Revert vitest.config.ts and fold the witness into
test-setup.ts itself: vitest runs root-level afterAll hooks in reverse
registration order, so the hook registered immediately after the pin
runs last among this file's root hooks and still turns every file red
if a teardown sweep of the live pin is reintroduced below it
(mutation-probed). The separate witness setup file is deleted.

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* test(integration): raise the installed distribution case ceiling

The tui-parity installed-distribution darwin-x64 leg failed on the
npx-lifecycle-enabled no-relaunch-fallback case with "Test timed out in
120000ms" (run 40537979533, job 122316223603). The five preceding cases
averaged ~117s on that host, right at the ceiling: startup alone can
spend the whole 90s ready-prompt budget there (#15677) and the /about

Raise the per-case ceiling to 240s and keep the budget helper's note in

prs.title: ci: route Lint & Static to ECS for every pull request
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Routes the Lint & Static lane to the self-hosted ECS pool for every pull request, including forks from contributors without write access. The classifier now publishes a dedicated routing decision for this lane alongside the existing association-gated one; the unit-test and integration lanes keep their current trust boundary unchanged. The lane's timeout reads the same decision, so pool runs keep the 90-minute contention ceiling and hosted runs keep 45. The maintainer kill switch and the hosted-fleet override still force this lane back to hosted runners, and the ARM64 fleet selector is honored. The routing regression battery grows a matrix that pins the divergence in both directions: every association reaches the pool for this lane, the overrides still revert it, and the shared output keeps its association gate for every other lane.

## Why it's needed

The lane already runs on ECS for in-repo branches, write-access fork authors, pushes to main, and the merge queue; only untrusted fork PRs still queue on the hosted pool. In a recent 60-PR sample that was 12 PRs (~20%) paying hosted queue time for a lane whose self-hosted path is fully provisioned and exercised daily. Moving the remainder removes that queue without touching any other lane's routing.

The security tradeoff was reviewed and explicitly accepted by the maintainer: this lane executes PR-provided code — dependency installation, linter configuration, the bundle-closure build, and the helper battery all run against the PR head — so untrusted forks now run that code on the shared persistent pool. The fleet carries no data-at-rest secrets (bot credentials are injected per job) and the fork job itself only receives a read-only token; the residual exposure from co-resident jobs and workspace persistence is accepted for this lane only.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Open (or re-run CI on) a fork PR from an account without write access: Lint & Static should land on a self-hosted ECS runner while Test and the integration lanes stay on ubuntu-latest.
- Set `MAINTAINER_ECS_RUNNER_DISABLED=true` (or `LINUX_RUNNER_FLEET=hosted`) and re-run: every Linux lane, including Lint & Static, returns to hosted.
- Run the routing regression battery: `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs` (98 tests) and the workflow meta suites `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js scripts/tests/review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js` — both green on this branch.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI routing only. Before: untrusted fork PRs' Lint & Static queued on ubuntu-latest (12 of the last 60 PRs sampled). After: the same PRs route to the shared ECS pool; this PR's own CI run exercises the new path end to end.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: full meta-test battery locally (562 tests across the eight workflow suites, plus the 98-test routing battery). Windows: N/A, workflow-only change. Linux: not tested locally; covered by this PR's CI, which runs the lane on the pool itself.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — workflow meta-tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: untrusted fork code now executes on the shared persistent pool for this lane (maintainer-accepted 2026-10-31). Co-resident review/triage jobs receive per-job credentials, so same-UID process introspection and workspace persistence remain theoretically reachable; the kill switch reverts the lane to hosted in one variable flip.
- Not validated / out of scope: no isolation layer (dedicated fork label or ephemeral hosts) is introduced; other lanes' trust boundary, the Windows/macOS lanes, and merge-queue routing are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the classifier's existing output is untouched, so downstream consumers and the mirrored workflows are unaffected.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 Lint & Static 车道对所有 pull request（含无 write 权限贡献者的 fork）路由到自托管 ECS 池。分类器在原有按 association 门禁的输出之外，新增一个专供该车道使用的路由决策；单测和集成测试车道的信任边界保持不变。车道的 timeout 读取同一个决策：池上跑保留 90 分钟争抢上限，hosted 保留 45。维护者 kill switch 和 hosted-fleet 覆盖仍能把该车道一键退回 hosted，ARM64 fleet 选择器同样生效。路由回归测试新增一组矩阵，双向钉住这个分歧：该车道下所有 association 都上池、覆盖开关仍能退回、共享输出对其他车道保留 association 门禁。

## 为什么需要

该车道对仓内分支、有 write 权限的 fork 作者、push main、merge queue 早已跑在 ECS 上；只有不可信 fork PR 还在 hosted 池排队。最近 60 个 PR 样本里有 12 个（约 20%）在为一条 self-hosted 路径早已完备且每天被验证的车道付 hosted 排队时间。把剩余部分移过去即可消除这段排队，且不影响任何其他车道的路由。

安全取舍已经维护者评审并明确接受：该车道会执行 PR 提供的代码——依赖安装、linter 配置、bundle-closure 构建、helper 测试全部跑在 PR head 上——因此不可信 fork 的代码现在会跑在共享持久池上。fleet 机器不落盘任何密钥（bot 凭证按 job 注入），fork job 自身只拿只读 token；同机并发 job 与工作区持久化带来的残余暴露面仅就该车道被接受。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

- 用一个无 write 权限账号开 fork PR（或重跑其 CI）：Lint & Static 应落在 self-hosted ECS runner，而 Test 和集成测试车道仍在 ubuntu-latest。
- 设置 `MAINTAINER_ECS_RUNNER_DISABLED=true`（或 `LINUX_RUNNER_FLEET=hosted`）后重跑：包括 Lint & Static 在内的所有 Linux 车道回到 hosted。
- 跑路由回归：`node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`（98 个测试）及工作流元测试 `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/ci-platform-lanes.test.js scripts/tests/review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js`——本分支均绿。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——纯 CI 路由变更。前：不可信 fork PR 的 Lint & Static 在 ubuntu-latest 排队（最近 60 个 PR 样本中 12 个）。后：同样的 PR 路由到共享 ECS 池；本 PR 自身的 CI 运行即端到端验证新路径。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅（本地完整元测试：8 个工作流套件 562 个测试 + 98 个路由回归）；Windows N/A（纯 workflow 变更）；Linux ⚠️ 未本地测试，由本 PR 的 CI 在池上覆盖。

### 环境

N/A——仅工作流元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：不可信 fork 代码现在就该车道在共享持久池上执行（维护者 2026-10-31 接受）。同机的 review/triage job 按 job 注入凭证，同 UID 进程内省与工作区持久化在理论上仍可达；kill switch 一个变量即可把车道退回 hosted。
- 未验证/范围外：不引入隔离层（专用 fork label 或一次性主机）；其他车道的信任边界、Windows/macOS 车道、merge-queue 路由均不变。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；分类器原有输出未动，下游消费者与镜像 workflow 不受影响。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

This closes post-split verification gaps in cancellation, ordinary Maven embedding and Hosted fault testing. The cancellation probe observes an active response before cancelling; the full MySQL lane exercises dependency-only and explicitly enabled hosts. Fault injection now accesses the known SDK wrapper's delegate, the event replay finds its TypeScript authority from the verification module, and stream-idle failures retain a neutral subtype and their idle duration. The recovery driver waits for the documented projection-pending response only inside its existing bounded Items poll. The workflow commands stay within the unchanged size gate. Unexpected Broker500 failures now retain their original cause in internal logs while preserving the existing sanitized response. The branch also incorporates current main after its CI-gate revert made the previous branch stale; upstream production changes are preserved as inherited scope.

## Why it's needed

The original macOS cancellation probe could cancel before observing a response, and the independent host fixture had no CI caller. The completed full run at `2d878d48e2` exposed four Hosted failures and 20 errors among 165 cases: obsolete reflection/bean assumptions, an old directory-depth calculation, lost idle-failure metadata and a driver rejecting an expected temporary projection state. These require code corrections; rerunning the same source would retain them. The subsequent2f6 full run reached165/1failure/0errors/4skips, exposing an acquire500 whose original cause was not retained; the diagnostic addition addresses that missing evidence, not the underlying500.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Unexpected Broker500 should retain an underlying server-side exception while its HTTP response stays sanitized. FG11g must still prove the intended probe exit/stderr, and complete Hosted/admission gates must execute.

### How to verify

Confirm cancellation succeeds after the first flushed byte while preserving the 300 ms deadline, 10 s caller timeout and 2 s peer-close bound. An ordinary dependency must leave Managed resources inactive; explicit embedding must compose successfully without contaminating the host's default beans. Both stream entry points must preserve the idle subtype, duration, message and cause; the real liveness gates must continue detecting only idle failures. Hosted fault injection must reach its original assertions through wrapped single/pool connectors, replay must use the real TypeScript reader, and recovery must retain its single-execution and stale-cancel checks while waiting only for `503 message_projection_pending` within the original 30 s poll. Run the complete existing CI gates and reject empty or incomplete test selections.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no UI change. The [completed pre-fix full run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41092536370) and its failure reports are retained. The [bilingual acceptance report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15927#issuecomment-6527647102) distinguishes those results from the pending new revision.

Two wipe cases are traced to the Mac temporary-directory symlink and global Git hooks; handoff status1 and the original120-second A/B timeout remain unresolved local limitations. The separate Linux helper attempt finished265 passed/42 failed on Darwin, with hermetic PATH, GNU stat and Linux proc assumptions retained as platform evidence. The initial incorrect mixed-runner attempt is also preserved. No gate, assertion or deadline was relaxed. Two consecutive clean audits and independent review confirmed the merged source, and the ordinary pre-commit hook left the reviewed tree unchanged. No local Java/Maven/JDK/Java formatting/install/build/runtime ran; the shared budget remains598.382695465/600s and57 records with unchanged hash. These checks do not replace actual Java/Hosted execution.

prs.title: fix(desktop): stop the bundled runtime before installing an update
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On Windows, the in-app update now shuts the bundled runtime down before the installer starts, instead of leaving the daemon holding the Node binary mapped. The confirmation dialog states that open sessions will close, and the runtime's Windows job object is marked kill-on-close so a daemon can no longer outlive the desktop process.

## Why it's needed

Windows refuses to overwrite an executable that a running process has mapped, and the desktop app starts its bundled daemon at launch and keeps it alive. Accepting the startup update prompt therefore ended in the NSIS dialog `Error opening file for writing: ...\runtime\qwen-code\node\node.exe`, and no button could recover: `Retry` races the same live image, restarting the app recreates the lock at startup, and `Ignore` leaves a half-replaced runtime that is never verified. The process evidence and the full code path are in #15276.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On Windows with the desktop app installed, launch it and accept the update prompt (or trigger the check from the UI). Expected: the app closes, the installer finishes without any "Error opening file for writing" dialog, and the app relaunches on the new version. To confirm the runtime is gone before the installer runs, execute `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'"` while the installer window is up: nothing from `...\Qwen Code Desktop\runtime\qwen-code\node\` should remain.

The hook only executes from the Windows install routine; on macOS and Linux the builder records it but the install path never calls it, so those platforms are unaffected by construction.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installer stopped at the copy stage with the NSIS dialog `Error opening file for writing: C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Qwen Code Desktop\runtime\qwen-code\node\node.exe` (Retry / Abort / Ignore). Opening the same file for writing from PowerShell reproduced the collision: `The process cannot access the file ... because it is being used by another process.`

After: not demonstrated from a packaged build in this PR — verification here is compilation, the crate's 42 unit tests, and a static review of the updater plugin's install path (the hook is invoked after extraction and immediately before the installer is launched).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ `cargo check`, `cargo test` |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows 11 10.0.26300, rustc 1.99.1 with MSVC 14.44 and Windows SDK 10.0.26100; `cargo check` and `cargo test` run inside the desktop crate. No packaged installer was produced locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: accepting an update stops the runtime before the installer runs, so open sessions end at that moment instead of after the restart. The download completes first, so a failed download leaves sessions untouched, and the dialog now says sessions will close.
- Not validated / out of scope: a daemon orphaned by an app instance killed before this fix shipped cannot be reached from the current process and can still hold the binary; reaping such leftovers at startup is a separate follow-up. The orphan class itself is prevented going forward by the kill-on-close flag.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: users on a build released before this change must quit the app once before updating, because that update is started by the old binary, which cannot stop the runtime; the same transition is tracked in #15933, and the installer-side reap it proposes would remove the caveat. The flag itself only changes what happens when the desktop dies without a graceful exit, which already stopped the daemon explicitly.

## Linked Issues

Part of #15276. The update that installs this fix is still driven by the old binary, which has no hook — that one transition is tracked in #15933.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Windows 上，应用内更新现在会先关闭内置运行时，再把控制权交给安装程序，而不是让守护进程继续映射 Node 可执行文件。确认对话框会说明打开的会话将被关闭，运行时的 Windows job object 也被标记为 kill-on-close，守护进程不能再比桌面进程活得更久。

## 为什么需要

Windows 不允许覆盖正被运行进程映射的可执行文件，而桌面应用在启动时就会拉起内置守护进程并保持其运行。因此接受启动时的更新提示必然以 NSIS 对话框 `Error opening file for writing: ...\runtime\qwen-code\node\node.exe` 收场，且三个按钮都救不回来：`Retry` 仍会撞上同一个正在运行的映像，重启应用会在启动时重新建立锁，`Ignore` 则留下一个从未校验过的半替换运行时。进程证据与完整代码路径见 #15276。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在有桌面应用的 Windows 上启动应用并接受更新提示（或在界面里触发检查）。预期：应用关闭，安装程序顺利跑完、不再出现「Error opening file for writing」对话框，应用以新版本重启。要在安装程序运行前确认运行时已经退出，可在安装窗口出现时执行 `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'"`：不应再看到 `...\Qwen Code Desktop\runtime\qwen-code\node\` 下的任何进程。

该钩子只会由 Windows 的安装流程调用；在 macOS 与 Linux 上 builder 只记录它，安装路径不会调用，因此这些平台在构造上不受影响。

### 证据（前后对比）

改动前：安装程序停在拷贝阶段并弹出 NSIS 对话框 `Error opening file for writing: C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Qwen Code Desktop\runtime\qwen-code\node\node.exe`（重试 / 中止 / 忽略）。用 PowerShell 打开同一文件写入即可复现冲突：`The process cannot access the file ... because it is being used by another process.`

改动后：本 PR 没有从打包产物做端到端演示——此处的验证是编译、该 crate 的 42 个单元测试，以及对 updater 插件安装路径的静态复核（钩子在解压完成后、启动安装程序前被调用）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ `cargo check`、`cargo test` |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Windows 11 10.0.26300，rustc 1.99.1（MSVC 14.44、Windows SDK 10.0.26100）；在 desktop crate 内执行 `cargo check` 与 `cargo test`，本地未构建安装包。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：接受更新时会在安装程序运行前关闭运行时，因此打开的会话会在那一刻结束，而不是等到重启之后。下载先完成，所以下载失败不会影响会话，对话框也已说明会话将被关闭。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：由修复发布前就被杀掉的旧实例遗留的孤儿守护进程，无法从当前进程触达，仍可能占住二进制；在启动时清理这类残留是单独的后续工作。孤儿这类问题本身从此由 kill-on-close 标记挡住。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：仍在使用本改动之前版本的安装，需在更新前先完整退出应用一次 —— 那一次更新由旧二进制发起，无法停止运行时；该过渡场景见 #15933，其中建议的安装器侧清理可以消除这一限制。该标记本身只改变桌面进程非正常死亡时的行为，而正常退出与重启本来就会显式停止守护进程。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #15276。安装本修复的那一次更新仍由没有钩子的旧二进制驱动 —— 该过渡场景见 #15933。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): route helper-test tmpdir off the host /tmp tmpfs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Routes the full-profile helper-test battery's temporary directory to the runner's data-disk temp dir by exporting `TMPDIR="${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}"` before the battery runs — the same routing the unit-test lanes already use (#10035). A meta-test pins the export so it cannot silently regress.

## Why it's needed

The Lint & Static lane failed on #15965 ([run 41160950657, attempt 1](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41160950657/job/124418225161)) with `tar: ... Cannot open: No space left on device`, unrelated to the PR's changes. The failure dump on runner `ecs-qwen-hz1-9` showed the real cause: the host `/tmp` is a tmpfs with a ~1M inode quota, and it was 100% full on inodes (1,045,825 / 1,048,576) while 202G of capacity and the 1T data disk sat nearly empty. The helper battery was the one substantive step without the TMPDIR routing: `e2e-build.test.mjs` mkdtemps thousands of chunk files via `os.tmpdir()`, which defaults to `/tmp`, and exhausted the remaining 2,751 inodes. With the export, those files land on `RUNNER_TEMP` (data disk, 67M inodes at 7% use) instead.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts ci-platform-lanes` — all 66 tests pass, including the new `routes the battery tmpdir off the host /tmp tmpfs` contract and the existing retry/load-bearing assertions (the export sits before the battery and does not touch the retry shape).
2. `TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d) node --test .github/scripts/e2e-build.test.mjs` — 20/20 pass, and the custom tmpdir is empty afterwards, confirming the test's scratch files follow `TMPDIR` and are cleaned up.
3. On the next full-profile CI run, the helper step's temp usage stays on the runner data disk even if the host `/tmp` inode quota is tight.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI-only change. Before: [failed job log](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41160950657/job/124418225161) with `df -i` showing `tmpfs 1048576 1045825 2751 100% /tmp`. After: local runs above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux is where the lane runs; local verification was macOS, and this PR's own CI run exercises the Linux path.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: minimal — one environment export identical to the unit lanes' existing routing; hosted runners without `RUNNER_TEMP` fall back to the current behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: host-level `/tmp` hygiene on the ECS pool (accumulated temp files from other processes can still fill the tmpfs and hit anything else that hardcodes `/tmp`); that is an ops follow-up, not blocked by this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Failure observed on #15965; same routing doctrine as #10035.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

给 full-profile 的 helper 测试电池补上临时目录路由：在跑测试前导出 `TMPDIR="${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}"`，让临时文件落到 runner 数据盘——和单测车道已有的 #10035 路由完全一致。同时新增一条 meta-test 钉住这个导出，防止将来被无声删掉。

## 为什么需要

#15965 的 Lint & Static 车道失败（[run 41160950657 attempt 1](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41160950657/job/124418225161)），报 `tar: ... Cannot open: No space left on device`，与 PR 改动无关。runner `ecs-qwen-hz1-9` 的失败现场 dump 显示真因：主机 `/tmp` 是 tmpfs，inode 配额约 100 万，当时已 100% 用满（1,045,825 / 1,048,576），而容量还剩 202G、1T 数据盘几乎全空。helper 电池恰好是唯一没做 TMPDIR 路由的实质步骤：`e2e-build.test.mjs` 通过 `os.tmpdir()`（默认 `/tmp`）批量创建几千个 chunk 文件，把仅剩的 2,751 个 inode 吃穿。加上导出后，这些文件落到 `RUNNER_TEMP`（数据盘，6700 万 inode 才用 7%）。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts ci-platform-lanes` —— 66 个测试全过，包括新增的 tmpdir 路由契约和既有的 retry/load-bearing 断言（导出位于电池之前，不改变 retry 结构）。
2. `TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d) node --test .github/scripts/e2e-build.test.mjs` —— 20/20 通过，且跑完自定义临时目录为空，证明测试的临时文件确实跟着 TMPDIR 走并被清理。
3. 下一次 full-profile CI 运行时，即使主机 `/tmp` inode 紧张，helper 步骤的临时文件也留在数据盘上。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 纯 CI 改动。Before：[失败 job 日志](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41160950657/job/124418225161)，`df -i` 显示 `tmpfs 1048576 1045825 2751 100% /tmp`。After：上述本地验证。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅（本地验证）；Windows N/A（该步骤仅 Linux）；Linux ⚠️（由本 PR 自己的 CI 运行覆盖）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：极小——一行环境变量导出，与单测车道既有路由一致；没有 RUNNER_TEMP 的 hosted runner 回落到原行为。
- 未验证/范围外：ECS 主机层面的 `/tmp` 卫生（其他进程累积的临时文件仍可能填满 tmpfs，砸到其他硬编码 `/tmp` 的地方），属于运维跟进项，不被本 PR 阻塞。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

## 关联

失败现场见 #15965；路由方案沿用 #10035。

</details>

prs.title: fix(release): use the job token for the publish checkout
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The release publish job's checkout now uses the job's automatic GitHub token instead of the bot PAT. The PAT remains on the two steps that need it: pushing the release branch and creating the GitHub release, both of which re-authenticate explicitly.

## Why it's needed

The v0.26.2 release run failed at the first `Checkout` step of `Publish Release` with `could not read Username for 'https://github.com': terminal prompts disabled` (three fetch attempts, git exit 128). A re-run of the same commit checked out successfully, and the v0.26.2-preview.1 publish job hit the same failure about 40 minutes earlier. The publish checkout was the only release checkout that supplied `secrets.CI_BOT_PAT`, while also setting `persist-credentials: false`; the push step re-authenticates on its own. A read-only checkout therefore had a secret dependency it never used, and a transient auth failure at that point aborted the release before any work ran.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused scripts suites and the size gate: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/package-scripts.test.js scripts/tests/release-workflow.test.js` and `bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh`. Both should pass. To see the new pin work, temporarily add `token: '${{ secrets.CI_BOT_PAT }}'` back to the publish checkout and rerun the first command: the assertion `expect(checkoutStep).not.toContain('CI_BOT_PAT')` fails. Remove it and the suite returns to green. On the next release run, confirm the publish checkout succeeds and that the release branch is still pushed by the bot PAT (that step is unchanged).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the publish checkout passed `token: secrets.CI_BOT_PAT`, and a checkout auth failure aborted the release at step 3 (the public run annotations show `could not read Username`). After: the checkout uses the action's default `github.token`; the PAT is supplied only to the push and release-creation steps.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox, Node.js 22.23.2, pnpm 11.24.0 via corepack. The GitHub-hosted release environment cannot be reproduced locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: nothing in the job relied on the checkout's PAT. `persist-credentials: false` is set, the job token has `contents: write`, and every later authenticated operation supplies the PAT explicitly. The push and release-creation steps are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact hosted-runner environment; the next release run is the end-to-end check.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15727

prs.title: feat(autofix-pr): report a blocked round and state the merge boundary
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A watch on a pull request now tells the pull request when it is blocked. A round that could not push anything — its fix failed verification, a push was refused, a failure turned out to need a person — posts one comment saying what it attempted, what blocks it and what is needed from a human. Before, such a round was silent on the pull request: the outcome reached only the session's report line and the watch's status listing.

That comment does not repeat. A round which answers no comments gets one summary per head, and a later round posts another only when it leaves something new for a person; the same blocked items never post it twice, and a watch started with replies turned off still posts nothing.

The skill also states the limit of the job where the user reads it — in its opening, in the start confirmation, and in the user guide: the watch gets the pull request ready to merge and keeps it there, and it never approves a pull request, changes its review state, merges or closes it, or turns on auto-merge. It combines with the repository's auto-merge, which merges once the reviews and checks pass. Until now that limit was written only in the instructions handed to the fix agent, which the user never sees.

## Why it's needed

GitHub shipped Agent Merge on 2026-10-28: the **Watch and fix** button in a pull request's merge box, which watches for the blockers its owner selected — failed Actions workflows, merge conflicts — and fixes them in the cloud. Comparing it with this skill surfaced two gaps that cost almost nothing to close.

The first is visibility. Agent Merge reports its work on the pull request itself, so its state is visible where the pull request is read. Ours reported a blocked round only inside the session, so a reviewer could not tell a watch that was still working from one that had given up. On a pull request that keeps failing, the blocked rounds are exactly what a reviewer needs to see.

The second is the boundary. Agent Merge's documentation says in one sentence that it gets a pull request ready to merge, that it does not enable auto-merge, and that it replaces neither human review nor the repository's merge requirements. This skill already behaved that way, but documented it only for the agent. Someone starting a watch should be told what it will not do before consenting to it, particularly since it pushes and replies under their own git and GitHub identity.

There was a trap in the first gap. The reply helper already allowed a summary with no push, but only once per head, so a head an earlier round had summarized — after a push, or after answering comments — suppressed every later blocked round on it. Teaching the skill to ask for that comment without addressing this would have produced a rule that silently never fires in the most common case.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the reply helper's suite and the skill's pin suite (commands and real output below). Expect 32 and 11 passing; they were 30 and 9 before this change. The whole watch-helper directory is worth running too: 16 files, 482 passing.
2. Confirm the new behavior is load-bearing rather than decorative. In the reply helper, turn the new condition — "the plan added at least one item for a person this head has not recorded" — into an impossible threshold, and rerun the two new tests. Expect the blocked-round test to fail because the summary was skipped. Restore the file from the commit and expect green again. This was done during development; the captured output below shows the failure and the clean restore.
3. Read the summary rule in the skill's reply step, and the boundary sentences in its opening and its start confirmation. Expect the summary to be omitted only when nothing was pushed, no review or issue comment was answered, and nothing needs a person; and expect the watch to be described as never approving, changing the review state, merging, closing, or enabling auto-merge.
4. On a real pull request, start a watch and let a round fail verification or have its push refused. Expect one comment on the pull request naming what blocks it, and no second comment when the same round is retried. **Not executed locally** — no live watch was started for this change; steps 1–3 are what was verified here.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real terminal output from the working tree at head `c6792580d8` (base `46d825d115`): the two suites, the deliberate mutation and its restore, the whole watch-helper directory, format and lint, then the typecheck with a base-versus-head attribution.

![Verification output: 11 skill pins and 482 watch-helper tests passing, the mutation check failing as intended and the tree restored clean, Prettier and ESLint clean, core typecheck clean, and the 68 cli typecheck errors proven identical on the base commit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/autofix-pr-blocked-round/autofix-blocked-round-verification.png)

Observable behavior on a pull request, before and after:

- **Before** — a round whose fix failed verification pushed nothing and posted nothing. The pull request showed no sign that the watch had tried and stopped; only `/autofix-pr status` and the session's one-line report knew.
- **After** — that round posts one comment saying what it attempted and what a person has to decide. Retrying the same round adds nothing. A later round on the same head that hits a different blocker posts once more.

The typecheck line needs reading with care: this checkout's dependencies predate the lockfile, so its `cli` typecheck is red on the base commit too. Restoring the two changed files to the base and rerunning gives an identical list of 68 errors, all in the daemon and ACP surfaces, none in a changed file. The core typecheck is clean. A full build was not run locally for the same dependency reason; CI on this pull request is the authoritative build and typecheck.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ not tested   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ tested   |

### Environment

Linux x86_64, Node 22, vitest 3.2.7, no sandbox. Unit tests, typecheck, lint and format only — no live watch against a real pull request, and no full local build (see above).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: one extra pull request comment per head that has no summary yet, plus one per round that adds a new blocked item on a head already summarized. New blocked items require new events — a new failed attempt, a new trusted comment — which the gate reports once and the handled-item records then suppress, so a quiet pull request costs nothing and a stuck one cannot loop on the same item. A watch started with replies off posts nothing at all.
- A second, smaller tradeoff: "new" is judged by the blocked-items list, which keeps the newest 20 items of a watch. A plan with more than 20 blocked lines, or an item that later ones pushed out of the list, can therefore be reported again. The cost is one extra comment, never a loop, since a round runs only when the gate reports a new event. This is written into the design note rather than left implicit.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live watch end-to-end run, and no full local build. The rest of what Agent Merge does is deliberately left out and recorded as non-goals in the design note — per-blocker authorization (its `fix_ci` / `resolve_merge_conflicts` selection), a declared environment setup for the fix worktree, default enrollment for one's own pull requests, and stacked or fork eligibility.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No new state field and no schema change, no new GitHub write surface, and the gate probe, its cursor, the push budget and the trust rules are untouched. Existing watches keep their state files as they are.
- Design documents: the new note in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-blocked-round-report/docs/design/2026-10-31-autofix-pr-merge-boundary-and-blocked-report.md) and [Chinese](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-blocked-round-report/docs/design/2026-10-31-autofix-pr-merge-boundary-and-blocked-report.zh-CN.md), plus the updated command design in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-blocked-round-report/docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.md) and [Chinese](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-blocked-round-report/docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.zh-CN.md). Both pairs are complete and synchronized, including the decisions, the 20-item constraint, the validation results and the acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

None. The motivation is GitHub's [Agent Merge changelog of 2026-10-28](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-agent-merge-watches-and-fixes-pull-requests-in-the-cloud/) and its [documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-on-github/use-copilot-agents/watch-and-fix-pull-requests), both linked from the design note.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

监视现在会在自己受阻时告诉 PR。一轮如果什么都没推送——修复没通过验证、推送被拒、某个失败需要人来判断——就发一条评论，说明它尝试了什么、被什么卡住、需要人决定什么。此前这样的一轮在 PR 上完全静默：结果只进入会话的一行报告和监视的 status 列表。

这条评论不会重复。不回答任何评论的一轮，每个 head 只发一条总结；之后的一轮只有在留下**新的**人工事项时才再发一条。同样的受阻事项不会发第二次，启动时关闭回复的监视仍然什么都不发。

skill 也在用户读得到的地方写明了职责上限——开头、启动确认、用户指南：监视把 PR 修到可合并并保持在那里，从不 approve、改变评审状态、合并或关闭 PR，也不开启 auto-merge。它可以与仓库的 auto-merge 组合，由后者在评审和检查都通过后合并。在此之前，这条上限只写给修复 agent 看的指令里，用户根本读不到。

## 为什么需要

GitHub 于 2026-10-28 上线 Agent Merge：PR 合并框里的 **Watch and fix** 按钮，按启用者勾选的阻塞项（失败的 Actions workflow、合并冲突）监视并在云端修复。把它与本 skill 对照后，发现两个几乎零成本就能补上的缺口。

第一个是可见性。Agent Merge 把工作情况报告在 PR 本身上，所以它的状态在看 PR 的地方就可见。我们此前只在会话内部报告受阻的一轮，reviewer 分不清"监视还在跑"和"监视已经放弃"。而在一个反复失败的 PR 上，受阻的那些轮恰恰是 reviewer 最需要看到的。

第二个是边界。Agent Merge 的文档用一句话讲清：它把 PR 修到可合，它不开启 auto-merge，也不替代人工评审和仓库的合并要求。本 skill 的行为本来就是这样，却只写给 agent 看。启动监视的人应当在同意之前被告知它不做什么，尤其因为它是以用户自己的 git 与 GitHub 身份推送和回复的。

第一个缺口里有个陷阱。回复助手本来就允许"无推送的总结"，但每个 head 只允许一条，所以只要上一轮已在这个 head 发过总结（推送之后，或回答评论之后），之后所有受阻的一轮都会被压掉。只教 skill 去要这条评论而不解决这一点，就会得到一条在最常见情形下静默失效的规则。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 跑回复助手的套件与 skill 的 pin 套件（命令与真实输出见下）。预期分别 32 与 11 通过；改动前是 30 与 9。整个监视助手目录也值得跑：16 个文件、482 通过。
2. 确认新行为是承重的、不是装饰。把回复助手里的新条件——"计划新增了该 head 尚未记录的人工事项"——改成一个不可能达到的阈值，重跑两条新测试。预期受阻一轮的测试因为总结被跳过而失败。再从提交恢复该文件，预期重新变绿。开发过程中已这样做，下方截图记录了这次失败与干净还原。
3. 读 skill 回复步骤里的总结规则，以及开头与启动确认里的边界句。预期：只有在"没推送、没回答 review 或 issue 评论、且没有人工事项"时才省略总结；预期监视被描述为从不 approve、改变评审状态、合并、关闭或开启 auto-merge。
4. 在真实 PR 上启动监视，让一轮验证失败或推送被拒。预期 PR 上出现一条指明阻塞原因的评论，重跑同一轮不再新增评论。**本地未执行**——本次没有启动真实监视；本地验证的是第 1–3 步。

### 证据（前后对比）

来自工作树 head `c6792580d8`（base `46d825d115`）的真实终端输出：两个套件、故意做的变异及其还原、整个监视助手目录、格式化与 lint，然后是带 base/head 归因的 typecheck。

![验证输出：11 条 skill pin 与 482 条监视助手测试通过，变异检查按预期失败且工作树还原干净，Prettier 与 ESLint 干净，core typecheck 干净，cli 的 68 个 typecheck 错误被证明在 base 提交上完全相同](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/autofix-pr-blocked-round/autofix-blocked-round-verification.png)

PR 上可观察的行为，前后对比：

- **改动前**——修复没通过验证的一轮，既不推送也不发帖。PR 上看不出监视曾经尝试并停下；只有 `/autofix-pr status` 和会话里的一行报告知道。
- **改动后**——这一轮发一条评论，说明它尝试了什么、需要人决定什么。重跑同一轮不新增内容。之后同一 head 上的一轮若碰到不同的阻塞，再发一条。

typecheck 那一行要仔细读：本 checkout 的依赖停在旧 lockfile，所以它的 `cli` typecheck 在 base 提交上同样是红的。把两个改动文件退回 base 再跑一次，得到完全相同的 68 个错误清单，全部位于 daemon 与 ACP 相关代码，没有一个指向改动文件。core 的 typecheck 干净。出于同样的依赖原因，本地未跑全量构建；本 PR 上的 CI 才是构建与 typecheck 的权威结果。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ 未测试   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ 未测试   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ 已测试   |

### 环境

Linux x86_64、Node 22、vitest 3.2.7、无沙箱。只跑了单元测试、typecheck、lint 与格式化——没有对真实 PR 启动监视，也没有本地全量构建（见上）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：每个尚无总结的 head 多一条 PR 评论；在已总结过的 head 上，每轮新增受阻事项再多一条。新增受阻事项必须有新事件——新的失败 attempt、新的可信评论——闸门只报告一次，随后由已处理记录压掉，所以安静的 PR 不花任何成本，卡住的 PR 也不会围绕同一件事刷屏。启动时关闭回复的监视完全什么都不发。
- 另一个较小的权衡："新增"以受阻事项列表是否还留着为准，而该列表只保留监视最新的 20 项。因此一份超过 20 行受阻事项的计划，或被后来事项挤出列表的某一项，可能被再报告一次。代价是多一条评论，绝不会成循环，因为一轮只在闸门报告新事件时才运行。这一点写进了设计文档，而不是留作隐含行为。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有真实监视的端到端运行，也没有本地全量构建。Agent Merge 的其余能力刻意不做，并在设计文档里记为非目标——按阻塞项授权（它的 `fix_ci` / `resolve_merge_conflicts` 选择）、为修复 worktree 声明环境准备、对自己创建的 PR 默认启用，以及 stacked 与 fork 的 eligibility。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。不新增状态字段、不改 schema、不新增 GitHub 写入面，闸门探针、游标、推送预算与信任规则都不动。已有监视的状态文件原样可用。
- 设计文档：新增说明的[英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-blocked-round-report/docs/design/2026-10-31-autofix-pr-merge-boundary-and-blocked-report.md)与[中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-blocked-round-report/docs/design/2026-10-31-autofix-pr-merge-boundary-and-blocked-report.zh-CN.md)，以及更新后的命令设计的[英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-blocked-round-report/docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.md)与[中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-blocked-round-report/docs/design/2026-10-21-autofix-pr-command.zh-CN.md)。两对文档完整且同步，包括设计决策、20 项上限这条约束、验证结果与验收标准。

## 关联 Issue

无。动机来自 GitHub 的 [Agent Merge 变更日志（2026-10-28）](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-agent-merge-watches-and-fixes-pull-requests-in-the-cloud/)及其[文档](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-on-github/use-copilot-agents/watch-and-fix-pull-requests)，两者都已链接在设计说明里。

</details>

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): qualify the storage stall and keep the per-row lease note
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Applies two review suggestions on #15965 that arrived after it merged. Both change setting descriptions in `configuration-descriptions.json`, in English and Chinese, and the two configuration reference pages are regenerated from it:

- **`artifacts.read-timeout`.** The row said a download also ends when one storage read receives nothing for 50 seconds, the OSS client's default socket timeout. That holds only for the object's content stream. Opening the object is retried: `AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore.read` retries a `SocketTimeout` from `getObject` up to `ClientConfiguration.DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` (3) times, and runs the download's guard before each attempt. The row now says the 50 seconds applies to the stream, and that a request to open the object that times out is first retried up to three times while `read-timeout` allows.
- **`automation.scanner-threads`.** The README table that #15965 removed also said that a row's lease runs from that row's own claim, so a long tick hands out no already-expired lease. No operator-facing page kept that, so the row now says it. The source is `AutomationScanner.claimed`, which reads the clock at the claim.

The third suggestion, which said the 30 minutes in `v3-result-window` is the default of `harness.turn-deadline`, is answered on #15965 and not applied. The Harness's Tool v3 wait is a literal `30 * 60_000` in `hosted-workspace-broker.ts`, so the sentence stands.

## Why it's needed

#15965 moved these facts out of the server README so that the configuration reference is the one place they are stated. One of the moved sentences was wrong in the case of a stall before the response arrives, and one fact had been dropped.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -DskipTests clean process-classes
node scripts/generate-managed-agent-configuration-reference.mjs --check
node --test scripts/tests/generate-managed-agent-configuration-reference.test.mjs scripts/tests/package-managed-agent-reference.test.mjs
```

Then read the two rows against `AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore.read` and `open`, `ToolPublicationDataStore`'s copy loop (a stream `IOException` becomes the failure `ManagedArtifactService.content` handles), and `AutomationScanner.claimed`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A, documentation only. On this head the generator check passes with two rows changed per language, the generator and packaging suites pass 38/38, and Prettier is clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** none beyond wording; no setting or behaviour changes.
- **Not validated / out of scope:** the triage note that Sessions under a CSI guard record no receipts for projection is not added here. It is a separate fact about the CSI path that needs its own check before it goes into the `artifacts.enabled` row.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15965; part of the deployment usability plan (#12380), item 12.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

落实 #15965 合入后才到的两条评审建议。两处都是修改 `configuration-descriptions.json` 中的设置描述（中英文都改），并据此重新生成两份配置参考页面：

- **`artifacts.read-timeout`。** 原句说：一次存储读取 50 秒内没有收到任何数据（OSS 客户端的默认 socket 超时）时，下载也会结束。这只对对象的内容流成立。打开对象这一步会重试：`AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore.read` 对 `getObject` 抛出的 `SocketTimeout` 最多重试 `ClientConfiguration.DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES`（3）次，并在每次尝试前运行下载的 guard。现在这一行写明：50 秒针对的是数据流；打开对象的请求超时时，会先在 `read-timeout` 允许的范围内最多重试三次。
- **`automation.scanner-threads`。** #15965 删掉的 README 表格里还有一条：每一行的租约从该行自己的认领时刻起算，因此扫描轮次再长也不会发放已经过期的租约。面向运维的文档里已经没有这句话，所以补到这一行。依据是 `AutomationScanner.claimed`，它在认领时读取时钟。

第三条建议认为 `v3-result-window` 中的 30 分钟是 `harness.turn-deadline` 的默认值。这一条已在 #15965 上回复，没有采纳：Harness 等待 Tool v3 的期限在 `hosted-workspace-broker.ts` 中是字面量 `30 * 60_000`，所以原句成立。

## 为什么需要

#15965 把这些事实从 server README 移到了配置参考，使它们只在一处说明。其中一句在响应到达之前就停顿的情形下是错的，还有一条事实被漏掉了。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```bash
mvn -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -DskipTests clean process-classes
node scripts/generate-managed-agent-configuration-reference.mjs --check
node --test scripts/tests/generate-managed-agent-configuration-reference.test.mjs scripts/tests/package-managed-agent-reference.test.mjs
```

然后对照代码阅读这两行：`AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore.read` 和 `open`；`ToolPublicationDataStore` 的复制循环（数据流的 `IOException` 会变成 `ManagedArtifactService.content` 处理的那种失败）；以及 `AutomationScanner.claimed`。

### 证据（修改前后）

N/A，仅文档改动。在当前 head 上，生成器检查通过，每种语言改动 2 行；生成器与打包测试 38/38 通过；Prettier 干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

N/A

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或权衡：** 只涉及措辞，没有任何设置或行为改变。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：** triage 提到 CSI guard 下的 Session 不会记录回执用于投影，这里没有加。这是关于 CSI 路径的另一条事实，写进 `artifacts.enabled` 一行之前需要单独核实。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。

## 关联 Issue

#15965 的后续；属于部署易用性计划（#12380）第 12 项。

</details>

prs.title: fix(acp-bridge): display declared Channel submissions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

For Channel-source sessions, use a nonblank original-text declaration as the display projection when the request has a text block and the turn has no channel-worker classification or worker display projection. Pending text, live user echoes, and durable recording use the original declaration verbatim, while the model still receives the complete prepared prompt.

Missing, invalid, empty, whitespace-only, and media-only submissions retain their content-derived display. An explicit worker projection keeps precedence, including an intentionally empty projection paired with a declaration. Add regression coverage for these boundaries and synchronize the [English design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md) and [Chinese design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

An external Channel gateway can submit model text such as `gateway instructions\nhello` and separately declare the original user text `hello` through the existing non-privileged `qwen.submittedPrompt` contract. The declaration reaches the bridge, but the user echo and transcript display the prepared wrapper. This change displays `hello` consistently without removing the instructions from model input or granting worker authority.

The declaration is a display contract, not authentication or proof of authorship. Native authenticated channel-worker history behavior and Qwen product wording remain unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Submit a prepared text prompt to a Channel-source session with a nonblank original-text declaration and no worker keys. Pending text and live user echo should match the raw declaration, including surrounding whitespace. The complete prepared prompt should still reach the model.
2. Complete the turn, stop the daemon, start a new process with the same isolated runtime, and load the session. Both load replay and transcript paging should show the declaration; persisted model content should retain the prepared text.
3. Omit the declaration or supply an invalid type, empty string, or whitespace-only string. Display should retain the prepared text. For an image-only request with a nonblank declaration, pending text should stay `[image]`, the echo should contain only the image, and private display metadata should be absent. Ordinary-source sessions should keep their original display.
4. Confirm caller-supplied private display metadata cannot select this fallback and worker-classified turns cannot acquire a declaration-based projection. An explicit worker projection should win over a declaration; an empty worker projection must still hide every text block and forward `''`.
5. Set a one-tool-call cap and use a controlled model to request another tool call from an ordinary declared Channel turn. Expect `turn_error` with `LOOP_DETECTED`, `errorKind: loop_detected`, and `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The review baseline reproduced three display regressions: an empty declaration erased the live echo and durable user display while the turn-result record retained the wrapper; whitespace-only declarations replaced the display with blank space; a media-only declaration changed pending/child display metadata without adding a live text echo.

After the correction, all ten bridge cases pass. Six real daemon text cases pass live pending/echo, durable user/turn-result recording, and cold-process load plus transcript replay: 18 assertions. A separate real loop-cap assertion also passes, for 19 daemon assertions total. Every complete prepared text was observed in the mock model request and persisted intact. The worker-empty-projection control passes normally and fails an actually executed isolated `??` to `||` mutation.

Local quality checks passed: all 2,639 ACP Bridge package tests, repository typecheck, changed-file lint and Prettier checks, build, and bundle. Independent read-only review found no actionable issue. Test reports and artifact fingerprints are retained locally under `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` and `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`; these ignored artifacts are not included in the PR. This is protocol/recording evidence, not a browser screenshot or deployed gateway acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local quality checks and real daemon with a mock model |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, and the rebuilt `node dist/cli.js`. The runtime test used synthetic prompts, isolated workspace/home/runtime directories, port-0 listeners, and a local mock OpenAI endpoint. The global `qwen` command was unavailable, so verification used the local bundle. Both daemon processes and the mock endpoint were stopped. CI for the newly pushed source revision must complete separately; earlier revisions do not validate this update.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an eligible Channel caller can choose the declared display text; that text does not authenticate the caller or prove human authorship. The model still sees the full prepared prompt.
- Not validated / out of scope: external gateway integration, real provider behavior, browser rendering, historical record rewriting, and deployment. Preexisting submission-provenance forwarding remains unchanged; Session already omits blank provenance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new API or privileged flag. Gateway producers must explicitly declare nonblank original text beside a text-bearing prompt and omit worker classification, authorization, and private display keys to use the existing non-privileged route.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13747.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

对于 Channel 来源会话，当请求包含文本块、当前回合没有 channel-worker 分类或 worker 显示投影时，将非空白原文声明用于显示投影。排队文本、实时用户回显和持久录制完整保留该声明，模型仍收到完整准备后的 prompt。

缺失、非法、空串、纯空白声明及纯附件提交继续从内容取得显示文本。显式 worker 投影保持优先，包括刻意为空的投影与声明同时存在的情况。补充这些边界的回归覆盖，并同步[英文设计契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md)和[中文设计契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

外部 Channel 网关可提交 `gateway instructions\nhello` 这样的模型文本，并通过既有非特权 `qwen.submittedPrompt` 契约单独声明用户原文 `hello`。声明已经到达 bridge，但用户回显和记录仍显示准备后的包装文本。本改动将展示统一为 `hello`，同时保留交给模型的指令，也不授予 worker 权限。

声明属于展示契约，不是认证，也不证明作者身份。原生授权 channel-worker 的历史展示行为和 Qwen 产品文案保持不变。

## 评审验收计划

### 如何验证

1. 向 Channel 来源会话提交准备后的文本 prompt 与非空白原文声明，省略所有 worker 键。排队文本和实时用户回显应完整保留声明及其空白，模型仍应收到完整准备后的 prompt。
2. 完成回合后退出 daemon，以相同隔离 runtime 启动新进程并加载会话。load 重放与 transcript 分页都应显示声明，持久模型内容仍应保留准备后的文本。
3. 省略声明，或提供非法类型、空串、纯空白字符串，显示应保留准备后的文本。纯图片请求即使带有非空白声明，排队文本仍应为 `[image]`，回显只包含图片，且不附加私有显示元数据。普通来源会话保留原有展示。
4. 确认调用方自报的私有显示字段不能选择此回退，已分类的 worker 回合也不能取得声明投影。显式 worker 投影应优先于声明；空 worker 投影仍须隐藏所有文本块，并转发 `''`。
5. 设置单回合工具调用上限为一次，让受控模型在普通声明 Channel 回合继续请求工具调用。预期收到 `turn_error`，包含 `LOOP_DETECTED`、`errorKind: loop_detected` 和 `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`。

### 证据（修改前后）

评审基线复现了三项展示回归：空声明隐藏实时回显和持久用户展示，但回合结果记录仍保留包装文本；纯空白声明将展示替换为空白；纯附件声明改变排队项和子进程显示元数据，却没有增加实时文本回显。

修正后，十项 bridge 场景全部通过。六项真实 daemon 文本场景通过实时排队与回显、持久用户与回合结果录制、冷进程 load 与 transcript 重放，共十八项断言；独立执行的真实工具调用上限断言也通过，daemon 共十九项断言。模拟模型实际请求和持久记录都完整保留了准备后的文本。空 worker 投影控制用例正常通过，实际执行隔离的 `??` 改为 `||` 变异后则失败。

本地质量检查通过：ACP Bridge 包全部 2,639 项测试、仓库类型检查、改动文件 lint 与 Prettier 检查、构建及打包。独立只读评审未发现可行动问题。测试报告及制品指纹保留在本地 `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` 和 `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`，这些被忽略的制品不包含在 PR 中。上述属于协议与录制证据，不代表浏览器截图或已部署网关验收。

### 已验证平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地质量检查与使用模拟模型的真实 daemon 验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |

### 环境

Node 22.23.1、固定版本 pnpm 11.24.0，以及重新构建的 `node dist/cli.js`。运行时测试使用合成消息、隔离的 workspace/home/runtime 目录、自动分配端口的监听及本地模拟 OpenAI 服务。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，因此使用本地 bundle 验证。两个 daemon 进程和模拟服务均已停止。新推送 source revision 的 CI 须单独完成，旧 revision 的结果不能验证本次更新。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：符合条件的 Channel 调用方可选择声明的显示文本；该文本不认证调用方，也不证明内容由人撰写。模型仍会收到完整准备后的 prompt。
- 未验证或不在范围内：外部网关集成、真实 provider 行为、浏览器渲染、历史记录改写及部署。已有提交来源转发保持不变，Session 已经会省略空白来源。
- 兼容性与迁移：不新增 API 或特权标记。网关生产方须在包含文本的 prompt 之外显式声明非空白原文，并省略 worker 分类、授权和私有显示键，才能使用既有非特权路由。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13747。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): gate the B3 round-and-cost-budget crash window
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Packages matrix row B3 ("after earlier tools") of the hosted recovery acceptance as a fourteenth fault arm in the existing failover CI job. A multi-round fixture runs two earlier tool rounds, each with its own approval, execution and physical file effect, and the replacement Harness is crashed while a later post-tool model request is held open on the fake-model side (no new serve hook is needed). After scrashing the crashed generation's disk, the next generation must recover from MySQL alone: resume the saved logical round, restore the turn cost snapshot and the per-model token ledger, reissue the saved request deep-equal, retract the published prefix, and project exactly one terminal with the recovered answer. Both earlier Actions must end decided under their original IDs, and each earlier execution must occur exactly once under its original Runtime identity. The arm is fully gated on the new fault name, so every single-round arm is unchanged; there is no production behavior change.

## Why it's needed

B3 had focused/integration evidence only. The existing result-commit arm crashes after a single tool round; nothing crashed a replacement after several tool rounds and proved the numeric round counter and the turn cost ledger survive it. A recovery that restarts the round at 0 (letting a Turn run past its configured round limit) or zeroes the token ledger would pass CI today. "Cost budget" here is verified to mean the TurnBudget snapshot (parsed from the user's +Nk directive) plus the per-model session token ledger — there is no free-standing cumulative spend gate in the main model loop — so the arm asserts restoration fidelity of exactly that state. The ledger assertion compares per-model output-token totals with non-vacuity guards because an unrestored ledger is an empty-but-truthy object, which a null check alone would let pass; the fixture charges non-zero usage (300/300/100) so a zeroed restore totals less than the crash-boundary ledger instead of re-counting the same sum.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the new arm (it needs the bundled CLI, the server jar and a runner-private mysqld, exactly like its sibling arms): `npm run test:e2e:managed-harness-restart-approval-after-earlier-tools`. Expect a green run whose evidence shows: crash-boundary round 2 with a 500000-token snapshot and a 600-token ledger; recovered round 2 with a deep-equal snapshot and a 700-token ledger (the restored 600 plus the final round's 100 — proof the ledger was restored, not re-counted); a deep-equal reissue of the held request; both earlier executions SETTLED once each under the original Runtime identity with both file effects; both earlier Actions decided under their original IDs; the published prefix reconciled away; one terminal; the next Turn completes; close admitted 202. The contract suites pin the fixture, the choreography, the readers and every assertion; the round/budget reader also has a behavioural test on injected journal rows (including the escaped-quote JSON shape that mysql batch mode corrupts). The failover job ceiling rises from 26 to 27 arms (285 minutes).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change. Real-stack evidence is posted as a separate comment: head green twice on the .75 Linux rig (including a post-restore re-run), three named mutation kills (round reset → round-continuity red; ledger wipe → ledger red; snapshot restore dropped → re-baselining red), and three survived mutation cells documenting that the execution-count assertion is defense-in-depth in this window (exactly-once rides three independent guards: the saved-request replay routing, the continuation route's settled-batch adoption, and the Runtime's runtimeCallId idempotency on the Java side).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS: contract suites, workflow meta-tests, full build, typecheck, ESLint, Prettier. Linux: .75 real-stack rig (Ubuntu 24.04 container, Node 22.23.3, JDK 21.0.9, MySQL 8.0.46), three-generation crash/recovery choreography with the crashed generation's disk scrashed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fixture and several assertions are shared with the single-round approval arms; everything new is gated on the fault name, and the shared gates (hold arming AND release, prefix capture, retraction proof) enumerate both fault names — a release gated to the older arm alone was caught and fixed during real-stack verification. The contract suites and the single-round pins stay green.
- Not validated / out of scope: reddening the execution-count assertion requires a cross-language compound mutation (Java Runtime idempotency plus recovery routing), recorded as a follow-up; the skill-only / manual-continue round-reset paths' reachability in a packaged arm remains a deferred question; real-provider acceptance and full-owner restart stay separate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents (both languages, synchronized): [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-b3-round-cost-budget/docs/design/2026-10-31-hosted-b3-round-cost-budget.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-b3-round-cost-budget/docs/design/2026-10-31-hosted-b3-round-cost-budget.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #14481 (G3 Step 3 recovery-matrix acceptance, tracks #12380).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

把 hosted 恢复验收矩阵的 B3 行（「after earlier tools」）打包为现有 failover CI job 的第十四条故障支路。多轮夹具跑两个先前工具轮，每轮各有自己的审批、执行与物理文件效果；替换 Harness 在较后的 post-tool 模型请求被扣住时崩溃（hold 在 fake 模型侧，无需新 serve 钩子）。scrash 崩溃代磁盘后，下一代必须仅凭 MySQL 恢复：续跑已保存的逻辑轮次、恢复回合成本快照与每模型 token 账本、deep-equal 重发已保存请求、撤回已发布前缀、恰好投影一个带恢复答案的终态。两个先前 Action 必须在原 ID 下以 decided 结束，每个先前执行必须以原 Runtime 身份恰好发生一次。支路完全 gated 在新故障名上，单轮支路全部不变；无生产行为改动。

## 为什么需要

B3 此前仅有 focused/integration 证据。现有 result-commit 支路在单个工具轮之后崩溃；没有任何支路在若干工具轮之后崩溃并证明数值轮次计数器与回合成本账本跨替换存活。一个把轮次重启为 0（让 Turn 跑过配置轮次上限）或把 token 账本归零的恢复，今天都能通过 CI。此处「成本预算」经实证指 TurnBudget 快照（从用户 +Nk 指令解析）加每模型会话 token 账本——主模型循环没有独立的累计花费闸门——因此支路断言的正是该状态的恢复保真。账本断言比较逐模型输出 token 总量并带非空守卫，因为未恢复的账本是空但 truthy 的对象，仅查 null 会空过；夹具计入非零 usage（300/300/100），使归零恢复的总量低于崩溃边界账本，而非把同一总和重算一遍。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

运行新支路（与兄弟支路一样需要 bundled CLI、server jar 与 runner 私有 mysqld）：`npm run test:e2e:managed-harness-restart-approval-after-earlier-tools`。预期绿跑，证据显示：崩溃边界 round 2、500000 token 快照、600 token 账本；恢复后 round 2、快照 deep-equal、700 token 账本（恢复的 600 加最终轮 100——证明账本被恢复而非重算）；被扣住请求 deep-equal 重发；两个先前执行各以原 Runtime 身份 SETTLED 一次且两个文件效果都在；两个先前 Action 在原 ID 下 decided；已发布前缀被撤回；一个终态；下一 Turn 完成；close 准入 202。契约套件钉住夹具、编排、读法与每条断言；轮次/budget 读法另有注入日志行的行为化测试（含 mysql batch 模式会损坏的转义引号 JSON 形状）。failover job 上限从 26 抬到 27 臂（285 分钟）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——纯测试改动。真机证据以独立评论发布：.75 Linux rig 上 head 绿两次（含还原后重跑）、三条命名变异击杀（轮次重置→轮次连续红；账本归零→账本红；丢弃快照恢复→重新起算红），以及三个存活变异格，证明执行计数断言在此窗口是纵深防御（恰好一次依赖三道独立守卫：saved-request replay 路由、continuation 路由的 settled-batch 采纳、Java 侧 Runtime 的 runtimeCallId 幂等）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅（契约套件、workflow 元测试、全量 build、typecheck、ESLint、Prettier）；Linux ✅（.75 真机 rig，Ubuntu 24.04 容器、Node 22.23.3、JDK 21.0.9、MySQL 8.0.46，三代崩溃/恢复编排并 scrash 崩溃代磁盘）；Windows N/A。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：夹具与若干断言与单轮审批支路共享；所有新增内容 gated 在故障名上，共享 gate（hold 的 arm 与释放、前缀采集、撤回证明）枚举两个故障名——只 gate 旧支路的释放已在真机验证中抓住并修复。契约套件与单轮钉保持绿。
- 未验证/范围外：使执行计数断言变红需要跨语言复合变异（Java Runtime 幂等加恢复路由），已记录为后续；skill-only/手动 continue 轮次重置路径在打包臂中的可达性仍是延后问题；真实 provider 验收与两侧 owner 重启仍独立。
- 破坏性改动/迁移说明：无。

设计文档（双语同步）：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-b3-round-cost-budget/docs/design/2026-10-31-hosted-b3-round-cost-budget.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14481-b3-round-cost-budget/docs/design/2026-10-31-hosted-b3-round-cost-budget.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #14481（G3 Step 3 恢复矩阵验收，跟踪 #12380）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): request consent for native extension commands
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores confirmation before direct extension installation in OpenTUI. Requests use the existing action-dialog queue and belong to the current configuration; replacement or unmount cancels outstanding and captured stale requests. Extension descriptions render as sanitized native text.

## Why it's needed

A public direct-install reproduction in ordinary approval mode committed without asking in OpenTUI. Ink displayed consent and honored denial. The native shell had not registered the interactive consent callback. This CLI-only fix restores that registration without changing approval policy or Core installation behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Install an extension from an owned archive in ordinary approval mode. Confirm that its details and Yes/No choice appear before committing. Select No or cancel: initialized authority and installed-artifact state must remain unchanged. Ordinary rerenders must preserve a pending request; replacing configuration or unmounting must cancel it, and a late Yes must not approve a stale request. Existing explicit Source-acquisition confirmation remains independent.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the real native direct-install command committed without consent. Earlier Ink control observers failed on wrapped cancellation text despite confirmed denial/no-write behavior. An initial native correction also failed on raw text rendered under a box; these failures remain recorded.

After: the corrected precommit bundle passed the same public denial case on strict Bun+OpenTUI, Node+Ink and Bun+Ink. A separate installed global Ink baseline also passed with source identity unknown. Each of the four executions accepted one No, preserved exact authority and entire artifact snapshots, recorded zero model requests and exited naturally with exit0/signal0. The observer uses each renderer's existing confirmation UI, with no cosmetic production change to satisfy an Ink-only question. This verifies denial, not a later approved installation or hook execution.

Normal full build, typecheck, lint, bundle and native layout checks passed. Three whole CLI test files passed261 tests, including consent formatting/native-text rendering, FIFO Yes/No, ordinary rerenders, configuration replacement, stale callbacks, late answers and unmount. The actual precommit bundle entry is `9a16c6a746510853c9640b5368547e5f1e3dbbb07d5bb5bf6e602e4f6b028e54`; no postcommit installed or shipping artifact is claimed. Three existing native DiffDialog act warnings remain.


Follow-up for the inherited headless voice fixture: a stable extension-manager mock restores its real-shell setup. All 24 voice cases passed with devices, transcription and transport mocked. Normal rebuild, typecheck, full lint and bundle also passed; rebuilt entry `81367252387dbee315bad5113509b053fb8b4a4794e8e52c0fa2ea6740d62ac7` passed the three current denial profiles, each with full no-write snapshots, model0 and natural0/signal0. The original `9a16...` bundle is retained. This test-only descendant does not add voice/device functionality or a new installed/global baseline run.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Full normal checks,261 unit tests and three current source profiles passed; separate installed Ink baseline passed. |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested for this change. |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested for this change. |

### Environment (optional)

Owned workspace/config/runtime and immutable archive fixtures, deterministic loopback fake model API, Node24 and Bun1.4.4. The installed global baseline has unknown source identity and is not labeled as the current candidate.

## Risk & Scope

- Requests are configuration-owned; cancellation cannot roll back a Core commit already performed.
- Core APIs, approval policy, headless/provider behavior, explicit Source callbacks, marketplace choice and extension settings are unchanged.
- This CLI-only fix is independent of the Source/manual-agent feature branches. Other platforms, approved-install flow, hook lifecycle and overall migration acceptance are outside these results.
- [English design](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-command-consent.md) / [中文设计](docs/design/2026-10-31-opentui-extension-command-consent.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

No automatic closing reference.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

恢复 OpenTUI 直接安装扩展前的确认。请求使用现有动作对话框队列，归当前配置所有；替换配置或卸载取消等待及捕获的旧请求。扩展描述使用清理后的原生文本节点展示。

普通审批模式下，公开直接安装复现发现 OpenTUI 未询问即提交，而 Ink 会展示确认并接受拒绝。原因是原生 shell 未注册交互确认回调。本 CLI 修复补齐注册，不改变审批策略或 Core 安装行为。

评审应从 owned 归档安装，在提交前看到详情与 Yes/No。选择 No 或取消应保持初始化权限及整个安装产物状态不变。普通重渲染保留待确认请求；替换配置或卸载取消旧请求，迟到 Yes 无效。现有 Source 获取显式确认仍独立。

修复前真实原生命令未经确认即提交。早期 Ink 观察器虽已看到拒绝和无写入，仍因取消消息换行失败；首轮原生修正另因在 box 下渲染裸字符串失败，旧记录保留。

修后 precommit bundle 在 strict Bun+OpenTUI、Node+Ink、Bun+Ink 的同一公开拒绝 case 均通过。另一个 source 身份未知的全局已安装 Ink 基线也通过。四次均单次 No 后保持权限和整个产物快照精确不变、模型请求0，并自然 exit0/signal0。观察器使用各 renderer 现有确认界面，不为 Ink 特定问题句增加产品装饰文案。这里只证明拒绝，不证明随后同意安装或 hook 执行。

正常完整 build、typecheck、lint、bundle 与原生布局检查均通过，三个 CLI 整文件261P，覆盖确认格式/原生文本、FIFO Yes/No、普通重渲染、配置替换、旧回调、迟到答复与卸载。实际 precommit 入口为 `9a16c6a746510853c9640b5368547e5f1e3dbbb07d5bb5bf6e602e4f6b028e54`，不声明新提交后的安装或发布产物；三条原有 native DiffDialog act 警告保留。

macOS已验证上述完整检查、261测试、三个当前source profile及独立安装 Ink 基线；Windows/Linux未验证本改动。环境为 owned 工作目录/配置/runtime、不可变归档及 loopback fake API，Node24/Bun1.4.4；全局基线 source 未知，不能当当前候选。

请求归配置所有，取消不能撤销 Core 已提交事务。Core API、审批策略、headless/provider、显式 Source 回调、marketplace 选择及扩展设置不变。本 CLI 修复独立于 Source/手动 agent 分支；其他平台、同意安装、hook 生命周期与整体迁移均不在本次已证范围。双语设计同步，无自动关闭 issue 引用。


补充测试夹具修正：为 headless 语音测试补齐稳定的扩展管理器 mock 后，真实 shell 的24项测试全部通过，设备、转写和传输均为 mock。正常重建、typecheck、完整 lint 与 bundle 均通过；新入口 `81367252387dbee315bad5113509b053fb8b4a4794e8e52c0fa2ea6740d62ac7` 在三个当前拒绝路径均通过完整无写入、模型0和自然退出0验证。原9a16完整 bundle已保留。此测试修正不新增语音/设备能力，也没有重复运行已安装全局基线。

</details>

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): split AgentStateStore into six role interfaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Completes P0 step 3 of the Managed Agent structure review: the shared session state contract is split into six cohesive role interfaces — admission, lifecycle, query, policy, event projection, and turn execution — while the former interface name stays as an empty composite extending all six. Implementations and tests keep the full surface unchanged; consumers gain named seams they can inject narrowly. The three nested records and three recovery constants move to their owning roles and still resolve through the composite by inheritance; the five imports that named nested types through the composite switch to canonical names, as the language requires. Eighteen single-role consumers now inject their role directly (including OperationReconciler, unlocked by narrowing AcceptanceEvidence.settle to SessionLifecycleStore), established by a call-level audit (calls on the store variable only, with pass-through detection) after review caught the first, coarser audit overstating the composite's necessity. Most of the remaining consumers span roles or forward the store into multi-role dependencies (evidence settlement, Harness and broker wiring); four more single-role consumers (ChildWorkspaceService, WorkspaceRuntimeResolver, ManagedAutomationService, TaskCancelCoordinator) are recorded as deferred migrations for P1 — their this(...) calls are same-class constructor delegation, not forwarding. The design records the full inventory in both languages. A new pin test holds the composite empty of both methods and fields and the role set exact, so new state surface must land on a role; the constant-on-composite mutant is verified killed. All 48 member-level javadocs of the former interface are preserved verbatim in the roles (a masked-text scanning bug that dropped them was caught by verification and fixed).

## Why it's needed

The 900-line, ~150-method interface forced every consumer to see every capability and gave the upcoming implementation split no named seams. The roles are those seams: P1 can now decompose the god classes along the same boundaries, and new consumers can depend on the narrowest role they use. Doing the interface segregation before the physical split keeps each step behavior-free and independently verifiable, exactly as the accepted design prescribes.

### How to verify

Confirm the split is lossless: the union of the six role interfaces declares exactly the method signatures the former interface declared (a multiset comparison gives 210 = 210, including overloads and record constructors), and the composite declares nothing of its own. Then run the focused suite from `packages/managed-agent-server` with JDK 21:

```
mvn -Dtest='AgentStateStoreRolesTest,SessionCreationCommandContractTest,AgentStateStoreProxyTransactionTest,ManagedApprovalSelectionTest,ManagedAgentServiceWorktreeTest,OperationReconcilerTest,WorkspaceCreationStoreTest,ManagedWorkspaceAdmissionTest,SessionRowLockOrderTest,ManagedTaskCancelOperationTest,ManagedCwdChangeOperationTest,TaskCancelCoordinatorTest,ModuleArchitectureTest,MessageMaterializerTest,SessionRecoveryServiceTest,ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest' test checkstyle:check
```

Expected: 360 tests green (including the 57-test Spring integration suite), zero Checkstyle violations across all seven modules, ArchUnit boundaries green. The full H2 suite, SpotBugs, MySQL integration, Hosted/fault profiles, and the API contract gates run in CI.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal refactor with no user-visible surface change.

Local results (JDK 21.0.9, isolated task repository):

```
Tests run: 360, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
[INFO] You have 0 Checkstyle violations.   (all 7 modules)
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS
signature multiset: original 210 = role union 210, missing NONE, extra NONE
```

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.9, Maven 3.9.11, task-isolated local repository hardlink-seeded from the warm cache. H2 unit paths only locally; real MySQL and Hosted paths are CI-owned.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a wide but purely structural diff (36 files). Mitigation: lossless signature-multiset proof, full-reactor compile, 360 focused tests including the Spring integration suite, transaction boundaries, lock order, admission and reconciliation, plus the ArchUnit gate.

prs.title: fix(core): resolve MSYS paths in the file tools on Windows
prs.body:
## What happens

On Windows with Git Bash as the shell, a command that writes to /tmp creates the file in the OS temp directory, because the MSYS shell maps /tmp there. The file tools opened the same string literally, so it resolved to `<drive>:\tmp`. `read_file` answered "File not found" for a file that existed, and a native Python child process failed on the same string.

I reproduced it before writing the patch. From Git Bash, `echo qwenprobe > /tmp/probe_qwen.txt` followed by `cygpath -w /tmp/probe_qwen.txt` shows `C:\Users\andre\AppData\Local\Temp\probe_qwen.txt`. Then `read_file("/tmp/probe_qwen.txt")` answers File not found, and so does `python -c "print(open('/tmp/probe_qwen.txt').read())"`.

In an unattended run the agent concluded that /tmp was ephemeral and started writing scratch files inside the repository, where they showed up as untracked files.

## What this changes

A new helper in `packages/core/src/utils/paths.ts` converts POSIX-absolute paths before the file tools touch the disk: `/tmp` maps to `os.tmpdir()` and `/c/...` maps to `C:\...`. It is applied by `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit` and `ls` through `normalizeFilePath`, which is the existing `unescapePath` plus the conversion. Outside Windows, and for any path that is not POSIX-absolute, it returns the input unchanged.

I kept the change to the tools that open files. `grep`, `glob` and `notebook_edit` still resolve their own paths and can follow in a separate change if you want the same treatment there.

## Verification

The new unit tests cover the /tmp mapping, the drive-letter mapping, the no-op on other platforms, and the pass-through of Windows and relative paths. The paths test file is green with 132 tests passed, and typecheck plus eslint are clean on the six touched files.

Fixes #15920

prs.title: refactor(web-shell): share session view reset state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR consolidates the shared transcript-view reset used by session changes and `/clear`. It also makes the component contract explicit: when a consumer keeps the same transcript component mounted across a session-key change, a reading pause from the previous session is cleared. A reconnect within the same session continues to preserve that pause.

## Why it's needed

The two reset paths maintained overlapping state independently. Sharing their common reset keeps those paths consistent and covers the component's mount-stable session-switch contract. The shipped routes already remount the transcript or render an empty transcript when switching sessions, so this is component-level hardening, not a demonstrated user-visible fix on those routes.

The main-CI failure tracked in #15038 is an unhandled rejection in the hosted workspace tool-turn tests. This Web Shell change does not fix that failure and must not close its tracker.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Keep one transcript component mounted, pause following, and change its session key while supplying the next session's non-empty transcript. Following should resume, both with and without a replay transition.
- Reconnect within the same session after pausing. The reading position should remain paused.
- Clear the transcript within the same session. The existing clear/reset behavior should remain intact.
- Treat the session-switch DOM cases as component-contract coverage; the shipped routes' remount/empty-first behavior is not a before/after reproduction of this change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Earlier review reports establish that the added DOM cases fail without the session-switch pause reset and pass with it. The same reports establish that shipped-route-shaped cases already pass on the base. Those historical results support the component contract only; they are not new validation of the current head.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Windows | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Linux | Earlier DOM evidence is recorded in the PR discussion; the previous head's smoke check failed and checks for this closeout are pending |

## Risk & Scope

- The shared reset clears reading-pause, pagination-snapshot and expansion state. Each caller retains its additional resets; the settled-stale latch is cleared by `/clear`, not by the render-phase session switch.
- This PR changes no shipped route's mounting or empty-transcript behavior and does not repair the hosted workspace tool-turn failure.
- No local tests, build, lint or typecheck were run during this closeout, as requested. The previous smoke failure is reported separately and checks for the new head are pending; no passing browser result is claimed.
- No public API or migration change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15038; this PR does not resolve it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

合并会话切换与 `/clear` 共用的视图重置逻辑，并明确组件契约：调用方若在切换 session key 时保留同一个消息列表实例，上一会话的阅读暂停状态会被清除。同一会话重连仍保留阅读暂停。

## 为什么需要

两条路径原先分别维护重叠的重置状态。共用重置逻辑可以保持行为一致，并补全不重建组件时的会话切换契约。当前已发布页面在切换会话时会重建消息列表，或先渲染空记录，因此本 PR 是组件层加固，不是已证实的现有页面可见缺陷修复。

#15038 跟踪的是 hosted workspace tool-turn 测试中的未处理拒绝。该 Web Shell 改动不能修复此 CI 故障，也不应自动关闭它。

## Reviewer 测试计划

- 保持消息列表实例不变，暂停跟随后，改变 session key 并传入下一会话的非空记录。有回放与无回放两种情况下都应恢复跟随。
- 同一会话暂停后重连，应继续保持阅读位置。
- 在同一会话清空记录，原有清空和重置行为应保持。
- 新增 DOM 用例验证组件契约；已发布页面重建组件或先清空记录的路径不能作为本改动的前后对照复现。

## 已有证据与验证边界

此前评审记录表明，移除会话切换时的暂停重置会使新增 DOM 用例失败，保留时通过；按已发布页面形态编写的对照用例在 base 上原本就通过。这些历史结果只支撑组件契约，不代表本轮重新验证了当前 head。

本轮按用户要求未运行本地测试、构建、lint 或 typecheck。上一 head 的 Web Shell smoke 失败另行记录，新 head 的检查尚未完成；未声称浏览器验证通过。macOS 与 Windows 本轮均未验证，Linux 既有 DOM 证据见 PR 讨论。

## 风险与范围

公共重置处理阅读暂停、分页快照和展开状态；调用方保留各自额外的重置。settled-stale 状态只在 `/clear` 路径清除，不在渲染期会话切换路径清除。本 PR 不改变页面挂载方式，也不修复 hosted workspace tool-turn 故障。无公共 API 或迁移变更。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15038；本 PR 不解决该 issue。

</details>


### Latest repair

The latest repair also cancels old-session follow/animation callbacks and strengthens continued-follow assertions. It carries the two smoke selector corrections already landed in #15860. These new cases were not run locally; current-head CI remains pending.
