prs.title: test(ci): pin the setup steps the Broker fault-gate condition relies on
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This tightens the workflow pin that #15776 added for the Runtime Broker fault-gate condition, and corrects the night count in its two comments. The pin now checks that no step in the Hosted process job up to the SDK install carries `if:` or `continue-on-error`. Before, it only checked the install step's own `if:`.

## Why it's needed

The fault gates run when `steps.managed_dependencies.outcome == 'success'`. That works as a stand-in for "the CLI bundle exists" only because the install step has no condition, so it runs only after every step before it succeeded.

But a step skipped by its own `if:` fails nothing, and neither does a step whose failure `continue-on-error` absorbs. Put either on `Install, build and bundle CLI` and the install still runs, the condition still holds, and the gates spawn a `dist/cli.js` that was never built. The pin from #15776 passed both shapes.

Both points were non-blocking review notes on #15776 that I didn't get to before it merged. The bot pointed out that the comment overstated the count, and a verification on the PR found the skipped-bundle gap. The verify failed on 10 of the 14 nights to 10-27; the 11th skipped night was a cancelled run, which `!cancelled()` still skips.

Since #15776 merged, the condition has done its job on all three nightlies: on 10-28, 10-29 and 10-30 the Hosted verify failed, and the fault gates still ran, 45 tests with 0 failures each night.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`. The changed case is `runs the Broker fault gates even when the Hosted verify fails`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A, test and comment change. Results:

**Mutants against the workflow**, run under the pin test from `main` (before) and under this PR's pin test (after):

| Mutant | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| M4: `if: false` on the bundle step | 83/83, survives | red: `expected [ 'Install, build and bundle CLI' ] to deeply equal []` |
| M5: `continue-on-error: true` on the bundle step | 83/83, survives | red, same message |
| M6: `if: always()` on the install step | red | red |
| M1: drop the gates' `if:` | red | red |
| M2: point the gates' `if:` at `steps.managed_deps` | red | red |
| M3: rename the install step's id | red | red |

Under this PR, each mutant fails only this case (82 passed, 1 failed). After restoring, the suite is 83/83 again.

**Local, Linux x86_64, Node 22:**

- Every script test that reads `sdk-java.yml`: 9 files, 692 passed, 1 skipped.
- `.github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs` under `node --test`: 91/91.
- `node scripts/lint.js --actionlint` and `--yamllint` both exit 0.
- Prettier and ESLint are clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A, unit test of the workflow file only.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** a future `if:` or `continue-on-error` on any of the six steps up to and including the install now fails this pin, even where it would be harmless. That is deliberate. Whoever adds one has to say why the gates' condition still implies a built CLI.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - The workflow's behaviour does not change. The step condition is byte-identical to `main`.
  - `Verify Hosted admission gates` is still skipped after a red Hosted verify, as noted on #15776.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15776. Related to #15340.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

收紧 #15776 为 Runtime Broker fault-gate 条件加的 workflow 固定测试，并修正它两处注释里的晚数。现在固定测试会检查：Hosted process job 里，到 SDK 安装步骤为止，没有任何步骤带 `if:` 或 `continue-on-error`。以前它只检查安装步骤自己的 `if:`。

## 为什么需要

fault gates 在 `steps.managed_dependencies.outcome == 'success'` 时运行。这个条件之所以能代表“CLI bundle 已经存在”，前提是安装步骤没有条件：它只有在前面每一步都成功之后才会运行。

但是，被自己的 `if:` 跳过的步骤不会让任何东西失败；失败被 `continue-on-error` 吸收的步骤也一样。只要 `Install, build and bundle CLI` 上出现这两者之一，安装步骤照样会跑，条件照样成立，gates 就会去启动一个从未构建出来的 `dist/cli.js`。#15776 的固定测试对这两种写法都放行。

这两点都是 #15776 上的非阻塞评审意见，合入前我没来得及处理。机器人指出注释里的数字说多了；PR 上的一次验证发现了 bundle 被跳过时的漏洞。到 10-27 为止的 14 晚里，Hosted 验证失败的是 10 晚；第 11 个被跳过的晚上是一次被取消的运行，`!cancelled()` 仍然会跳过它。

#15776 合入后，这个条件在三次夜跑里都起了作用：10-28、10-29、10-30 三晚 Hosted 验证都失败了，fault gates 照样运行，每晚 45 项、0 失败。

### 如何验证

运行 `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`。改动的用例是 `runs the Broker fault gates even when the Hosted verify fails`。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A，这是测试和注释的改动。结果如下：

**针对 workflow 的变异**，分别用 `main` 上的固定测试（改动前）和本 PR 的固定测试（改动后）运行：

prs.title: fix(cli): accept explicitly named Local Control addresses outside RFC 1918/3927
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly passed `--local-control-address` is now treated as operator intent: Local Control accepts any non-internal, non-loopback IPv4 the host actually has — including addresses outside RFC 1918/3927 space (some enterprise intranets number their LANs from public ranges) and addresses on VPN/tunnel interfaces (phone and laptop on the same corporate VPN). Automatic advertisement stays RFC 1918/3927-only and untouched; the escape hatch opens only when the operator names the address, and out-of-private-space picks are logged with a loud warning on enable. The explicit pick is also resolved before the no-candidate failure, so a host with zero automatic candidates can still opt in.

## Why it's needed

On a host whose only non-loopback IPv4 is a public-range corporate-intranet address, Local Control was completely unusable: `qwen serve --local-control` exited with "No private IPv4 address is available", and `--local-control-address` could not help because it only disambiguated among candidates that had already passed the RFC 1918 filter. The same dead end hit hosts whose only usable address sits on a VPN/tunnel interface. Refuse-by-default remains the right posture for automatic advertising — the missing piece was a way for an operator to say "yes, this one, I mean it."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host whose address is outside RFC 1918/3927 (or on a VPN/tunnel interface), run `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <that-address>`. Expected: a WARNING that the address is outside private/link-local space, then the pairing QR/URL bound to that address; the LAN listener enforces the pairing token (401 without it, 200 with it). Naming an address the host does not have still fails with `unknown_lan_interface`; naming loopback still fails. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged: automatic selection stays RFC 1918/3927-only, and multiple candidates still surface the explicit-choice error. Unit tests cover the full selection matrix (public-range, tunnel interface, loopback, unknown address, ambiguity, no-candidate ordering).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (released 0.25.1, host's only address on a public-range corporate intranet):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control
qwen serve: No private IPv4 address is available. Local Control needs the host to be on a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
(exit code 1)
```

After (this branch, same host):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <public-range-address> --port 4399
qwen serve: WARNING: Local Control address <public-range-address> is outside RFC 1918 private / RFC 3927 link-local space. It was accepted only because it was named explicitly — advertise it only on a network you trust.

Local Control is on. Scan this QR code from the same network:
en0: http://<public-range-address>:4399/#token=<pairing-token>
```

LAN listener auth boundary on that address: `GET /` → 200 (Web Shell), `GET /capabilities` → 401 without the pairing token, 200 with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Dev CLI (`npm run dev`) on the affected host; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, ESLint, and Prettier all pass on the change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit opt-in deliberately widens what `--local-control-address` accepts; automatic (no-flag) behavior is unchanged, and out-of-private-space picks always log a warning. Acceptance requires the address to exist on a live interface, so wildcards, multicast, and typos stay refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: adding CGNAT (100.64/10) to the default allowlist, and a Web Shell settings-card affordance for the opt-in — both deliberately deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14136

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

显式传入的 `--local-control-address` 现在被视为操作员意图：只要主机真实持有该地址，Local Control 就接受任意非 internal、非 loopback 的 IPv4——包括 RFC 1918/3927 范围之外的地址（一些企业内网用公网段给内网编号），以及 VPN/隧道接口上的地址（手机与电脑同挂一个企业 VPN 的场景）。自动 advertise 路径保持 RFC 1918/3927-only 不变；逃生舱只在操作员显式点名地址时开启，且超出私有段的选取会在 enable 时打出醒目警告。显式选取还先于"无候选"报错解析，因此一个没有任何自动候选的主机也能通过显式指定完成配对。

## 为什么需要

当主机唯一的非 loopback IPv4 是企业内网的公网段地址时，Local Control 完全不可用：`qwen serve --local-control` 直接以 "No private IPv4 address is available" 退出，而 `--local-control-address` 也帮不上忙——它此前只能在已通过 RFC 1918 过滤的候选里消歧。唯一可用地址在 VPN/隧道接口上的主机同样无路可走。对自动 advertise 保持默认拒绝仍是正确姿态，缺的是一条让操作员明确表达"就要这个"的通道。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在地址超出 RFC 1918/3927（或位于 VPN/隧道接口）的主机上运行 `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <该地址>`。预期：先打印地址超出私有段的 WARNING，然后输出绑定该地址的配对二维码/URL；LAN listener 强制 pairing token（无 token 401，有 token 200）。指定主机没有的地址仍以 `unknown_lan_interface` 失败；指定 loopback 仍然失败。不带该 flag 时行为不变：自动选取保持 RFC 1918/3927-only，多候选仍然报"需要显式选择"。单元测试覆盖完整选取矩阵（公网段、隧道接口、loopback、未知地址、歧义、无候选顺序）。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（已发布 0.25.1，主机唯一地址在企业内网公网段）：`qwen serve --local-control` 以 exit 1 退出，报 "No private IPv4 address is available"。After（本分支，同主机）：WARNING 之后正常打印二维码与 URL，LAN listener 鉴权边界实测通过（无 token 401 / 有 token 200）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：显式 opt-in 是有意放宽 `--local-control-address` 的接受范围；无 flag 的自动行为完全不变，超出私有段的选取必打警告。接受以"主机真实持有该地址"为前提，通配、组播、笔误依旧拒绝。
- 未覆盖/刻意排除：CGNAT（100.64/10）进默认白名单、Web Shell 设置卡片的 opt-in 入口——均有意延后。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): preserve Maven suite results across cache write-back failures
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR hardens the SDK Java Maven cache path after the suite/write-back lock split. Failed MySQL integration suites can still publish downloaded artifacts while preserving the original suite status, cache setup failures preserve the already-known suite result, and the final error annotation identifies the failed Maven stage. Cache seeds report copy failures, tolerate an unavailable cache or failed best-effort prune, and detach mutable resolver metadata before Maven runs. Write-back excludes the same metadata and partial-download files.

## Why it's needed

The lock relocation associated with #15262 already landed on main through #15128 and #15254. This branch is the remaining hardening delta: a failed suite should not throw away reusable downloads, a best-effort cache operation should not replace the suite result, and mutable resolver state should not be published as an immutable shared artifact. The test repair in 11c0f4b2fb12c also includes the deferred-status reporter in extracted shell snippets so those tests can exercise their intended paths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Fail either Maven stage in the self-hosted MySQL integration lane. Reusable downloaded artifacts should reach write-back, later suites should not run, and the step should retain the failed stage's status and annotation.
- Run a green and a failed suite with an unusable cache or missing job-local repository. The cache fault should produce a warning and preserve the suite result.
- Seed a warm cache containing resolver markers and version metadata. Mutable hardlinks should be detached before Maven runs; write-back should publish artifacts while excluding resolver markers, metadata and partial-download files.
- Exercise a cold cache and a seed prune failure. Both should still reach Maven; an actual copy failure should remain visible in the log.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The current base already runs Maven before acquiring the cache lock. On the remaining delta, the prior Linux A/B report found that failed integration runs publish their download delta and retain failure, and that write-back excludes resolver markers. Its seed-prune regression was repaired by restoring best-effort pruning. The latest closeout comment records verification against the exact current head and distinguishes macOS tests from Linux shell witnesses and CI.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Focused workflow guard tests; Linux-only cases skip |
| Linux | See the exact-head closeout evidence and CI links; macOS results are not Linux verification |
| Windows | Not run locally |

## Current closeout

The branch now incorporates main's MySQL-only integration scope. The unusable-cache fixture uses a regular file in place of the cache directory, so it exercises the failure path regardless of root permission capabilities. This closeout received static source review only; no local tests, build, lint or typecheck were run, and CI was not awaited. Earlier test reports below remain historical evidence.

## Risk & Scope

The host cache remains best-effort. Failure to seed can increase network resolution. An unexpected bare-flock failure remains fatal. Real Maven resolver behavior and contention on the self-hosted pool require CI evidence beyond shell fixtures.

#15286 contains distinct follow-up work: existing-destination seed nesting, removal of old in-house artifacts from the host cache, self-hosted Checkstyle repository selection, and reference-release cache isolation. Those changes remain separately owned. Shared-helper and test-fixture extraction are deferred rather than widening this repair.

Related to #15262; the original lock relocation is already on main.



### Latest repair

The latest repair caps failed MySQL cache waits at 300 seconds and excludes metadata checksum sidecars plus older Resolver partial-download residue. Regression fixtures were updated but not executed; details and version attribution are in the closeout comment.

prs.title: fix(ci): keep sdk-java resolver bookkeeping and in-house jars out of the host cache (#15281)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The job-local Maven repository that the sdk-java suites resolve from no longer shares mutable inodes with the host cache:

- Every seed site drops `maven-metadata-local.xml` together with the other resolver bookkeeping names (`_remote.repositories`, `resolver-status.properties`, `*.lastUpdated`, `*.tmp`), so the unlocked Maven runs cannot rewrite a host-cache file through a seeded hardlink.
- The locked write-back removes the two in-house fixed-release coordinates from the host cache, prunes them at any depth rather than only at the repository root, publishes only job-produced files (the same five names stay job-local), and downgrades a failed cache-directory creation to a warning instead of reddening a green suite.
- The self-hosted Managed Agent Checkstyle leg resolves the SDK from the job-local repository the suite installed it into.
- The release builder's seed copies into the job-local repository instead of nesting a second `repository/` inside it, and drops the same bookkeeping names.
- The workflow meta-tests pin the five exclusions at every seed and both prunes, the write-back's children and their fd 9 closure, the host-side removal, the warning path, and the Checkstyle repository.

## Why it's needed

Moving Maven above the per-host lock is only safe while the job-local repository has no inode in common with the host cache. Maven's resolver rewrites its bookkeeping files in place, and the suites `install` two fixed-release in-house artifacts: seeded as hardlinks, both let an unlocked run mutate state that every sibling job on the host reads.

Correction to the earlier description: the lock-scope change itself ("only the write-back takes the lock") landed through #15128 and #15254 and is already on main. #15274 remains open with overlapping cache and deferred-status changes. This PR is the cache-isolation half that makes that scope safe, and it is judged on that, not on the lock wait from #15281.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job of a PR that touches a managed-agent path. The self-hosted step should show the `cp -aln` seed and all three Maven invocations before any `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; the lock wait should appear only at the cache write-back, and the write-back should remove the in-house coordinates before copying. Grep the job-local repository for `maven-metadata-local.xml` after the suite: it should hold only job-produced files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a seeded `maven-metadata-local.xml` and a seeded `qwencode-sdk` jar were the same inode as the host cache, so the unlocked `mvn install` changed the host file (same inode, SHA and mtime both moved). After: the host file is byte- and mtime-identical while the job-local copy is still written, the write-back publishes zero bookkeeping files and never the in-house coordinates, and the host cache loses the pre-PR in-house trees. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     |                       Status                        |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
| 🪟 Windows |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ meta-tests, size baseline, lint, Prettier        |

### Environment (optional)

Meta-tests only: `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js` (129 passed), `scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` (239 passed, 1 skipped), `scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js` (14 passed). No JDK 21 / Maven in this container, so the real Java suite is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cold host pays the seed cost once, and the write-back is best-effort and capped at 300 seconds, matching the MariaDB lane. The write-back also deletes pre-existing in-house copies from the host cache — intended, because they are the stale fixed-release jars the in-house prune exists to stop publishing.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS pool and its ticketed lock queue; the full JDK 21 Maven suite; the MySQL / MariaDB integration lanes; the hosted legs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #15281 (the lock-scope change landed through #15128 and #15254; this PR closes the cache-isolation gap that the smaller lock scope depends on).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

sdk-java 套件解析所使用的 job 本地 Maven 仓库，不再与宿主缓存共享可写 inode：

- 每个播种站点在删除其他解析器记账文件（`_remote.repositories`、`resolver-status.properties`、`*.lastUpdated`、`*.tmp`）的同时也删除 `maven-metadata-local.xml`，因此不持锁的 Maven 运行无法穿透播种的硬链接改写宿主缓存。
- 持锁的写回会在宿主缓存中删除两个内部固定发布坐标，按任意深度 prune 而不只匹配仓库根，只发布本 job 产生的文件（同样五个名字留在 job 本地），并把缓存目录创建失败降级为警告，而不是让绿色套件变红。
- self-hosted 的 Managed Agent Checkstyle leg 从套件安装到的 job 本地仓库解析 SDK。
- 发布构建的播种改为向 job 本地仓库内复制，而不是在其中再嵌套一个 `repository/`，并删除同样的记账文件。
- 工作流元测试钉住每个播种点与两处 prune 的五个排除名、写回子进程及其 fd 9 关闭、宿主侧删除、警告路径，以及 Checkstyle 的仓库。

## 为什么需要

把 Maven 移到池级锁之外，只有在 job 本地仓库与宿主缓存没有共同 inode 时才是安全的。Maven 解析器会原地重写记账文件，而套件会 `install` 两个固定发布坐标的内部构件：一旦以硬链接播种，二者都会让不持锁的运行改写同宿主上所有兄弟 job 都读取的状态。

对早先描述的更正：持锁范围的改动本身（“只有写回取锁”）已通过 #15128 和 #15254 落地并在 main 上。#15274 仍然开放，其中缓存和延后状态处理的改动与本 PR 有重叠。本 PR 是让该范围安全成立的缓存隔离部分，评审应以这一点为准，而不是 #15281 的锁等待。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

打开一个触及 managed-agent 路径的 PR 的 `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job。self-hosted step 应先出现 `cp -aln` 播种和三次 Maven 调用，之后才可能出现 `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock`；锁等待只应出现在缓存写回处，且写回会先删除内部坐标再复制。套件结束后在 job 本地仓库里 grep `maven-metadata-local.xml`，应当只剩本 job 产生的文件。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：播种出的 `maven-metadata-local.xml` 与 `qwencode-sdk` jar 与宿主缓存是同一 inode，不持锁的 `mvn install` 会改写宿主文件（inode 相同，SHA 与 mtime 都变化）。After：宿主文件字节与 mtime 完全不变，同时 job 本地副本仍被写入；写回不发布任何记账文件、也从不发布内部坐标；宿主缓存中遗留的内部目录被删除。UI 不适用。

### 测试环境

仅元测试：`scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`（129 通过）、`scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`（239 通过、1 跳过）、`scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js`（14 通过）。容器内没有 JDK 21 / Maven，真实 Java 套件交给 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：冷宿主要付一次播种成本；写回是尽力而为且上限 300 秒，与 MariaDB 通道一致。写回还会删除宿主缓存中遗留的内部坐标副本——这是有意为之，因为它们正是内部坐标 prune 要阻止继续发布的过期固定发布 jar。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实 ECS 池及其票据化锁队列；完整 JDK 21 Maven 套件；MySQL / MariaDB 集成通道；hosted leg。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

与 #15281 相关（持锁范围的改动已通过 #15128 和 #15254 落地；本 PR 补上更小持锁范围所依赖的缓存隔离缺口）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): materialize inert external workspaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an operator-only way to materialize an already registered external storage alias as a discoverable Workspace with an explicitly delegated owner. The operation creates only metadata and an idempotent receipt in one transaction. It does not allocate storage, start a worker, or enable Session execution.

An owner can discover the new Workspace, but its Session-creation and directory-selection capabilities remain unavailable. Replaying a completed request returns the original creation receipt without restoring revoked access, changing a renamed Workspace, or reactivating removed metadata.

## Why it's needed

#15512 needs a durable link between registered external storage and the Workspace a Session will eventually select. Registration alone creates storage records, not a Workspace or owner grant. This is a deliberately inert prerequisite: later execution admission, tools, recovery and exact-worker close must become usable together rather than allowing partially wired Sessions.

This increment is independent of #15654's provisioning prerequisite and does not copy its changes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On an isolated fresh catalog, register external storage using the loopback operator credential, then materialize its alias with an owner. Confirm the owner can discover it on the public and WebShell surfaces, an unrelated actor cannot, and neither Session creation nor directory selection is advertised. Requests without operator authorization must fail.

Replay the request and confirm its receipt is stable and rows are not duplicated. Change the owner or display name under the same key and confirm a conflict. Revoke access or rename/remove the Workspace, then replay: the original receipt returns, but current state must not be restored. Concurrent attempts must produce one Workspace, grant and completed receipt. A receipt-write failure must roll back the preceding Workspace and grant writes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The baseline has external registration but no materialization operation. The candidate was exercised through actual Spring HTTP and an isolated MySQL 8.4 instance on the designated Linux development machine: registration/materialization/replay succeeded, owner-only discovery remained non-executable, and empty public/WebShell Session creation was rejected before execution state was created. Raw SQL readback found no Sessions, Turns or Runtime bindings.

Prompted creation in the live Harness-disabled configuration was rejected at the deployment availability gate; this is not claimed as live EXTERNAL-specific prompt admission proof. Separate focused service tests exercise the storage-kind gate with Harness availability supplied. No browser screenshot or running Hosted worker is claimed for this inert slice.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ source review only; no heavy runtime execution |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ✅ focused Java/MySQL and real HTTP validation on development host |

### Environment (optional)

Remote JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.11, task-isolated dependency repository and MySQL 8.4.13 in a capped Podman container. Existing services and databases were preserved. The application ran from compiled production classes and cached dependencies, without test fixture classes.

Validation: 110 focused Java tests and both Checkstyle executions passed. The first nine-case MySQL run had eight passes and one test exception-wrapper mismatch; after a test-only correction, the affected rollback method passed on both H2 and MySQL. Original failed evidence is retained; these results are not presented as a second full nine-case run. The CLI inventory suite passed 204 tests after correcting its generated digest header; scoped formatting and the CLI dependency build/bundle passed. The full local review engine exited before model execution because its isolated operator-policy configuration could not be read; that gate is unverified. Independent source reviews found no remaining issue in this slice. This PR is **ready for review**; full CI and final acceptance remain pending.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the authenticated operator may delegate ownership to the specified actor. That field is a grant target, not proof of authenticated user identity or tenant membership. Existing loopback and bearer checks remain required; public authentication is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: full external Hosted execution, real worker/tool effects, available-Harness prompted Session flow, drain/ACK safety, recovery, shell/capture and full CI. This PR does not complete #15512.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the new receipt namespace extends the shared V1 catalog CHECK under the repository's pre-release fresh-catalog policy. A source revert is not a guarantee that an old binary can open the changed database catalog. No V2 migration or schema-version bump is introduced.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512. Related prerequisite: #15654. Neither this PR nor the provisioning prerequisite closes the full feature issue.

| Linux | ✅ 开发机聚焦 Java/MySQL 与真实 HTTP 验证 |

开发机 JDK 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.9.11、任务隔离依赖仓库和受资源限制的 MySQL 8.4.13 Podman 容器。现有服务和数据库未改动。应用使用编译的生产类和缓存依赖启动，不加载测试 fixture 类。

- 主要风险：经过授权的 operator 可向指定 actor 授予 owner。请求体字段是授权目标，不证明调用者身份或租户成员关系；原 loopback 和 bearer 限制必须满足，公开认证保持不变。

设计文档为上方链接的英中两份，保持同步。

## 关联问题

属于 #15512；相关前置为 #15654。本 PR 和 provisioning 前置都不关闭完整功能 issue。

## Scope note (updated 2026-10-29)

The opening paragraphs still describe the materialization step as a "deliberately inert prerequisite". That was true of the commit they were written for, and it is no longer true of this branch as a whole: subsequent commits here add the live `EXTERNAL_FILES` behaviour — the input-attachment gate in the session capability row, the external-files branch of `mayChangeContextShape`, and the receipt-backed `LOST` release in `WorkspaceRuntimeTransport.releaseRetired` (R2-1).

So, precisely: the **materialization operation** remains metadata-only, allocating no storage and starting no worker; the **capability gates and the close-path release in this same branch are not inert** and do change what a live Session is offered and how a stranded external binding is released.

Raised as R2-11 in review and corrected here rather than left standing, because a description that calls the change inert while the code enables the profile misleads the next reader.

prs.title: fix(cli): keep a long /btw answer readable in a bounded viewport
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The `/btw` side answer now renders inside its own scroll viewport instead of growing without limit in the bottom controls region. It takes at most half the terminal (less on short terminals), opens on the first line of the answer, and scrolls with the mouse wheel, Shift+Up/Down and PageUp/PageDown while it is open. When the answer overflows, a scrollbar stays painted on the right edge so the extra content is discoverable; short answers render exactly as before.

While the panel is open it owns those scroll inputs, and the conversation viewport yields them so a single keypress or wheel tick cannot scroll both surfaces. The input line and everything else stay usable, and the panel still closes with Space, Enter or Escape.

The screen-reader layout and the transcript replay of a past `/btw` item are unchanged and still render the whole answer, because neither has a viewport to scroll.

## Why it's needed

A long answer was unreachable. The panel had no height budget, so it grew with the markdown and pushed the composer (and the conversation) off screen. The interactive CLI paints the visible region itself by default, so there is no native terminal scrollback to fall back on: the rows below the screen were simply gone. Enlarging the window was the only workaround, and on Windows terminals that have no usable scrollback once the app owns the screen it was the difference between reading the answer and not reading it at all.

This is the scrolling half of #15949. The copy/selection half of that report is the documented mouse-tracking tradeoff (`ui.mouseTracking: false` restores native selection) and is deliberately not changed here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the interactive CLI in a normal-height terminal and ask `/btw` a side question whose answer is clearly taller than the panel, e.g. "list 40 short numbered lines".
2. Before the fix the panel expands past the bottom of the screen; the start of the answer is cut off and no key or wheel input brings it back.
3. After the fix the panel stops at roughly half the terminal, shows the first lines of the answer plus a scrollbar on the right, and PageDown / PageUp / Shift+Up / Shift+Down / wheel move through the answer. The composer stays visible and the conversation above keeps its own space.
4. Dismissing with Space / Enter / Escape still works, and a short `/btw` answer (one or two lines) looks the same as before.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Rendered with the same 60-column panel budget, answer = a paragraph plus seven bullets (frames from the component render harness, not tmux):

Before (no budget: the panel grows, colored rows are off-screen in a real terminal):

```
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ /btw q                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                  │
│ Here is a longer side answer that wraps across the panel.                                        │
│                                                                                                  │
│ Details                                                                                          │
│  - first bullet                                                                                  │
│  - second bullet                                                                                 │
│  - third bullet                                                                                  │
│  ...                                                                                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

After (bounded at half the terminal, scrollbar pinned, PageDown reaches the rest):

```
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ /btw q                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                  │
│ Here is a longer side answer that wraps across the panel.                                      █ │
│                                                                                                █ │
│ Details                                                                                        │ │
│  - first bullet                                                                                │ │
│                                                                                                  │
│ Press Space, Enter, or Escape to dismiss                                                         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests and component render harness. The layout change is platform-independent shared code, but I could not drive the Windows terminal or a Linux TTY here.

### Environment (optional)

`npm run typecheck`, `npx vitest run` for the touched suites (BtwMessage, VirtualizedList, ScrollableList, MainContent, DefaultAppLayout, ScreenReaderAppLayout, layoutUtils): 119 + 54 tests passing.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: while the panel is open it takes over wheel / PageUp / Shift+Up scrolling, so the conversation behind it does not scroll until the panel is dismissed. That keeps a single gesture from moving two surfaces; the panel is transient (Space / Enter / Escape). Also, a capped panel means a very tall answer is read through the viewport rather than all at once.
- Not validated / out of scope: the copy/select half of the report (intentional mouse-capture tradeoff, escape hatch already exists), and a real Windows CMD / PowerShell run.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The two new list options default to today's behavior; only the `/btw` panel passes the non-default values.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15949

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`/btw` 的旁问回答现在渲染在独立的滚动视口里，不再在底部控件区无限增高。它最多占终端的一半（终端很矮时更少），打开时停在回答的第一行，并支持鼠标滚轮、Shift+↑/↓ 和 PageUp/PageDown 滚动。回答溢出时右侧会常驻一条滚动条，让"下面还有内容"一眼可见；短回答的渲染与之前一致。

面板打开期间由它接管这些滚动输入，对话视口主动让出，避免一次按键或滚轮同时滚动两个区域。输入框和其他行为不受影响，Space / Enter / Escape 关闭面板照旧。

读屏布局和历史上 `/btw` 条目的回放不变，仍然渲染完整回答 —— 它们没有可滚动的视口。

## 为什么需要

长回答原本读不到。面板没有高度上限，会随 markdown 一起长高，把输入框和对话区顶出屏幕；而交互式 CLI 默认自己绘制可见区域，没有原生滚动回滚可依赖，超出屏幕的行就彻底不可见。只能靠放大窗口，Windows 终端在应用接管屏幕后没有可用回滚，等于完全看不到。

这是 #15949 的"滚动"部分。"复制/选中"部分是已记录在案的鼠标捕获取舍（`ui.mouseTracking: false` 可恢复原生选中），本次有意不改。

## 审阅验证方式

1. 在正常高度的终端运行交互式 CLI，用 `/btw` 问一个明显超过面板高度的问题，比如"列 40 条短编号行"。
2. 修复前面板会超出屏幕底部，回答开头被截断，任何按键或滚轮都找不回来。
3. 修复后面板停在约半个终端高，显示回答开头并在右侧常驻滚动条，PageDown / PageUp / Shift+↑ / Shift+↓ / 滚轮可在回答内移动；输入框始终可见，上方对话保留自己的空间。
4. Space / Enter / Escape 关闭照旧；一两行的短回答与之前表现相同。

证据：上面的 Before/After 是同一 60 列预算、同一段"段落 + 七条列表"回答在组件渲染夹具里的帧（不是 tmux 实拍）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：面板打开时接管滚轮 / PageUp / Shift+↑ 滚动，面板后的对话在关闭前不跟着滚；这是为了避免一次手势滚动两个界面，且面板是临时性的（Space / Enter / Escape）。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：报告中的"复制/选中"部分（既有的鼠标捕获取舍，已有开关）；Windows CMD / PowerShell 真机未跑。
- 破坏性变更：无。两个新增的列表选项默认保持现有行为，只有 `/btw` 面板传非默认值。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15949

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): reject LSP queries when no server is ready
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When no language server is ready, LSP code-navigation queries now fail with an explicit reason instead of returning an empty result. This covers go-to-definition, find-references, hover, document symbols, implementations, call-hierarchy preparation, code actions and workspace symbols. The reason names each relevant server and its state (for example `No LSP server is ready to provide definitions (test is in progress)`), the same message diagnostics queries already give.

The not-ready check diagnostics already used is generalized to take the operation name and is now shared by those eight queries. Diagnostics messages are unchanged word for word. As before, the check only applies when nothing is ready. If at least one server is ready, queries behave exactly as they do today.

## Why it's needed

This is the second finding in #13143. With a server still starting up, failed, or never started, a diagnostics query correctly reported that nothing could answer, while go-to-definition on the same state printed `No definitions found for main.ts:1:1.` The model reads that as a fact about the codebase ("this symbol has no definition") rather than "the language server was not up", and acts on false information. The LSP tool already turns a rejected query into a `LSP <operation> failed: <reason>` message for every one of these operations, so the rejection reaches the model.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With the only configured server in the `IN_PROGRESS` state, a `goToDefinition` call through the LSP tool now returns `LSP go-to-definition failed: No LSP server is ready to provide definitions (test is in progress)` instead of `No definitions found…`, and no request is sent to the server. A new test pins this tool-level behavior, mirroring the existing diagnostics "names a starting server as pending" case as the issue asks.
- A parameterized test runs each of the eight queries against that same not-ready state and expects the named rejection with no server request.
- Two existing integration tests asserted that workspace-symbol and code-action queries return `[]` when no server is configured. Those expectations were the bug, so the tests now expect `No LSP servers are configured or running`, matching the existing diagnostics test beside them.
- With the fix reverted, all 11 new or updated tests fail. With it applied, they pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This is an internal LSP service change with no UI rendering change. Test results: the core `src/lsp` and LSP tool suites pass 500/500, the CLI config tests pass 541/541, and `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck` and ESLint are clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only, Node 24.16.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: when no server is ready, callers of these eight service methods now get a rejection instead of an empty result. The only production consumer is the LSP tool, which catches the rejection on every one of these paths and reports it as text. The internal path that replays open documents keeps its empty-result behavior, since the lower-level ready-handle lookup it uses is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: incoming and outgoing call-hierarchy queries already reject (with the stale-item error) when their server is not ready, so they don't report a false clean result and are left unchanged. The first finding in #13143 (partial-success diagnostics dropping the failed server's name) needs a change to the result shape of the public client interface and is left for a separate PR. #12286 adds guards for the case where every request fails, at the tail of some of the same methods. It doesn't overlap with this change, but whichever merges second may need a trivial rebase.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for users. The public client interface signatures are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13143 (finding 2). Finding 1 remains open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当没有任何语言服务器就绪时，LSP 代码导航类查询现在会明确地失败并给出原因，而不再返回空结果。涉及的查询包括：跳转到定义、查找引用、悬停信息、文档符号、实现、调用层级准备、代码操作以及工作区符号。错误原因会列出每个相关服务器及其状态（例如 `No LSP server is ready to provide definitions (test is in progress)`），与诊断查询已有的提示一致。

诊断查询原有的"未就绪"检查被泛化为接收操作名称，并由上述八种查询共用。诊断相关的提示文字逐字保持不变。与之前一样，该检查只在没有任何服务器就绪时生效；只要至少有一个服务器就绪，查询行为与现在完全相同。

## 为什么需要

这是 #13143 中的第二项发现。当服务器仍在启动、启动失败或从未启动时，诊断查询会正确地报告没有服务器可以响应，而在同样状态下的跳转到定义却输出 `No definitions found for main.ts:1:1.`。模型会把这当作关于代码库的事实（"这个符号没有定义"），而不是"语言服务器尚未就绪"，从而基于错误信息行事。LSP 工具已经会把每一种此类操作被拒绝的查询转换为 `LSP <operation> failed: <reason>` 消息，因此拒绝原因能够传达给模型。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 当唯一配置的服务器处于 `IN_PROGRESS` 状态时，通过 LSP 工具调用 `goToDefinition` 现在返回 `LSP go-to-definition failed: No LSP server is ready to provide definitions (test is in progress)`，而不是 `No definitions found…`，并且不会向服务器发送任何请求。新增的测试固定了这一工具层面的行为，按 issue 的要求对应已有的诊断"将启动中的服务器标记为待定"用例。
- 一个参数化测试在同样的未就绪状态下逐一运行这八种查询，期望得到列出服务器的拒绝信息，且没有向服务器发送请求。
- 两个已有的集成测试断言：在未配置服务器时，工作区符号和代码操作查询返回 `[]`。这些断言本身就是缺陷所在，因此现在改为期望 `No LSP servers are configured or running`，与旁边已有的诊断测试一致。
- 回退修复后，全部 11 个新增或修改的测试都会失败；应用修复后全部通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用。这是 LSP 服务内部的改动，没有 UI 渲染变化。测试结果：core 的 `src/lsp` 与 LSP 工具测试套件 500/500 通过，CLI 配置测试 541/541 通过，`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 ESLint 均无问题。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试，Node 24.16。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在没有服务器就绪时，这八个服务方法的调用方现在会收到拒绝而不是空结果。唯一的生产环境调用方是 LSP 工具，它在所有这些路径上都会捕获拒绝并以文本形式报告。重放已打开文档的内部路径保持返回空结果的行为，因为它使用的底层就绪句柄查询没有改变。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：调用层级的传入调用与传出调用查询在服务器未就绪时本来就会拒绝（抛出过期条目错误），不会报告虚假的"干净"结果，因此保持不变。#13143 中的第一项发现（部分成功的诊断丢失失败服务器名称）需要修改公共客户端接口的返回结构，将在单独的 PR 中处理。#12286 在部分相同方法的末尾增加了"所有请求都失败"时的保护，与本改动不重叠，但后合并的一方可能需要做一次简单的 rebase。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对用户无影响，公共客户端接口签名不变。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #13143（第二项发现）的一部分，第一项发现仍保持打开。

</details>

Definition, reference, hover, symbol, implementation, call-hierarchy,
code-action and workspace-symbol queries returned an empty result when no
server was ready, so the lsp tool reported "No definitions found" while a
server was still starting or had failed. Route them through the same
not-ready rejection that diagnostics already use, naming the server and
its state.

Part of #13143.

prs.title: fix(cli): open the highlighted /mcp server when grouping reorders rows
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`/mcp` now selects servers by identity instead of by a display index. `ServerListStep` reports the selected server object, and `MCPManagementDialog` stores its name and resolves it against `servers` — the same name-based selection the OpenTUI dialog already uses.

## Why it's needed

Rows are grouped by source while `servers` stays in configured order. Top-tier servers (`--mcp-config`, ACP/IDE session, bundled Mem0) render under "User MCPs" but sit last in `servers`, so passing a row index made the dialog open a different server; Disable, Clear Authentication, Reconnect and Approve then applied to that server. Removing the index means the two orderings can no longer be confused.

Fixes #14651.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```console
cd packages/cli
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/ui/components/mcp
```

The current MCP suite contains 47 tests, including the two added regressions. [wenshao independently verified 47/47 at the current head](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14653#issuecomment-6528151819), with the two added regressions failing on base. My original local run below predates those additions and covered 45 tests. The mixed-source test fails on `9135d45910` because the callback receives the row index, and passes here because it receives `cliSrv`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: selecting `cliSrv` (row 2) called `onSelect(1)`; the dialog used `servers[1]` = `projectSrv`.
- After: the callback receives the `cliSrv` object; the dialog resolves it by name.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Original local macOS validation: `components/mcp` suite 45 passed (before the two later regressions), `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier on the changed files. No live TUI session was run.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only. No screen recording is attached because no live TUI session was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `ServerListStepProps.onSelect` changes signature; it is internal to the MCP dialog package (`ServerListStep`, `MCPManagementDialog`, tests).
- Not validated / out of scope: live TUI keypress flow and non-macOS platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none (internal type only).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14651

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`/mcp` 原来按行的显示位置传索引，但列表按来源分组后的顺序与配置里的 `servers` 数组顺序不同：`--mcp-config`、ACP/IDE 会话和内置 Mem0 在数组里排在项目服务器之后，显示时却归到 "User MCPs"。选中第二行可能打开另一台服务器。

本 PR 改为按身份选择：`ServerListStep` 把选中的 server 对象交给回调，`MCPManagementDialog` 保存 `selectedServerName` 并用 `servers.find(...)` 解析，与 OpenTUI 版已有的做法一致。新增的混合来源测试在 base 9135d45910 上失败（回调收到行号），最初本地 `components/mcp` 套件 45 个测试通过（早于后续新增的两个回归）；wenshao 在当前 head 独立验证了 47/47、两个新增回归在 base 失败，该 47 项不是我本次执行；`tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 均通过。未跑真实 TUI 会话和非 macOS 平台。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep the /mcp action cursor on its action when the list rebuilds
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The OpenTUI `/mcp` server-detail dialog now remembers the highlighted action by its key instead of its row index. When an action succeeds and the host rebuilds the list with fewer rows, the cursor stays on the same action, or falls back to the first row when that action is gone.

## Why it's needed

The cursor belongs to an action, but the host can rebuild the action list after an operation. Retaining only its old row index can select a different action when rows disappear. The ink dialog already tracks the active item by key and falls back to the first entry (`useSelectionList`); this restores parity for the opt-in OpenTUI renderer.

The component regression demonstrates the wrong-action risk using a disconnected server with cached tools. That fixture is broader than the normal product state: disconnected servers drop their tools. The reachable product transition is a four-row to three-row list, where Enter should use the first-row fallback instead of retaining the old index. [wenshao independently verified that real TUI transition](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14661#issuecomment-6527646220); I did not run that live session.

Fixes #14655.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```console
cd packages/cli
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialogs-mcp.test.tsx -t "keeps the cursor on its action"
```

On `91a7f9e481` this fails with `expected "spy" to not be called with ... "toggle-disable"` because the second Enter falls through to Disable. On this branch it passes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before (component fixture with cached tools): after Reconnect succeeds, the next Enter calls `onServerAction(server, 'toggle-disable')`.
- After: the cursor falls back to View tools, so Enter opens the tool list and `toggle-disable` is never called.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Original local macOS validation (before the later three regression additions): the dialog test file (19 passed), the related OpenTUI dialog suites (53 passed across `dialogs-mcp`, `opentui-dialog-mount`, `batch-cursor`), `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier on the changed files.

The current head has 22 dialog tests; [wenshao verified 22/22 at head and trial merge, with two failures against base production](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14661#issuecomment-6527646220). This is reviewer evidence, separate from my original local run.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only. No live TUI session was run, so no screen recording is attached.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the change only affects the opt-in OpenTUI renderer (`QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui`); the ink path is untouched.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live keypress session and non-macOS platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14655

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

OpenTUI 的 `/mcp` 服务器详情页原来用行号记录高亮动作，列表变化后可能选中另一动作。组件回归用“断开但仍有缓存工具”的夹具展示误触 Disable；真实产品断开时会清空工具，因此不能将该夹具原样描述为真实 TUI 故障。可达产品路径是四行变三行后应回落到第一行。wenshao 已独立验证该真实 TUI 路径；我未运行该会话。ink 版的 `useSelectionList` 已按 key 记录并回落。

本 PR 把详情页光标改成保存 `action.key`，渲染时再换算成行号；动作消失时回落到第一行。新增回归测试：base 上第二次 Enter 会调用 `toggle-disable`（19 个测试中 1 个失败），分支上 19 个全过；相关的 OpenTUI 对话框套件 53 个测试通过，`tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 均通过。未跑真实 TUI 会话和非 macOS 平台。

</details>

prs.title: feat(desktop): persist Web Shell catalogs across restarts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The desktop client now keeps the Web Shell's saved daemon connections and workspace-host catalog across restarts. Both catalogs live in the desktop shell's settings file and are read through a small allowlisted IPC surface gated to the runtime origin. The browser Web Shell keeps its existing storage behavior.

## Why it's needed

The desktop shell serves the Web Shell from a bundled daemon on an ephemeral loopback port. WebView2 scopes storage by origin, so the catalogs written by one launch were unreachable on the next and users had to re-add their connections every time. This is Part 1 of #14947; credential persistence is deliberately separate.

The live restart check also found that the workspace-host catalog would record the page's own ephemeral origin once persistence existed, adding one stale host per launch. This change skips the page origin **in the desktop shell**, where that origin really is ephemeral; the sidebar still adds it in-session. The browser keeps saving it, because there the saved entry is the local group's offline snapshot.

Hydration also re-pushes a `localStorage` mirror that differs from the native copy instead of deleting it: within one launch every change is mirrored while hydration clears the mirror, so a differing copy can only be newer than a native write that never landed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Launch the desktop shell from this branch and add a daemon connection under Settings → Connections.
2. Restart the app. It comes back on a new loopback port, and the saved connection is still listed; Settings → Connections shows it.
3. Click × next to the connection. It disappears from the list and from `desktop-state.json`.
4. Restart twice and confirm `qwen-workspace-hosts` does not grow a `127.0.0.1:<port>` entry per launch.

Expected: the connection catalog survives restarts; the workspace-host catalog contains remote hosts only. Before this change the connection list was empty after every restart.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: after a restart the saved list was empty because both catalogs lived in origin-scoped `localStorage`.

After: a Windows debug build from this branch, with an isolated app identifier, wrote a catalog, restarted, came back on a different port, and read the catalog back; Settings → Connections showed the saved host. The same run reproduced the per-launch workspace-host growth and then verified its fix. The unit and integration checks below pass.

An independent A/B run on macOS confirmed the same on head `8a220bc4d`: five launches on rotating ports, catalogs intact after each restart, base arm empty after the first one, and the browser arm still writing the page origin to `localStorage`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

The macOS row reflects what the author ran; the independent run above covers the restart flow on that platform, not the full PR scope.

### Environment

Local Tauri debug build with an isolated app identifier and profile; bundled runtime built from this branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the catalogs now live in `desktop-state.json`. The file is plaintext, so it must stay free of credentials; it stores addresses and workspace identities only.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux live restart checks. The full repository typecheck OOMs in `packages/cli` on this Windows machine; the `web-shell` package typecheck passes. Credential persistence, a stable shell origin, and an automated desktop E2E remain out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Browser behavior is unchanged. Migration reads only the current origin's `localStorage`; older launches cannot be recovered.

## Design docs

- [English](https://github.com/BigDaddy1337/qwen-code/blob/feat/desktop-shell-state/docs/design/2026-10-25-desktop-shell-state.md)
- [简体中文](https://github.com/BigDaddy1337/qwen-code/blob/feat/desktop-shell-state/docs/design/2026-10-25-desktop-shell-state.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

References #14947.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

桌面客户端现在会在重启后保留 Web Shell 的已保存 daemon 连接和工作区主机目录。两个目录都保存在桌面外壳的设置文件中，并通过一层小而带白名单、按运行时 origin 校验的 IPC 读取。浏览器 Web Shell 保持原有存储行为。

## 为什么需要

桌面外壳由内置 daemon 在临时回环端口上提供 Web Shell。WebView2 按 origin 隔离存储，因此一次启动写入的目录在下一次启动时无法读取，用户每次都要重新添加连接。这是 #14947 的第一部分；凭据持久化刻意分开处理。

实机重启检查还发现：一旦目录开始持久化，工作区主机目录会记录页面自身的临时 origin，每次启动都追加一个过期主机。本次改动在**桌面外壳中**跳过页面 origin——那里的 origin 确实是临时的；侧边栏仍会在会话内加入它。浏览器则继续保存它，因为在浏览器中该条目是本地分组的离线快照。

水合时，与原生副本不同的 `localStorage` 镜像会被回推而不是删除：一次启动内每次变更都会写镜像，而水合会清空镜像，因此不同的副本只可能比“从未真正落地”的原生写入更新。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 从本分支启动桌面外壳，在 Settings → Connections 中添加一个 daemon 连接。
2. 重启应用。应用会以新的回环端口回来，已保存连接仍在列表中；Settings → Connections 能看到它。
3. 点击连接旁的 ×。它会从列表和 `desktop-state.json` 中消失。
4. 连续重启两次，确认 `qwen-workspace-hosts` 不会每次启动都增加一个 `127.0.0.1:<port>` 条目。

预期：连接目录能跨重启存活；工作区主机目录只包含远程主机。改动前，每次重启后连接列表都是空的。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：重启后已保存列表为空，因为两个目录都存放在按 origin 隔离的 `localStorage` 中。

修改后：在 Windows 上使用本分支的 debug 构建和隔离的应用 identifier，写入目录、重启、以不同端口回来并读回目录；Settings → Connections 显示了已保存主机。同一次实跑先复现了每次启动累积工作区主机的问题，随后验证了修复。下面的单元与集成检查均通过。

一次独立的 macOS A/B 实跑在 head `8a220bc4d` 上确认了同样的结果：五次启动、端口轮换，每次重启后目录都完好；base 臂第一次重启后即为空；浏览器臂仍把页面 origin 写入 `localStorage`。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

macOS 一行反映的是作者本人的验证；上述独立实跑覆盖的是该平台的重启流程，而非本 PR 的全部范围。

### 环境

本地 Tauri debug 构建，使用隔离的应用 identifier 与配置目录；运行时由本分支构建。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：目录现在位于 `desktop-state.json`。该文件是明文，因此必须保持不含凭据；其中只存地址和工作区标识。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：Linux 的实机重启检查。在这台 Windows 机器上，完整仓库的 typecheck 会在 `packages/cli` 中 OOM；`web-shell` 包的 typecheck 通过。凭据持久化、稳定外壳 origin 与自动化的桌面端到端测试仍超出范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。浏览器行为不变。迁移只读取当前 origin 的 `localStorage`；更早的启动无法恢复。

## 设计文档

- [English](https://github.com/BigDaddy1337/qwen-code/blob/feat/desktop-shell-state/docs/design/2026-10-25-desktop-shell-state.md)
- [简体中文](https://github.com/BigDaddy1337/qwen-code/blob/feat/desktop-shell-state/docs/design/2026-10-25-desktop-shell-state.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

引用 #14947。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): avoid unsupported forced Anthropic tool selection
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Avoids forced tool selection on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1. Requests that previously required a tool use `auto` on those models and explicitly name the expected tools. Only schema-response requests offer JSON text as an alternative; ordinary tools are still instructed to call the tool. Supported and unknown models retain the existing request shape.

## Why it's needed

These models reject `tool_choice:any` with HTTP 400. JSON side queries use that selection mode, so permission classification, memory selection and other structured requests fail even while the main conversation works. This is documented in [Anthropic's tool-choice restrictions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/define-tools#forcing-tool-use) and reported in #15542.

The change stays on the Anthropic wire and uses the existing model-version parser. It does not change the OpenAI-compatible behavior tracked in #13919 or introduce a structured-output subsystem.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run a structured side query on an affected model. The outgoing Anthropic request should use `auto`, include the schema-tool instruction, and return the structured result from either tool arguments or JSON response text. Repeat on Haiku 5.5 or Opus 4.6: these must retain `any`. Dotted and provider-prefixed affected model IDs should select the same fallback. Normal AUTO requests and requests without tools should be unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

An independent loopback HTTP probe drives the real JSON client, Anthropic generator and Anthropic SDK. The fixture rejects forced tool selection for affected models according to the documented API contract; no generator or converter is mocked.

| Probe | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sonnet 5.5 / Opus 5.5 JSON query | Sends `any`, receives 400, query fails | Sends `auto`, structured result extracted |
| Haiku 5.5 / Opus 4.6 controls | Sends `any`, succeeds | Still sends `any`, succeeds |
| Expanded 8-model × 2 response-format matrix | Not used as baseline | 16/16 pass, covering tool arguments and JSON text |

501 related tests pass across the Anthropic provider/converter, JSON client and forked-agent consumers. Build, bundle, repository-wide typecheck and lint pass. Formatting and diff checks pass. Full `npm run preflight` was attempted: clean install/build, formatting, lint and typecheck passed, followed by 3,573 passing tests in the first four workspaces. The CLI suite then reported `read ECONNRESET` in the unchanged `multi-workspace-sessions.test.ts` case “validates the workspace session search query parameters”; I interrupted the remaining full run. That exact test passed in isolation on this head (1 passed, 177 skipped). Its cause is not established; I am not claiming a fully green preflight. The remaining full-suite tests and final serve-bundle check did not complete.

This is wire-level reproduction against a local service, not a live Claude API test or a measurement of model adherence. The globally installed CLI was also tried in an isolated local session, but that older binary only exercised the main conversation, not the side-query path. The current-source wire probe is the reproduction evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS arm64 | ✅ |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment

Node 26.7.0, pnpm 11.24.0, base `1dc74d58384ca1fe8c29730970f1f7c60d1e5265`. Tests use dummy credentials and local HTTP only. Provider unit tests ran with inherited Anthropic credential/base-URL overrides unset.

## Risk & Scope

- `auto` does not guarantee a tool call. Existing JSON consumers accept tool arguments or a JSON object in response text; the fallback instruction makes that expectation explicit.
- This does not globally enable strict schemas or alter schema validation. Live model adherence and token-budget behavior remain unmeasured.
- No dependency changes, permission changes, or migration required. The existing main-session AUTO path is unchanged.
- Prepared with local Grok Build, then independently reviewed and verified; compilation and scope corrections were applied before delivery.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15542.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动与原因

Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Fable 5.1 和 Mythos 5.1 不接受强制工具选择，会对 `tool_choice:any` 返回 400，导致权限分类、记忆选择等 JSON 辅助请求失败。本修复在 Anthropic 请求层对这些版本使用 `auto` 并明确提示应调用的工具。只有 schema-response 请求允许以 JSON 文本替代工具返回；普通动作工具仍要求调用工具。其他及未知模型保留原请求形状，不修改 #13919 涉及的 OpenAI 兼容路径。

## 如何验证

对受影响模型执行结构化辅助请求，确认实际请求使用 `auto`、包含 schema 工具指令，并能提取工具参数或 JSON 文本。Haiku 5.5、Opus 4.6 保留 `any`。点分版本及 provider 前缀使用同一版本判断。普通 AUTO 请求和无工具请求保持原行为。

## 验证证据

独立探针通过真实 JSON 客户端、Anthropic generator 和 Anthropic SDK 访问本地 HTTP 服务；服务根据官方文档拒绝受限模型的强制工具调用，没有 mock generator/converter。修复前 Sonnet/Opus 5.5 发出 `any` 并失败，修复后改为 `auto` 且结果提取成功。Haiku 5.5、Opus 4.6 对照保持成功。扩展的 8 模型 × 两种返回格式矩阵 16/16 通过。相关单测合计 501/501 通过，构建、打包、全仓类型检查、lint、格式与差异检查通过。已尝试完整 `preflight`：干净安装/构建、格式、lint、类型检查通过，前四个工作区 3,573 个测试通过；随后 CLI 中未修改的多工作区搜索参数用例报 `read ECONNRESET`，因此中止剩余全仓运行。同一用例在当前补丁版本单独重跑通过（1 通过、177 跳过）。失败根因尚未确立，不声称完整 preflight 全绿；剩余全仓测试和最后的 serve-bundle 检查未完成。

测试平台为 macOS arm64，Node 26.7.0、pnpm 11.24.0，基线为 `1dc74d58384ca1fe8c29730970f1f7c60d1e5265`。未在 Windows/Linux 本地验证。仅使用虚拟凭据与本地 HTTP，provider 单测清除了继承的 Anthropic 凭据/端点覆盖。全局旧 CLI 的隔离尝试只覆盖了主对话，未触发辅助请求，因此实际复现证据采用当前源码的线缆探针，而非线上模型实测。

## 风险与范围

`auto` 不保证一定调用工具；现有 JSON 消费者可以读取工具参数或 JSON 对象文本，本修复明确提示这一期望。没有全局开启 strict schema，不改变 schema 校验；真实模型服从率和 token 预算表现未测量。无依赖、权限或迁移变化，主会话现有 AUTO 路径不变。初始补丁由本机 Grok Build 生成，随后独立审查与验证并修正编译和范围问题。

修复 #15542。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): exempt non-TUI packages from the parity impact gate
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Completes the TUI impact classifier's unrelated-path exclusions in one pass. Besides the existing documentation, Java service and Companion-source exclusions, every package tree the parity and no-flicker gates can neither build nor execute is now exempt: Web Shell, the Chrome extension, mobile-mcp, qwen-live, external-context, external-context-mem0, test-failure-explorer, the desktop, live-host and mobile-shell trees that the pnpm workspace itself excludes, the Java, Python and Zed SDK trees that carry no workspace manifest, and the CUA driver tree. A PR touching only those trees now selects no lane, reports "Outside the TUI build/test closure" as its reason, and both named checks report skipped, instead of launching the parity job through the unmapped-source fallback. Mechanism mappings, the Companion source-only boundary, runner routing and the conservative fail-closed behavior are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#15930 changes two Web Shell completion files and still launched `TUI parity snapshots (ink vs opentui)`: the classifier introduced in #15383 and tiered in #15864 only exempts docs, the Java service and Companion source, so Web Shell fell into "Unmapped source or test change: component checks". The job then died in its prerequisite CLI build on a main-side break unrelated to the PR — exactly the unrelated-failure-blocks-unrelated-PR pattern the tiering work was meant to end, and it will repeat for every package outside the closure until each one is exempted individually.

This PR closes the whole set at once. The exclusion list was derived from an audit, not from the incident: workspace manifests were walked against the `--cli-only` build filter plus the root and integration-tests dependencies (with `linkWorkspacePackages` semantics), and the fixed parity/noflicker suite lists were checked for references. Web Shell is the one deliberate exception to pure closure membership — the `web-templates` transcript bundle builds it, but no TUI suite renders that bundle, and ci.yml owns Web Shell build and E2E health. cua-driver is excluded as well: its only path into the CLI closure is the node-repl runtime import, which the --cli-only filter never builds. Companion manifests, bundler settings and scripts stay outside the Companion exclusion, as the original design records.

Excluded manifests lose no unique coverage: a manifest-only change that breaks the shared frozen-lockfile install fails every workflow's install step, and an accompanying root lockfile change still selects full acceptance through the existing broad patterns.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the classifier contract suite: `npx vitest run scripts/tests/e2e-workflow.test.js --config scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts`. It pins each newly excluded tree with a single-file case (no lane selected), a rename case whose both ends sit in an excluded tree, and a Web Shell-only vs Web-Shell-plus-CLI mixed pair; removing any one prefix from the exclusion regex fails its pin. The pnpm-workspace case parses the workspace file and pins the exact set of its negations, so a new exclusion there fails until the classifier covers it.
- Confirm the gates still accept the workflow: `bash .github/scripts/check-workflow-size.sh` (growth stays within the 4096-byte allowance, no baseline bump), `node .github/scripts/check-ci-budget.mjs` (job/timeout shape unchanged), and `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs` (routing untouched).
- On a Web Shell-only PR after merge, expect `Check TUI impact` to succeed with "Outside the TUI build/test closure" as the reason and both named TUI checks to report skipped; on a mixed PR, expect the usual mechanism selection.

Local results: 162/162 classifier tests, 91/91 runner-routing tests, size and budget gates green, Prettier clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI selection change, no user-visible surface. Before: #15930's run 41095791903 launched the parity job for a two-file Web Shell diff. After: the same diff classifies with every lane false.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

The contract suite parses YAML and executes the embedded classifier in-process; it is platform-independent, and CI runs it on Linux.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — meta-tests and gate scripts only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: path-based selection can miss a newly introduced cross-module dependency from an excluded tree into the TUI surface. The design doc already records this class of risk; nightly full acceptance and maintainer-triggered full runs remain the mitigation, and adding a new shared mechanism still requires a mapping plus a contract test.
- Not validated / out of scope: live runner behavior of the skip path (first observable on the next eligible PR); the Companion non-source boundary is deliberately unchanged; the main-side `SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS` build break that reddened #15930 is handled by #15935, not here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Named checks keep reporting (as skipped) because the workflow still starts and the classifier emits the selection.

Design doc updated in both languages: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ci/tui-parity-exclude-non-tui-packages/docs/design/2026-10-24-tui-parity-ci-efficiency.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/ci/tui-parity-exclude-non-tui-packages/docs/design/2026-10-24-tui-parity-ci-efficiency.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

References #15930 (the incident), #15864 and #15383 (the tiering and classifier this completes). No auto-close.

prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and retention-only handling of an oversized direct text resource (the prompt is admitted, the resource reaches the model live, and the durable record drops it with `embeddedResourcesTruncated` set). Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and the oversized-resource retention-only drop. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1; package-level test scripts and bundled `dist/cli.js` sanity check. A live ACP daemon session was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: directly supplied embedded text resources add bounded user content to durable transcripts; the aggregate serialized replay budget is 256 KiB per prompt. Oversized direct text resources are admitted and delivered to the model live; only their durable retention is dropped, marked with `embeddedResourcesTruncated` — the prompt always runs. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.
- Not validated / out of scope: running-daemon JSONL and `session/load` readback after restart, browser refresh acceptance, persistence of inline blob resources, and recovery of resources absent from historical records. Downstream clients must render the new typed SDK field to display a card.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no record migration is required; old records remain readable. The new text-resource replay limit bounds durable retention only; it does not reject prompts or change their parameters.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12538.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将有大小上限的原始 ACP 嵌入式文本 `resource` 块与所属用户 Prompt 一同持久化，并在回放时恢复为带类型的用户消息块。Daemon UI SDK 将其与 `resource_link`、原生附件区分，并支持离线 transcript 投影。原生附件展开结果按输入位置识别，因此即使另一个直接资源与它使用相同 URI，也仍可独立回放。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 已能把嵌入式资源用作模型上下文，但刷新或重启后此前只恢复 Prompt 文字。客户端因此丢失原始上下文引用，尽管助手回复仍可见。本 PR 修复 #12538 的持久化与回放缺口；它不同于 #12088 的 `resource_link` 修复。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

依次发送包含文字和文本资源的 ACP Prompt、纯资源 Prompt、以及后续纯文字 Prompt。检查保存的用户记录与加载后的 transcript：每个资源都应作为带类型的用户消息块保留在原轮次，包含 URI、MIME 类型、文本、元数据、Prompt ID 和来源记录身份；不得迁移到后续轮次，也不得根据 URI 抓取内容。另需检查 rewind/有效分支回放、超过 256 KiB 的原生附件、与原生附件同 URI 的直接资源，以及超限直接文本资源的仅保留层处理（Prompt 被放行、资源实时送达模型，持久记录丢弃该资源并置 `embeddedResourcesTruncated`）。定向桥接、CLI、持久化和 SDK 测试覆盖这些场景。

### 前后证据

修复前：新增的录制与回放回归测试在旧源码上失败，类型化资源在回放后缺失。修复后：定向测试通过，包括纯资源、同 URI 并存和超限资源的仅保留层丢弃。本 PR 未声称完成运行中 Daemon 或浏览器录屏。

### 已测试系统

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint 与测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.1；包级测试脚本与打包后的 `dist/cli.js` 基础检查。未运行真实 ACP Daemon 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：直接提供的嵌入式文本资源会作为有界的用户内容进入持久 transcript；每个 Prompt 的序列化资源回放预算为 256 KiB。超限直接文本资源会被放行并实时送达模型；仅其持久保留被丢弃，并以 `embeddedResourcesTruncated` 标记——Prompt 始终执行。原生附件沿用独立存储路径；新 Daemon 请求按来源排除。缺少位置字段的旧元数据只排除 URI 唯一对应的块；歧义块会保留，也可能触及内联限额。
- 未验证／范围外：运行中 Daemon 的 JSONL 与重启后 `session/load` 回读、浏览器刷新验收、内联 blob 资源持久化，以及从未保存资源的旧记录恢复。下游客户端需要渲染新的类型化 SDK 字段才能显示卡片。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：无需记录迁移，旧记录继续可读。新的文本资源回放上限只约束持久保留，不拒绝 Prompt，也不改变其参数。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12538。

</details>

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): Simplify session creation and event streaming
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Public and WebShell Session streams now share one replay/live-delivery loop while retaining their distinct payloads and timestamp units. Workspace Session creation now accepts one typed command instead of nine progressive repository overloads, with all in-repository callers and fixtures migrated together. The change removes 278 net production lines across five production files and adds matching English and Chinese design documentation.

## Why it's needed

The duplicated stream loops require every permission, replay and termination fix to be maintained twice. The creation overload chain repeats default forwarding in both the contract and JDBC implementation and branches between nineteen- and twenty-argument calls. Consolidating these paths reduces maintenance work while preserving transaction order, admission decisions and wire behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Exercise Public and WebShell replay and live delivery. Confirm identical ordering and SSE IDs, Public timestamps in seconds, WebShell timestamps in milliseconds, termination after deletion or revoked read access, and a resynchronization frame without an SSE ID when the replay cursor has expired.
2. Create Sessions with the base defaults and with supported model, approval, plan, skill, extension and worktree selections. Confirm unsupported selections are still rejected, idempotent retries retain the original Workspace binding, and changing defaults does not alter a replay across JVMs.
3. Inject a failure after writes through the real Spring transaction proxy. Confirm rollback uses the dedicated Managed Agent datasource and never the host application's transaction manager.

Before rebasing onto `1ccf0d43f3`, local evidence covered 808 selected unit/H2 cases across 40 classes and five real MySQL cases, with no remaining failures, errors or skips in those reports; reactor Checkstyle and the root build/typecheck also passed. The rebase left all refactor source and test files unchanged. To verify the new upstream configuration-metadata build step, reactor compilation, Checkstyle and 52 selected API-contract, streaming, creation/worktree and transaction-proxy cases were rerun successfully after the rebase. Broader checks were not repeated; complete CI acceptance is pending. Design formatting/reference checks passed, and the design documents record the initial obsolete-interface assertion and Failsafe invocation failures, their corrections, and the applicable passing evidence.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal refactor with no intended UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14, Node 26.12.1 and pnpm 11.24.0. Java verification used an isolated Maven repository with the SDK built from matching source. The disposable MySQL 8.4.11 instance used `max_allowed_packet=134217728` and disabled binary logging; macOS native AIO differs from Linux CI. The database process and data directory were cleaned up.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: command migration must retain null/default semantics and the dedicated transaction boundary; shared streaming must retain permission-check timing, overflow reconciliation and terminal-event handling. Production changes are limited to the contract, its service caller, JDBC implementation and event streaming; the broad test-file diff migrates their existing consumers.
- Not validated / out of scope: full Java/SpotBugs, complete MySQL, Hosted/fault and cross-platform acceptance remain pending CI. Provisioners, runtime recovery state machines and digest helpers are outside this refactor. Local results are not production acceptance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the internal Java repository API is source- and binary-incompatible. Direct Java callers must wrap the former arguments in `WorkspaceSessionCommand`, implement the new single method where applicable, and rebuild. All repository callers are migrated. Public HTTP APIs, SDK request formats and the database schema do not change.

Design and acceptance criteria: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/simplify-managed-agent-sessions/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-agent-stream-and-creation-simplification.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/simplify-managed-agent-sessions/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-agent-stream-and-creation-simplification.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Public 与 WebShell 的 Session 事件流现在共用一个回放/实时投递循环，同时保留各自的消息格式和时间单位。Workspace Session 创建现在接收一个类型明确的命令，替代九个渐进式仓库重载，并同步迁移仓库内所有调用方和夹具。本次涉及五个生产文件，生产代码净减 278 行，并补充对应的中英文设计文档。

## 为什么需要

重复的事件流循环使每次权限、回放和终止逻辑修复都需要维护两遍。创建入口的重载链在契约和 JDBC 实现中重复转发默认值，并在十九参数与二十参数调用之间分支。合并这些路径可减少维护工作，同时保留事务顺序、准入决策和线上协议行为。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 验证 Public 与 WebShell 的回放和实时投递。确认事件顺序与 SSE ID 一致，Public 时间戳使用秒，WebShell 使用毫秒；删除或撤销读取权限后终止；回放游标过期时发送不含 SSE ID 的重新同步帧。
2. 使用基础默认值以及受支持的模型、审批、plan、技能、扩展和 worktree 选择创建 Session。确认仍会拒绝不支持的选择，幂等重试保留原 Workspace 绑定，修改默认值不会改变跨 JVM 重放结果。
3. 通过真实 Spring 事务代理，在写入后注入失败。确认回滚使用专用 Managed Agent 数据源，不会使用宿主应用的事务管理器。

Rebase 到 `1ccf0d43f3` 之前的本地证据覆盖 40 个测试类中的 808 个选定单元/H2 用例，以及五个真实 MySQL 用例；对应报告中没有遗留失败、错误或跳过，reactor Checkstyle 和根目录 build/typecheck 也通过。Rebase 后，本次重构的全部源码与测试文件保持不变。为验证上游新增的配置元数据构建步骤，rebase 后重新运行 reactor 编译、Checkstyle，以及 52 个选定 API 契约、事件流、创建/worktree 和事务代理用例，均通过。未重复运行更广的检查，完整 CI 验收仍待完成。设计文档格式与引用检查通过；设计文档记录了首次运行中的过时接口断言和 Failsafe 调用失败、对应修正，以及适用的通过证据。

### 证据（修改前后）

N/A — 内部重构，无预期 UI 变化。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :------: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、JDK 21.0.8、Maven 3.9.14、Node 26.12.1 和 pnpm 11.24.0。Java 验证使用隔离 Maven 仓库，并从匹配源码构建 SDK。临时 MySQL 8.4.11 实例使用 `max_allowed_packet=134217728` 并关闭 binary logging；macOS native AIO 与 Linux CI 不同。数据库进程和数据目录已清理。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：命令迁移必须保留 null/默认值语义和专用事务边界；共享事件流必须保留权限检查时机、溢出协调和终止事件处理。生产修改限于契约、调用它的服务、JDBC 实现和事件流；涉及较多测试文件的差异用于迁移现有调用方。
- 尚未验证或不在范围内：完整 Java/SpotBugs、全量 MySQL、Hosted/fault 及跨平台验收仍待 CI。Provisioner、运行时恢复状态机和摘要工具不在本次重构范围内。本地结果不代表生产验收。
- 不兼容变更与迁移说明：内部 Java 仓库 API 的源码和二进制不兼容。直接 Java 调用方须将原参数包装为 `WorkspaceSessionCommand`，适用的实现方须实现新的单一方法，并重新构建。仓库内调用方均已迁移。公开 HTTP API、SDK 请求格式和数据库 schema 不变。
