prs.title: fix(verify-pr): publish the newest round and correct two skill claims
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #15938, closing the Suggestions recorded after it merged. Two of them are in the sandboxed verification publisher and two are in the `/verify-pr` skill text.

- **Newest round wins.** The publisher picked the first round directory in sort order. Round directories are named `pr<n>-verify-<YYYYMMDD>-<HHMMSS>`, so that was the oldest. It now takes the last one: the newest round holding a `report.md`. A run with no report takes its count line from the newest round holding an `assertions.json`, and that search is now limited to the same depth as the report search.
- **The harness-fault rule says what CI actually does.** The skill claimed CI refuses a `findings` round whose failures name no `pr` cause. The checker only refuses that when `assertions.json` carries a `failures` ledger. Without a ledger it only warns, and the round still publishes as ❌ not passed. The rule now states both cases.
- **The headline rule is scoped to `findings`.** "The published headline follows the counts" read as a general rule. `blocked` deliberately stays not passed at any count, and the sentence now says so.

Test-only changes:

- the unused `VERDICT_TXT` fixture hook is removed;
- a new case covers a `verdict.txt` word outside the four;
- the vocabulary pin now also covers the trust switch, which is the third place the step spells the four words.

## Why it's needed

The ordering was pre-existing, but #15938 raised its cost. When an earlier complete round sits beside the newest one, the earlier round's report, counts and verdict headline the run. Under the new headline rule, an old zero-failure `findings` round publishes as "✅ passed with findings", while a newer round that recorded a PR failure is ignored. The post-merge verification round reproduced this, and switching to `sort | tail -1` fixes it.

The rewording of the harness-fault rule came from #15938's own review, and it overpromised. An agent that writes `findings` over a harness fault without a ledger still gets a ❌ on the PR. That outcome is exactly what the rule exists to prevent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the triage workflow meta-tests. The binding case now places an earlier, complete, green round (`report.md`, a zero-failure `assertions.json`, `verdict.txt` = `merge-ready`) beside the newest round, and covers these arms:
  - the newest round says `findings` with a PR-attributed failure: the comment shows its report and its counts and publishes ❌, with nothing from the earlier round;
  - the newest round holds only `report.md`: inconclusive, no assertion line, and the `verdict.txt` warning;
  - the newest round's `verdict.txt` holds an unknown word: inconclusive, the warning, and the word appears nowhere in the body;
  - a `report.md` in the round's `scratch/` subdirectory sorts past the round's own `report.md`, and must not stand in for it;
  - with no report at all, a timed-out run shows the newest round's own counts rather than the earlier round's or a nested file's.
- The vocabulary test pins the allowlist, the trust switch and the headline labels against the checker's four words.

### Evidence (Before & After)

```
✓ scripts/tests/verify-pr-check.test.js (27 tests)
✓ scripts/tests/serve-ab-workflow.test.js (23 tests | 1 skipped)
✓ scripts/tests/issue-triage-ownership-workflow.test.js (4 tests)
✓ scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js (239 tests | 1 skipped)
✓ scripts/tests/verify-capture.test.js (23 tests)
✓ scripts/tests/review-worktree-cleanup-workflow.test.js (23 tests | 11 skipped)
✓ scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js (194 tests | 1 skipped)
Test Files  7 passed (7)
     Tests  519 passed | 14 skipped (533)
```

Each new assertion was checked against a mutant of the change. Every mutant turned a test red:

```
T1 report taken from the oldest round       1 failed
T2 report search at any depth               1 failed
T3 reportless counts from the oldest round  1 failed
T4 reportless counts at any depth           1 failed
T5 unknown verdict word kept                1 failed
T6 trust switch drops a word                1 failed
T7 trust switch gains a fifth word          1 failed
T8 allowlist gains a fifth word             1 failed
```

The 18 real `verify-results` artifacts used in #15938 each hold a single round, so this change leaves all of them as they were. Replayed through this branch's publisher: 9 ✅ passed (merge-ready), 5 ✅ passed with findings, 4 ❌ not passed, none untrusted, the same as on `main`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

The publish job runs only on `ubuntu-latest`; macOS and Windows are covered by CI only.

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux worktree. The publish step was extracted from the workflow and executed with a stubbed `gh` and the real checker, exactly as the meta-tests do.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: when a run leaves several round directories, the newest one holding a `report.md` is published, even when an older one is complete and the newest is not trusted. That is intended. The newest report is the agent's last word, and an untrusted one falls back to the process outcome rather than to an older verdict. A newer directory with no `report.md` at all does not hide an older complete round.
- Not validated / out of scope: in CI the `.qwen` tree is base-pinned, so the skill wording takes effect only after merge. Evidence images are still collected from every round directory, which is unchanged. The tmux lane's own report search is separate and untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The workflow grows by 355 bytes and stays within the size baseline's allowance, so the baseline is not bumped.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15938.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这是 #15938 的后续，收掉它合入后记录下来的 Suggestion：两条在沙箱验证的发布端，两条在 `/verify-pr` skill 的文字里。

- **取最新一轮。** 发布端原来按排序取第一个轮次目录。轮次目录的命名是 `pr<n>-verify-<YYYYMMDD>-<HHMMSS>`，所以排第一的是最旧的一轮。现在改为取最后一个，即带 `report.md` 的最新一轮。没有报告的运行，计数行从带 `assertions.json` 的最新一轮读取，这次搜索的深度也限定成和报告搜索一样。
- **harness 故障规则如实描述 CI 的行为。** skill 原来说，如果 `findings` 轮次的失败都没有归因到 `pr`，CI 会拒绝。实际上校验脚本只在 `assertions.json` 带 `failures` 归因账本时才拒绝；没有账本时只给警告，这一轮仍会发布为 ❌ 不通过。规则现在把两种情况都写清楚了。
- **标题规则限定在 `findings`。** "发布的标题跟随计数"读起来像一条通用规则，但 `blocked` 是有意在任何计数下都显示不通过的，这句话现在写明了这一点。

只涉及测试的改动：

- 删掉没有调用方的 `VERDICT_TXT` 测试钩子；
- 新增一个用例，覆盖 `verdict.txt` 里写的不是四个判定词之一的情况；
- 判定词表的钉扎测试现在也覆盖信任分支。信任分支是这个步骤第三处逐一写出这四个词的地方。

## 为什么需要

排序问题以前就有，但 #15938 放大了它的影响。当一个更早的完整轮次和最新轮次并存时，发布出来的标题用的是早期轮次的报告、计数和判定。按新的标题规则，旧的 0 失败 `findings` 轮次会发布为"✅ 通过（有发现）"，而记录了 PR 失败的较新轮次被忽略。合入后的验证轮复现了这个问题，改成 `sort | tail -1` 后即修复。

harness 故障规则的那次改写来自 #15938 自己的评审，但说过头了。agent 在没有账本的情况下，把 harness 故障写成 `findings`，PR 仍会被标 ❌，而这正是这条规则要避免的结果。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 运行 triage 工作流的元测试。绑定用例现在在最新轮次旁边放了一个更早的、完整且全绿的轮次（`report.md`、0 失败的 `assertions.json`、写着 `merge-ready` 的 `verdict.txt`），并覆盖以下分支：
  - 最新轮次写着 `findings` 且带 PR 归因失败：评论显示它的报告和计数，发布 ❌，不出现早期轮次的任何内容；
  - 最新轮次只有 `report.md`：发布为无法判定，没有断言行，并有 `verdict.txt` 警告；
  - 最新轮次的 `verdict.txt` 写着未知的词：发布为无法判定，有警告，正文里不出现这个词；
  - 轮次 `scratch/` 子目录下的 `report.md` 排序在本轮自己的 `report.md` 之后，不能顶替它；
  - 完全没有报告时，超时运行显示的是最新轮次自己的计数，而不是早期轮次或嵌套文件里的计数。
- 判定词表测试把白名单、信任分支和标题标签三处都与校验脚本的四个词对齐。

### 证据（前后对比）

测试结果与 8 个变异体的结果见上方英文部分：每个变异体都让测试变红。#15938 用过的 18 份真实 `verify-results` 产物都只有一个轮次目录，所以本改动对它们都没有影响。用本分支的发布端回放：9 份 ✅ 通过（可合入）、5 份 ✅ 通过（有发现）、4 份 ❌ 不通过，没有不被采信的，与 `main` 相同。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

发布 job 只在 `ubuntu-latest` 上运行；macOS 和 Windows 仅由 CI 覆盖。

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux worktree。发布步骤从工作流中提取出来，用桩化的 `gh` 和真实校验脚本执行，与元测试的做法相同。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：一次运行留下多个轮次目录时，发布的是最新的、带 `report.md` 的那一轮，即使更早的轮次是完整的、而最新一轮未被采信。这是有意的：最新的报告是 agent 的最终结论，未被采信时回退到进程结果，而不是回退到更早的判定。完全没有 `report.md` 的较新目录，不会遮住更早的完整轮次。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：CI 中 `.qwen` 目录固定为 base 版本，所以 skill 措辞要合入后才生效。证据图片仍从所有轮次目录收集，这一点没有改变。tmux 通道自己的报告搜索是独立的，本 PR 没有改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。工作流增加 355 字节，仍在体积基线的额度内，所以没有上调基线。

## 关联 Issue

#15938 的后续。

</details>

prs.title: docs(autofix-pr): design scheduled in-place rounds that ask before editing
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a design proposal (documentation only, no implementation) for the next step of the `/autofix-pr --in-place` co-driving mode that merged in #15929: rounds that fire on a schedule like the worktree mode, but ask the user before the fix agent edits the checkout. A scheduled in-place round becomes a proposal — it runs the read-only/safe prefix (gate, sync of a clean checkout, snapshot), reports what it found, and waits for an explicit "Fix it" answer before any edit. Both the English and Chinese versions are included and kept in sync.

## Why it's needed

The merged in-place mode is once-shaped: every round is a manual invocation, which is safe (a person is present each round) but asks the user to remember to run a round whenever CI fails or a trusted reviewer comments. The worktree mode already runs rounds on a schedule, but its rounds never ask and its lifecycle is destructive-by-isolation — none of which is safe in the user's own checkout, where a second writer may be editing. This design is the follow-up the v1 design explicitly left open (its open question 1): combine scheduled fires with a per-round approval so the convenience of a watch never costs the user's "nothing is edited without me deciding" guarantee.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

This is a design document pair, not code. Confirm that both language versions exist under `docs/design/`, that their reciprocal links resolve, and that they cover the same sections, decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and open questions. Key decisions to scrutinize: a scheduled round is a proposal, not an autonomous round (no edit without a per-round "Fix it"); two-layer consent (standing schedule consent plus per-round approval, neither skippable by `--yes`, no unattended option); the gate cursor advances only when events are addressed, not when they are proposed, so a declined round re-proposes instead of losing events; an unanswered proposal is a decline (no edit, events pending); a safe fast-forward of a clean checkout still runs, only editing asks. The principal open question is the bounded-wait proposal mechanism for an away user, which needs a daemon-scheduler investigation before implementation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Formatting and link checks only: `prettier --experimental-cli --check` and the bare CLI both clean on both files; reciprocal and referenced design links verified to resolve.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a declined round re-proposes the same events every interval (no snooze yet); the bounded-wait/notification mechanism for an away user is unresolved and gated on a daemon-scheduler investigation.
- Not validated / out of scope: no implementation, no tests; worktree mode is untouched; macOS/Windows not exercised (docs only).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — proposal only.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-31-autofix-pr-in-place-scheduled-ask.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-31-autofix-pr-in-place-scheduled-ask.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

References #15929 (the merged `--in-place` co-driving mode whose open question 1 this designs).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

新增一份设计提案（仅文档，不含实现），作为已随 #15929 合入的 `/autofix-pr --in-place` 共驾模式的下一步：轮次像 worktree 模式那样定时触发，但在 fix agent 编辑检出前先问用户。定时 in-place 轮次成为一个提案——它跑只读/安全的前缀（gate、干净检出的 sync、snapshot），报告发现了什么，并等待显式的「Fix it」回答后才做任何编辑。英文与中文双版同在并保持同步。

## 为什么需要

已合入的 in-place 模式是 once 形态：每轮都是手动调用，这安全（每轮都有人在场），但要求用户自己记得在 CI 失败或有可信评审者评论时跑一轮。worktree 模式本就有定时轮次，但其轮次从不提问、生命周期靠隔离而破坏性安全——这些在用户自己的检出里都不安全，那里可能有第二个写者在编辑。本设计正是 v1 设计明确留下的后续（其开放问题 1）：把定时触发与逐轮批准结合起来，让 watch 的便利绝不以牺牲用户「没有我的裁决就什么都不编辑」的保证为代价。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

这是一对设计文档，不是代码。确认两个语言版本都在 `docs/design/` 下、互链可解析、且覆盖相同的章节、决策、约束、验收标准与开放问题。需重点审视的决策：定时轮次是提案而非自主轮次（没有逐轮「Fix it」就不编辑）；两层同意（常设定时同意加逐轮批准，均不可被 --yes 跳过、无无人值守选项）；gate cursor 只在事件被处理时推进、不在提案时推进，于是被拒绝的轮次重新提案而不丢事件；无人应答的提案即拒绝（不编辑、事件待定）；干净检出的安全 fast-forward 照跑，只有编辑才问。主要开放问题是用户离开时的有界等待提案机制，实现前需一次 daemon 调度器调查。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——仅文档。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | N/A |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ |

### 环境

仅格式与链接检查：两个文件的 `prettier --experimental-cli --check` 与裸 CLI 均干净；互链与引用的设计链接均验证可解析。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：被拒绝的轮次每个间隔重新提案同一批事件（暂无 snooze）；用户离开时的有界等待/通知机制未定，依赖一次 daemon 调度器调查。
- 未验证/范围外：无实现、无测试；worktree 模式不受影响；macOS/Windows 未跑（仅文档）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无——仅提案。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-31-autofix-pr-in-place-scheduled-ask.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-31-autofix-pr-in-place-scheduled-ask.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

引用 #15929（已合入的 `--in-place` 共驾模式，本设计是其开放问题 1）。

prs.title: fix(core): reduce or refuse a compression request that cannot fit its window
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Compression no longer sends a summarization request that cannot leave room for the summary, and it recovers once when the provider rejects one for context length.

Before the cold compaction request goes out, it must leave the summary at least 4,096 output tokens, or a quarter of the window on windows under 16K, which self-hosted deployments do run. When it would not, the request is reduced first: every text part (tool results, tool-call arguments, assistant text and the user's messages) is cut to 4,000 characters, reusing the existing payload-overflow cap. No turn is dropped, so every tool call keeps its result. A wrapped system reminder longer than the cap is cut the same way and its closing tag added back, so its tags stay paired. If even the reduced request cannot leave the minimum, compression stops locally with a new "input too large" status instead of sending a request that is bound to fail. The CLI then shows "Could not compress chat history because it is too large for the context window.", translated into every shipped locale.

When the provider still rejects the compaction request for context length, compression retries exactly once, sized from the rejection itself. This happens because the local char/4 estimate runs low, notably for dense CJK text.
- If the rejection names a context window smaller than the configured one, the retry is sized for that window. A self-hosted server can run a smaller window than the model's own, and the rejection is the first place it shows. A limit the wording leaves untyped ("N tokens > M") is used the same way once the prompt's own count is past it.
- If the rejection states the prompt's own size and that prompt leaves the summary its reserve (a quarter of the window, up to 20,000 tokens), the same request is sent again with `max_tokens` lowered to the room that size leaves.
- Otherwise the reduced request is sent, asking for the reserve, when its estimate dropped by the overflow: the prompt's size + the reserve + 1,024 − the window, or the overflow past an input limit the rejection states. char/4 usually under-counts, so each estimated token removed takes at least one real token with it, whatever mix of dense CJK and sparse ASCII remains. When it dropped less, its output budget is sized by the rejected prompt's average density.
- Without a usable count, the reduced request is sent when it is smaller than the rejected one.
- If no retry fits, it is not sent and compression stops with the input-too-large status. A second rejection for context length gets the same status; any other error fails as it does today.

The prompt's own size is read only from wordings that state it apart from the output budget: OpenAI's "resulted in" and its breakdown, OpenRouter's breakdown, Anthropic, vLLM, Gemini's older wording, llama.cpp and SGLang. A bare "you requested N tokens" also counts the output and is taken as an upper bound, and a count that cannot describe the rejected request is ignored. The figure the reactive path already reads is unchanged. A server can also stop the output where its window ends instead of rejecting the request (llama.cpp's server does), so the reported output count can stay below the budget even when the summary was cut off. A summary that opens its `<state_snapshot>` but never closes it is therefore dropped as truncated when the reported prompt and output fill the window the request was sized for. Without that sign it is kept as today, since a model can also just leave the tag unclosed. A summary without the tags is unaffected.

After a reduction, the post-compression token count comes from the visible-history estimate rather than the provider's usage numbers, because the reduced request no longer reflects the whole history.

A conversation that already fits is sent unchanged, as the same single request as today.

This is the first half of #14953, split out so each part can be reviewed on its own. #14953 will be rebased on this and then only keeps the user's messages whole in a reduced request, condensing older turns to them when truncation is not enough.

## Why it's needed

The sessions that most need compressing are the ones whose compression request is most likely to overflow (#9455). Today the cold path clamps the output budget to whatever room the estimate leaves, but floors it at 1. Once the estimate fills the window, the request still goes out with `max_tokens: 1`, and the provider rejects it or returns a one-token fragment. Automatic, reactive and manual `/compress` compaction then fail the same way the main request did, and the session cannot recover.

Two earlier attempts closed unmerged.
- #9541 replaced the char/4 estimate with a byte-weighted one. On Chinese sessions that over-counted by about 2× and refused compression from roughly half the window.
- #13072 rebuilt the same approach as a larger rewrite (about +2,200 lines), and its author closed it.

This PR keeps the char/4 estimate. Because that estimate under-counts, a local refusal only happens when the request genuinely cannot fit. The PR handles the under-count with one retry sized from the rejection's own numbers, not from a calibration carried over from earlier turns. The production change is about 500 added lines.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use an OpenAI-compatible provider, or a local mock, that rejects any request whose prompt plus `max_tokens` exceeds its window. Set a small context window, and fill the session with a few large file reads.

- **History larger than the window.** Run `/compress`. Before: the compression request goes out with `max_tokens: 1` and returns 400. After: the large tool outputs are truncated, the request carries a real output budget, and compression succeeds.
- **History too large even after truncation** (for example, a window of about 2,000 tokens). Run `/compress`. After: no compression request reaches the provider, and the CLI shows the new "too large for the context window" message instead of an API error.
- **Provider counts more than the local estimate** (for example, a Chinese session on a Qwen tokenizer). After: the first compression request is rejected for context length, exactly one smaller retry is sent, and it succeeds. A third request is never sent.
- **Server window smaller than the configured one** (for example, vLLM with `--max-model-len 16384` while the CLI assumes a larger window). After: the first compression request is rejected, and the one retry, sized for the window the rejection names, fits it.
- **A session that fits.** After: the compression request is identical to what main sends today.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Real provider**, OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b` pinned to its 262,144-token endpoints. Before is the bundle of the main commit this branch is based on. Each scenario's session was built once and snapshotted, so both CLIs compress byte-identical histories; the setup and per-request numbers are in the E2E report comment.

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| zh94: `/compress` near 94% of the window | 400; the follow-up is rejected too, and the session cannot continue | 400, then one retry with 4 tool outputs and the skill-list reminder truncated (12,530 prompt tokens, `max_tokens` 20,000) → compressed; the recall question names the task, both added requirements and every file read |
| autozh: a 100K-token read overflows the next main request | main 400 → reactive compression 400 → the turn fails | main 400 → reactive compression 400 → one retry → compressed → the main request is resent and the turn completes; recall correct |
| autoen: a 150K-token read triggers hard-tier compaction | 400, then the main request with `max_tokens: 1` 400; the turn fails | 400, then one retry → compressed; recall correct. The following main requests still go out with `max_tokens: 1` (#15486, also on main) |
| zh56 (control): `/compress` at about 56% of the window | compressed | the same request, byte for byte; compressed |
| win32k: window configured at 32K, served at 262K | sent with `max_tokens: 1`: "the compression summary was empty", and the next turn is stopped | reduced before sending (5,980 prompt tokens, `max_tokens` 20,000) → compressed; recall correct |
| win4k: window configured at 4K | sent with `max_tokens: 1`: "the compression summary was empty" | nothing sent: "too large for the context window" |
| win1m: window configured at 1M, served at 262K | 400; the session cannot continue | 400, then one retry → compressed; recall correct |

The new logic has 50 new unit tests. They run against a mock backend that enforces the window, and an input limit where a test sets one, and can count above the local estimate; they also cover the CLI status text. A 26-mutant sweep over the new logic killed every mutant: the admission reduction, local refusal, the quarter-window minimum, the reported window, the untyped limit, the window held to the configured one, the cut grown for a sparse count, the output-only resend, both count sanity checks, the requested total taken whole and not reduced by the budget sent, density sizing, the second rejection's status, the must-be-smaller check, both accounting flags, the unclosed-snapshot check, the filled window it requires, the provider-reported output count it needs, and the window that is measured against, the input-limit term, the retry's minimum, the should-have-fit fallback, and a long reminder cut like plain text or replaced whole instead of cut and closed again.

Build, typecheck, lint and formatting pass. The core services and utils suites and the CLI i18n, OpenTUI, message and UI utility suites ran 14,089 tests: 14,056 passed, 33 were skipped and none failed.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

The CLI was built locally and run from its dist output with an isolated HOME, against OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b` pinned to its 262,144-token endpoints through a logging proxy. Before is the bundle of the main commit this branch is based on.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - A reduced request cuts the user's messages to 4,000 characters like tool output, keeping their start, so the summary can miss the end of a long request. Only sessions that could not be compressed at all before reach this. #14953 keeps them whole.
  - The reduction only cuts parts longer than 4,000 characters. A session made of many shorter messages does not get smaller, and is refused with the new status rather than compressed; before this change it failed with an API error.
  - After a reduced compression of a CJK session, the reported post-compression count is too high. It errs on the safe side and can only make the next compaction come earlier.
  - On windows under 16K a reduced request leaves the summary a quarter of the window, which a long summary may not fit. It is then dropped as truncated, and the history is kept.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - vLLM's "`max_tokens` cannot be greater than" rejection is not treated as a context overflow, because classifying it would change the main chat path too.
  - A server that drops messages from the front instead of rejecting (Ollama's default) sends no rejection to retry from.
  - Windows and Linux were not tested locally.
  - The cache-sharing compression request is not covered; when it fails, compression falls back to the cold path changed here.
  - Compacting with the previous model before a switch to a smaller window is not covered.
  - Giving up after a second rejection is covered by unit tests only.
  - A server that stops the output at a window smaller than the one the request was sized for, or a transport output cap below the budget, can still let a summary cut mid-snapshot through, as it does today.
  - Two problems found during E2E also happen on main and are filed separately: #15486 (after an automatic compaction the next request counts the pending tool result twice and can go out with `max_tokens: 1`) and #15487 (restoring recent files after a compaction can overflow a small window again).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. One compression status value is appended to the end of the status enum, and existing values are unchanged. It counts as a failure for the failure breaker, so code that switches over the status sees one new value.

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/9455-compression-retry/docs/design/2026-10-19-compression-request-admission.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/9455-compression-retry/docs/design/2026-10-19-compression-request-admission.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #9455

Related:
- #14953: the second half, which keeps the user's messages whole in a reduced request.
- #9541 and #13072: the earlier attempts.
- #7960: the output-budget clamp this builds on.
- #14098 and #14099: they let reactive compaction recognize vLLM and SGLang overflow errors, which complements this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

压缩不再发送无法给摘要留出空间的请求；provider 以上下文长度为由拒绝时，会恢复一次。

冷路径压缩请求发出之前，必须给摘要留出至少 4,096 个输出 token；窗口小于 16K 时（自建部署确实会用这么小的窗口），取窗口的四分之一。留不出时先缩减请求：每个文本片段（工具结果、工具调用参数、助手文本和用户消息）都截到 4,000 字，复用现有的载荷过大上限。不丢掉任何轮次，所以每个工具调用都保留它的结果。超过上限的系统提醒同样截短，再补回结束标签，首尾标签保持成对。缩减后仍留不出下限时，压缩在本地以新的"input too large"状态停止，而不是发出注定失败的请求。CLI 会显示 "Could not compress chat history because it is too large for the context window."，并已翻译成所有内置语言。

provider 仍以上下文长度为由拒绝压缩请求时，压缩只重试一次，大小由这次拒绝本身决定。会出现这种情况，是因为本地的 char/4 估算偏低，高密度中文尤其明显。
- 拒绝信息给出的上下文窗口比配置的小时，重试按这个窗口来算。自建服务的窗口可能比模型本身的小，而拒绝信息是它第一次出现的地方。没说明上限类型的写法（"N tokens > M"），只要报错给出的输入大小已经超过这个上限，也同样按它来算。
- 拒绝信息给出了输入本身的大小，且这个输入给摘要留下了预留空间（窗口的四分之一，最多 20,000 token）时，原样重发同一个请求，只把 `max_tokens` 降到这个大小留下的空间。
- 否则，缩减后的请求的估算减少了一个超出量时，就按预留空间要输出、发送这个请求。超出量是输入大小 + 预留 + 1,024 − 窗口，或者拒绝信息写明的输入上限之上的部分。char/4 通常偏低，所以每删掉一个估算 token，真实至少减少一个 token，无论剩下的中文和英文疏密如何。减少得不够时，输出预算按被拒请求的平均密度来定。
- 没有可用的数字时，缩减后的请求比被拒的小，就发送它。
- 放不下任何重试时不发送，压缩以 input-too-large 状态停止。第二次因为上下文长度被拒也是这个状态；其他错误仍像今天一样失败。

输入本身的大小只从把它和输出预算分开写的报错里读取：OpenAI 的 "resulted in" 及其分项、OpenRouter 的分项、Anthropic、vLLM、Gemini 的旧写法、llama.cpp 和 SGLang。单独的 "you requested N tokens" 还包含输出，会被当作上界；不可能描述被拒请求的数字会被忽略。被动压缩路径原来读取的那个数不变。服务端也可能不拒绝请求，而是在窗口用完处停止输出（llama.cpp 的服务端就是这样），所以即使摘要被截断，报告的输出数也可能低于预算。因此，打开了 `<state_snapshot>` 却没有闭合、且报告的输入加输出撑满了请求所按窗口的摘要，按截断丢弃。没有这个迹象时和今天一样保留，因为模型也可能只是漏写了闭合标签。不带标签的摘要不受影响。

缩减之后，压缩后的 token 数改用可见历史的估算，而不是 provider 返回的用量，因为缩减后的请求已不能代表整段历史。

本来就放得下的对话原样发送，和今天一样只发一个请求。

这是 #14953 的前一半，单独拆出来，方便分别审阅。#14953 会基于这个 PR 重新 rebase，之后只负责在缩减后的请求里完整保留用户消息，并在截短不够时把较早的轮次压成用户原话。

## 为什么需要

最需要压缩的会话，恰恰是压缩请求最容易超长的会话（#9455）。现在冷路径会把输出预算夹紧到估算剩下的空间，但下限是 1。估算一旦占满窗口，请求仍会以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出，provider 要么拒绝，要么只返回 1 个 token 的片段。于是自动、响应式和手动 `/compress` 压缩都会和主请求以同样的方式失败，会话无法恢复。

之前有两次尝试都没有合入。
- #9541 把 char/4 估算换成按字节加权的估算，中文会话被高估约 2 倍，从窗口约一半起就拒绝压缩。
- #13072 用更大的重写（约 +2,200 行）实现了同样的思路，作者自己关闭了它。

这个 PR 保留 char/4 估算。因为它偏低，只有请求确实放不下时才会在本地拒绝。估算偏低的问题由一次按拒绝信息自带数字确定大小的重试来处理，而不是沿用之前轮次的校准值。生产代码约新增 500 行。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

使用一个 OpenAI 兼容的 provider 或本地 mock，让它拒绝输入加 `max_tokens` 超过窗口的请求。设置一个较小的上下文窗口，并用几次大文件读取填满会话。

- **历史比窗口大。** 运行 `/compress`。修改前：压缩请求以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出，返回 400。修改后：大的工具输出被截短，请求带着真实的输出预算，压缩成功。
- **截短后仍然放不下**（例如约 2,000 token 的窗口）。运行 `/compress`。修改后：没有任何压缩请求发到 provider，CLI 显示新的"too large for the context window"提示，而不是 API 错误。
- **provider 算出的数比本地估算多**（例如用 Qwen 分词器的中文会话）。修改后：第一次压缩请求因上下文长度被拒，只发出一次更小的重试并成功，不会发出第三次请求。
- **服务端窗口比配置的小**（例如 vLLM 设置 `--max-model-len 16384`，而 CLI 假设的窗口更大）。修改后：第一次压缩请求被拒，按拒绝信息给出的窗口确定大小的那一次重试放得下。
- **放得下的会话。** 修改后：压缩请求和 main 今天发出的完全相同。

### 证据（修改前后对比）

**真实 provider**：OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`，固定使用其 262,144 token 窗口的服务端点。修改前是本分支所基于的 main 提交的构建产物。每个场景的会话只构建一次并打快照，两个 CLI 压缩的是完全相同的历史；环境和每个请求的数字见 E2E 报告评论。

| 场景 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| zh94：会话接近窗口 94% 时 `/compress` | 400；后续提问也被拒，会话无法继续 | 400，然后一次重试（4 段工具输出和技能列表提醒被截短，12,530 个输入 token，`max_tokens` 20,000）→ 压缩成功；回忆提问答出了任务、两条补充要求和所有读过的文件 |
| autozh：读取 100K token 后下一个主请求超长 | 主请求 400 → 被动压缩 400 → 本轮失败 | 主请求 400 → 被动压缩 400 → 一次重试 → 压缩成功 → 主请求重发，本轮完成；回忆正确 |
| autoen：读取 150K token 触发硬阈值压缩 | 400，随后以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出的主请求 400；本轮失败 | 400，然后一次重试 → 压缩成功；回忆正确。之后的主请求仍以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出（#15486，main 上同样存在） |
| zh56（对照）：会话约占窗口 56% 时 `/compress` | 压缩成功 | 逐字节相同的请求；压缩成功 |
| win32k：配置窗口 32K，服务端 262K | 以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出："the compression summary was empty"，下一轮被拦下 | 发送前缩减（5,980 个输入 token，`max_tokens` 20,000）→ 压缩成功；回忆正确 |
| win4k：配置窗口 4K | 以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出："the compression summary was empty" | 不发送任何请求："too large for the context window" |
| win1m：配置窗口 1M，服务端 262K | 400；会话无法继续 | 400，然后一次重试 → 压缩成功；回忆正确 |

新逻辑有 50 个新单元测试。它们使用一个强制窗口（测试设置时还强制输入上限）、并可按高于本地估算计数的 mock 后端，也覆盖了 CLI 的状态文案。对新逻辑做了 26 个变异的变异测试，全部被测试发现：准入缩减、本地拒绝、四分之一窗口下限、拒绝信息给出的窗口、未标类型的上限、窗口不超过配置值、数字低于估算时放大删减量、只降输出的重发、两项数字合理性检查、没有分项的总数整体采用且不减去发送的预算、平均密度定预算、第二次被拒的状态、"必须更小"的检查、两处 token 计数标志、未闭合 snapshot 检查、它要求的撑满窗口、所需的 provider 报告的输出数及所用的窗口、输入上限一项、重试的下限、本该放得下时的兜底，以及把过长提醒像普通文字一样截断或整段替换、而不是截短后重新闭合。

构建、类型检查、lint 和格式检查都通过。core 的 services、utils 套件和 CLI 的 i18n、OpenTUI、消息与 UI 工具套件共运行 14,089 个测试：14,056 个通过，33 个跳过，没有失败。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

CLI 在本地构建，用隔离的 HOME 从 dist 输出运行，通过一个记录日志的代理连接 OpenRouter 的 `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`，并固定使用其 262,144 token 窗口的服务端点。修改前是本分支所基于的 main 提交的构建产物。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：
  - 缩减后的请求像工具输出一样把用户消息截到 4,000 字、只保留开头，摘要可能看不到长请求的结尾。只有以前完全无法压缩的会话才会走到这一步。#14953 会完整保留它们。
  - 缩减只截短超过 4,000 字的片段。由许多较短消息组成的会话不会变小，会以新状态被拒绝，而不是完成压缩；在这个改动之前，它会以 API 错误失败。
  - 中文会话经过缩减压缩后，报告的压缩后 token 数偏高。偏差方向是安全的，只会让下一次压缩来得更早。
  - 窗口小于 16K 时，缩减后的请求只给摘要留窗口的四分之一，较长的摘要可能放不下，此时按截断丢弃，历史保持不变。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - vLLM 的 "`max_tokens` cannot be greater than" 拒绝不被视为上下文超长，因为识别它也会改变主对话路径。
  - 超长时从最前面丢消息而不是拒绝的服务（Ollama 的默认行为）不会给出可供重试的拒绝。
  - 没有在 Windows 和 Linux 上本地测试。
  - 共享缓存的压缩请求不在范围内；它失败后会回退到这里修改的冷路径。
  - 切换到更小窗口前先用旧模型压缩，不在范围内。
  - 第二次被拒后放弃，只有单元测试覆盖。
  - 服务端在比请求所按窗口更小的窗口处停止输出，或传输层把输出上限压到预算以下时，在 snapshot 中间被截断的摘要仍可能被保留，和今天一样。
  - E2E 中发现的两个问题在 main 上同样存在，已单独提交：#15486（自动压缩后，下一个请求把待处理的工具结果算了两次，可能以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出）和 #15487（压缩后恢复最近的文件，可能让小窗口再次超长）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。压缩状态枚举末尾新增一个值，现有的值不变。它和其他失败一样计入熔断次数，所以按状态分支的代码会多看到一个新值。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/9455-compression-retry/docs/design/2026-10-19-compression-request-admission.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/9455-compression-retry/docs/design/2026-10-19-compression-request-admission.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Part of #9455

相关：
- #14953：后一半，在缩减后的请求里完整保留用户消息。
- #9541 和 #13072：之前的两次尝试。
- #7960：这个 PR 所基于的输出预算夹紧。
- #14098 和 #14099：它们让被动压缩能识别 vLLM 和 SGLang 的超长错误，与这个 PR 互补。

</details>

prs.title: feat(hooks): add FileChanged notifications for local sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `FileChanged` hooks for local, non-managed sessions. Hooks can observe literal filenames in the working directory or register absolute files and recursive directories through successful synchronous `SessionStart` and `FileChanged` output. Notifications carry the listening session, configured absolute path and `add`, `change` or `unlink`, including changes made by external processes.

Registrations follow session ownership, working-directory changes and hook reloads. Initially missing paths and deleted/recreated roots can recover. Explicit symbolic-link files and directory roots observe their targets while preserving the configured alias in notifications; recursive discovery keeps implicit symbolic links, `.git` and `node_modules` subtrees excluded unless explicitly registered.

CI compatibility repairs retain the complete gates while using fresh verification directories and runner-local Java dependency caches. Hosted workflow fault checks distinguish live consumption from a delivery-classification snapshot, and the digest-tamper probe updates its exact resource row by primary key. Attestation-loss injection covers both attempts of the existing bounded read-only EOF retry while preserving recovery-blocking assertions. RocketMQ downloads have bounded connection/transfer/retry windows. The hard-pinned 5.5.1 release first uses a public Apache mirror and falls back to the two official Apache sources; its independent SHA-512 check remains mandatory before extraction. Other versions retain the official-source checksum chain. Cold-resume TUI verification waits for the original assistant reply, then checks the typed user text in the same frame within the existing deadline. The branch also contains the upstream CI history and hosted macOS Intel startup-budget fixes. The self-hosted browser gate prepares missing DejaVu font data in the runner user's font directory, then rechecks that user. Preparation uses private APT lists and package extraction at the runner's existing privilege level; it never elevates or executes the PR-provided host installer.

Commit `be264d0c9f9f9662702f7c7a1a7c4d2a84311441` fixes a CI test that assumed an ordering Git does not guarantee. The preceding Linux run recorded 117,400 passes, one order-only failure and 152 skips: both expected worktree-prune entries were present, but reversed in all three attempts. The assertion now requires exactly the same two complete records without ordering. Production behavior, the 20-second deadline and test selection are unchanged. The original file passes 48/48; a controlled reversal of real Git announcement lines also passes the original case, and ten missing/extra/duplicate/wrong-object controls are rejected.

Commit `1a8b2591` integrates upstream main `4dd7ac7` and resolves the overlapping prune-test repair using the upstream order-normalized, exact two-record assertion. Commit `16a439b6` corrects cache-repair eligibility: only default `_tool` cache candidates invoke the unchanged canonical-path and symlink safeguards. Other configured cache roots retain their provisioned permissions and continue through the original Java installation and tests. No new privileges, test selectors, coverage guards or deadlines were introduced. Commit `16ef4bb269` qualifies the Managed database template in two unit-test fixtures. This preserves their original binding on the branch and selects the same named private template after newer main is integrated; SQL, transaction fields, assertions and test selection are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Memory and other integrations need notifications from editors, shells and external writers, including files outside the working directory. This supplies a general filesystem event while leaving initial reconciliation and durable synchronization to the integration.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Register initially missing literal filenames, then create, atomically replace and delete them. Expect file notifications while unrelated siblings stay silent.
- Register an external directory, add nested files, delete and recreate the root, then write again. Notifications should continue; replacing or clearing dynamic registrations should retain static registrations.
- Register a symbolic-link file or directory, modify its target through the real path, and confirm the hook receives the configured alias. Multiple aliases should each notify. Refresh registration after retargeting a link; implicit child links should remain silent.
- Change the working directory or rotate the session and reload hooks. Only the current owning session should notify; temporary ACP/MCP configurations and managed, remote or sandbox sessions should remain disarmed.
- On a runner with font drift, expect DejaVu font data to be prepared under that runner's XDG/HOME directory, followed by the unchanged font check. Package or remaining-font failures must stop the gate; healthy runners make no preparation requests and PR-provided scripts never gain new privileges.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before the explicit-link repair, real CLI probes on the earlier source received zero notifications for static file links, dynamic file links and dynamic directory links, while the regular-file control notified. The d38 bundle passed all three configured aliases plus the control, preserving exact paths and session identity. Directory recreation produced `change → unlink → add → change`; both probes exited naturally with code 0 and empty stderr. These are historical source-scoped probes. The later main integration changes production Java, schema, SQL and other upstream inputs, so earlier SDK results are not current-tree runtime-equivalence evidence.

The resolved main-integration tree passed a complete build and typecheck, 1,714 core regressions, 912 ACP regressions, 50 Web Shell regressions and the complete 48-case prune file, all without test skips. Twelve strict assertion controls accept both valid report orders and reject missing, duplicate, extra or misattributed records. The subsequent two-file cache fix leaves the entire application package tree, dependency lock and manifests unchanged. Its workflow-contract checks pass 121/121, original cache-safety checks 8/8 and routing checks 92/92. The test engineer also verified 45 cache contexts and nine controlled flows without executing Java or modifying shared directories. Both source audits were clean; normal commit hooks preserved the verified trees.

Local workflow-reader runs retain their failures: the integration run recorded 1,235 passes, 23 failures and 25 conditional skips; the cache-fix reader run recorded 645 passes, 22 failures and 15 conditional skips. The 22 repeated failures reproduce with identical diagnostics on untouched main4dd under macOS Bash 3.2. The other original 90-second autofix timeout has no proven cause; isolated main/candidate controls passed without extending the deadline. The actual [1a8b Linux test job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664712936/job/122736421859) passed 117,940 test executions with zero failures and 152 existing skips, including the complete 150-case failure-reporter file, 339-case autofix file and original timed-out case. Initial local coverage-directory and linter-PATH failures remain recorded; serialization and the correct tool paths subsequently passed. Workflow-size validation also passed with the actual script under isolated Linux Bash 5, and the CI budget check passed.

### Current verification

Verification snapshot: 2026-10-29 09:16 Asia/Shanghai.

Current head is `16ef4bb269b146069d844d6df86cd6bd1cc45957`. The [Managed Agent fast gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250613), TUI, Landlock and reference-distribution workflows have succeeded. [Main CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250502) has also succeeded: required Lint & Static passed all 731 helper checks, Linux passed 117,940 test executions with 152 existing skips, no-AK integration passed 369/369, and browser smoke passed 403/403 plus six transcript cases. Its actual font probe selected DejaVu Sans on the healthy path; this run did not exercise cold font preparation. Serve A/B attempt1 hit the original 60-minute limit during official Node22.23.4 acquisition after a socket hang-up and stalled retry; both product builds/captures and the diff were unexecuted. Its complete failure logs remain preserved. The one same-source job rerun has now succeeded in all 16 workflow steps, including both original build/capture arms, the diff and artifact upload, with unchanged tests and deadlines. It used cached Node22.23.2-x64 under the original22.x setting; this cache-hit result does not verify the failed cold22.23.4-arm64 transfer. Visuals has also succeeded: head/base checks passed85/81, the render outcome and uploaded render-status both report success, and all118 screenshot pairs have zero pixel differences. Zero composed changes therefore produced no published PNG previews. Two raw videos were uploaded; optional GIF conversion was skipped because the host lacked ffmpeg. All eight product workflows have now succeeded. The new Live Host run actually checked out b616 on macOS26.6.2 ARM64 with Node22.23.3:374/374 tests passed without skips, followed by a successful build, ARM64 package, explicit ad-hoc signing and strict verification. These checks do not represent identity signing or notarization. The new-head automatic CR has now completed successfully and published a partial COMMENT review; formal approval remains separate from these completed product checks.

The preceding [Managed fast gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40669147407) recorded two SQL type errors after newer main made the Managed JDBC template private: two unit fixtures selected the unqualified host template. Commit `16ef4bb269` changes only those two field qualifiers and imports. The new fast job actually checked out `b61688f5` (main `11ef1988` + `16ef4bb2`) and recorded 5,834 Managed tests: 5,815 passed, 19 existing skips, and zero failures/errors. The two changed fixture classes executed all 57 integration and nine creation-skills cases with zero skips/errors, preserving the original SQL and transaction assertions. SDK tests recorded 421 total with nine existing skips; Java 11 daemon checks passed 4/4. Actual SDK, Managed and Broker Checkstyle goals reported zero violations. Fast runs test/package rather than verify, so it does not itself certify SpotBugs. Successful fast runs do not upload Surefire XML/TXT under the existing failure-only upload policy; the acceptance evidence is the complete raw console and exact-source class roster.

The [complete SDK run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40669464577) has succeeded in all13 original lanes at immutable source `16a439b6`; all13 terminal consoles confirm that checkout. MariaDB10.11.18 and MySQL8.4.6 each completed all1,192 integration cases with zero skips/failures/errors, matching each66-class source roster and all four reclamation cuts and two reuse-concurrency methods. Hosted recorded165 total:161 passed and four conditional skips; fault45/45, admission2/2 and O4 recovery59/59 passed without skips. Both original PROVISIONER/SERVICE fault contexts and their blocking, lease and relaunch assertions remain intact. The single-broker7, multi-node10 and all20 CLI/database failover commands also passed. macOS recorded SDK412 passes/9 skips and Runtime Broker1,245 passes/13 skips, including the ownership-revision case.

Commit16ef changes only two unit-fixture injection fields/imports; production, dependencies, schemas, integration-profile tests and workflow inputs remain identical to16a. The13-lane result supplies qualified evidence for those unchanged inputs; it did not execute16ef's changed fixtures, whose acceptance is separately established by the newer b616 fast run. It also does not certify the whole later b616 integration, which contains144 additional paths, including74 Managed Java production paths. The approval-triggered full gate remains the maintainer acceptance stage for that integration. Test trees, Git stamps and compiled outputs are not claimed byte-identical.

The four current Hosted skips remain explicit: three public-workspace cases require macOS, and one method containing12 media scenarios needs the manual bundle-ready property. The SDK macOS lane does not execute that separate Hosted profile. Successful SQL and fault/admission XML are not uploaded by the existing policies; source-scoped proof uses complete console summaries, exact class/selector checks and the Hosted/O4 XML artifacts that were actually uploaded. Original failed/cancelled attempts and acquisition failures remain preserved.

Real HZ jobs now skip only optional permission repair, complete Java installation and execute verification; HK jobs still execute the unchanged local-cache safeguards. The preceding [1a8b SDK run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664899184) failed four jobs before Java setup because a configured shared cache was mistaken for a repairable local cache. Once the corrected 13-lane replacement was accepted, its remaining obsolete work was stopped; completed results and all four failure logs remain preserved. Stopped or unexecuted work is not counted as passing. Upstream now runs installed npm acceptance on schedule or manual dispatch, so the PR's skipped installation jobs are not new 9/9 or 96/96 results.

The [round-17 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969#pullrequestreview-5688241194) reviewed the current16ef head, rechecked historical blockers and published no new inline blocker. It explicitly disclosed partial-review gaps and was COMMENTED, not APPROVED;14 nonblocking Suggestions are recorded as deferred in the review body. The [automatic CR workflow](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250268) succeeded. A separate check of the artifact-only, low-confidence R17-9 reproduced the missing-helper exit127 on an older source tree, but found no existing sdk-java tags or Java SDK release runs on October29; no currently blocked resumed release was established. This conditional old-ref compatibility risk remains recorded for follow-up. Current checks have no failures or pending jobs. The branch has no merge conflict; the two required formal approvals remain outstanding.

### Historical evidence and boundaries

The [be264 main CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40579375100) and its other seven product workflows succeeded, including 117,401 Linux passes with 152 existing skips, 372 browser plus six transcript cases, TUI installation 96/96 and Live Host 374/374. Those results belong to be264 or their recorded integration checkout37daa, not the latest head. The [d38 full SDK recovery](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40526188684/attempts/3) succeeded in all 13 lanes. It retains four pre-existing Hosted conditional skips: one method containing 12 provider-media scenarios needs the manual bundle-ready property, and three public-workspace checks require macOS; admission checks do not replace those scenarios. New Java/schema inputs invalidate reuse of that old run as full acceptance of the merged tree.

The R15 font repair retains all 20 regressions, four independent controls and two real Ubuntu UID1000 cold-font controls, with unchanged system fonts/configuration and no Chromium-metric claim for those containers. The actual font-repair shell remains unchanged through both new commits. Earlier local application and metadata failures remain recorded separately, including core 2,493/one failure, CLI 3,651/two failures and the 269-pass/43-failure Node metadata baseline. No local control erases those wider failures. Java, Maven and SQL verification stays in CI because the original shared local budget is exhausted.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Complete SDK lane succeeded at16a for unchanged runtime inputs; new Live Host374/374 plus ARM64 packaging and ad-hoc verification succeeded atb616 |
| Windows | Unchanged-input SDK lane succeeded at16a; current Landlock boundary6/6 passed, while the main Windows suite remains an original policy skip |
| Linux | Current16ef Main/fast and other completed products pass; full SDK succeeded at16a for unchanged runtime inputs |

## Risk & Scope

- Filesystem notifications are best effort; integrations remain responsible for initial scans, reconciliation and self-trigger loops. Retargeted links require a registration refresh.
- Managed/remote filesystem producers, memory enable/disable events and durable synchronization remain outside this change.
- Design and user contracts are synchronized in [English](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/codex/file-changed-hook/docs/design/file-changed-hooks.md) and [Chinese](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/codex/file-changed-hook/docs/design/file-changed-hooks.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #12558. Supersedes #12561; its separate memory-toggle requirement remains follow-up work.

## 改动

为本地非托管会话添加 `FileChanged` hook。Hook 可观察工作目录中的字面文件名，也可通过执行成功的同步 `SessionStart` 和 `FileChanged` 输出注册绝对文件或递归目录。通知携带监听会话、配置中的绝对路径及 `add`、`change` 或 `unlink`，覆盖外部进程的写入。

注册跟随会话归属、工作目录变化和 hook 重载；初始缺失路径和删除后重建的根可以恢复。显式符号链接文件和目录根观察其目标，通知保留配置中的别名；递归发现仍排除未显式注册的符号链接、`.git` 和 `node_modules` 子树。

CI 兼容修复保留完整门禁，并使用新的验证目录和 runner 本地 Java 依赖缓存。Hosted workflow 故障检查分别验证实时消费与投递分类快照，digest 篡改探针按资源主键更新精确一行。Attestation 丢失注入覆盖既有有界只读 EOF 重试的两次尝试，同时保留恢复阻断断言。RocketMQ 下载有连接、传输和重试时限。已固定摘要的 5.5.1 优先使用公共 Apache 镜像，并回退到原两个 Apache 官方来源；解包前仍必须通过独立固定 SHA-512 校验，其他版本保留官方来源的摘要链。冷恢复 TUI 验证在原时限内等待原助手回答，再检查同一帧中的用户原文。分支也已同步上游 CI 历史处理和托管 macOS Intel 启动预算修复。 自托管浏览器检查现在会在 runner 用户自己的字体目录准备缺失的 DejaVu 字体数据，并以同一用户重新校验。准备过程使用私有 APT 索引和软件包解包，保持 runner 原有权限，不提权，也不执行 PR 中的宿主安装脚本。

提交 `be264d0c9f9f9662702f7c7a1a7c4d2a84311441` 修复一条假定 Git 返回固定顺序的 CI 测试。此前 Linux 记录为 117400 项通过、一项仅顺序不同的失败及 152 项跳过；三次尝试均完整返回原两条 worktree-prune 记录，但顺序相反。新断言仍严格要求相同的两条完整记录和精确总数，仅不约束顺序；生产行为、20 秒时限和测试选择均未变。原文件 48/48 通过，真实 Git 公告行的受控反序也通过原用例，十项缺失、额外、重复或错误对象负控均被拒绝。

提交 `1a8b2591` 同步上游 main `4dd7ac7`，用上游排序后精确匹配原两条记录的等价断言解决测试修复重叠。提交 `16a439b6` 修正缓存权限修复的适用范围：只有默认 `_tool` 候选目录进入原有规范路径和符号链接检查；其他配置缓存保留部署时的权限，继续原 Java 安装与测试。未新增权限，也未改变测试选择、覆盖守卫或时限。

提交 `16ef4bb269` 为两个单元测试 fixture 明确限定 Managed 数据库模板：当前分支保持原绑定，集成新版 main 后选择同名私有模板。SQL、事务字段、断言和测试筛选均未改变。

## 原因

Memory 等集成需要观察编辑器、shell 和外部进程的写入，包括工作目录之外的文件。本改动提供通用文件系统事件，初始对账和持久同步仍由集成负责。

## 评审验证

- 注册初始缺失的字面文件名，再创建、原子替换和删除；应收到文件通知，无关兄弟路径保持静默。
- 注册外部目录，新增嵌套文件，删除并重建根后再次写入；通知应持续。替换或清空动态注册时保留静态注册。
- 注册符号链接文件或目录，通过真实路径修改目标；hook 应收到配置的别名。多个别名各自通知，链接改指后刷新注册；隐式子链接保持静默。
- 改变工作目录，或轮换会话后重载 hook；只有当前归属会话收到通知，ACP/MCP 临时配置及托管、远程、沙箱会话保持禁用。
- runner 字体漂移时，应在其 XDG/HOME 目录准备 DejaVu 字体数据，再执行原字体校验；包获取或字体仍异常时必须停止门禁。健康 runner 不发起准备请求，PR 脚本不获得新增权限。

## 修前与修后证据

显式链接修复前，真实 CLI 对静态文件链接、动态文件链接和动态目录链接均收到零条通知，普通文件对照正常。d38 的 bundle 通过了三种配置别名和普通文件对照，精确路径及会话身份保留；目录重建完整收到 `change → unlink → add → change`，两条探针自然退出 0、stderr 为空。这些是对应历史源码的探针。后来的 main 同步改变了 Java 生产代码、schema、SQL 等上游输入，因此旧 SDK 结果不能作为当前整棵树运行逻辑等价的证据。

解决冲突后的合并树通过完整构建、类型检查、1714 项核心回归、912 项 ACP 回归、50 项 Web Shell 回归和原完整 48 项 prune 测试，测试均零跳过。12 项严格断言对照接受两种合法顺序，拒绝缺失、重复、额外或错误归属记录。之后的两文件缓存修复未改变应用 packages 树、依赖锁或 manifests；工作流契约测试 121/121、原缓存安全测试 8/8、路由检查 92/92 均通过。测试工程师另验证了 45 个缓存上下文和 9 个受控流程，未运行 Java，也未改变共享目录；两轮源码审查干净，正常提交钩子保留了所验证代码树。

本地工作流元测试失败继续保留：合并验证为 1235 项通过、23 项失败、25 项条件跳过；缓存修复验证为 645 项通过、22 项失败、15 项条件跳过。重复的 22 项在未修改的 main4dd、macOS Bash3.2 上以完全相同诊断复现。另一项原 90 秒 autofix 超时原因仍未查明，main/候选单独对照通过，未延长时限。真实 [1a8b Linux 测试任务](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664712936/job/122736421859) 已通过 117940 次执行、零失败，保留 152 项既有跳过；包含完整 150 项失败报告器、339 项 autofix 和原先超时的用例。本地最初的覆盖率目录冲突和 linter PATH 错误记录也保留，串行运行和正确工具路径随后通过。原工作流大小脚本在隔离 Linux Bash5 环境通过，CI 预算检查也通过。

## 当前验证

验证快照：2026-10-29 09:16 北京时间。

当前提交为 `16ef4bb269b146069d844d6df86cd6bd1cc45957`。[Managed Agent fast门禁](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250613)、TUI、Landlock和参考分发工作流均已成功。[主CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250502)也已整轮成功：必需Lint & Static的731项辅助检查通过，Linux117940次执行通过并保留152项既有跳过，无AK集成369/369通过，浏览器smoke403/403和transcript6项通过。实际字体探针在健康路径选中DejaVu Sans，本轮未执行缺字体准备分支。Serve A/B的attempt1在官方Node22.23.4获取出现socket hang-up、重试停留后，达到原60分钟上限；两臂产品构建、采集和diff均未执行，完整失败日志保留。仅对原任务进行的一次同源码重跑现已完成全部16个工作流步骤，两臂原构建/采集、diff和artifact上传均成功，测试和时限不变。它在原22.x设置下命中Node22.23.2-x64缓存，此缓存命中结果不能证明首轮失败的22.23.4-arm64冷获取路径成功。Visuals也已成功：head/base检查85/81全部通过，实际render outcome和上传的render-status均为success，118对截图逐一零像素差异；因此compose零变动，没有发布PNG预览。两条原始视频已上传，主机缺少ffmpeg导致可选GIF转换跳过。全部八条产品工作流现均成功。新Live Host实际检出b616，macOS26.6.2 ARM64、Node22.23.3环境的374/374测试零跳过通过，后续构建、ARM64打包、显式ad-hoc签名和strict verify也成功；这些检查不代表身份签名或公证。新提交自动CR现已整轮成功，发布了披露审查缺口的COMMENT评审；正式批准与已完成的产品检查分别记录。

prs.title: fix(core): end post-compact history on a model turn after /compress
prs.body:
## What this PR does

After compression, restored files, images and session reminders are folded into the summary's user turn, followed by a model acknowledgement. When an automatic compression preserves a trailing tool call, its id and plain narration stay together after the acknowledgement text; thought parts are excluded. The degraded restoration fallback keeps the same shape, and saved sessions from older builds remain recognizable.

The usage-reported token count includes the restored content. It also adds back a preserved trailing turn when a pending tool result meant that turn was included in the summarization input and subtracted from the original count. Without a pending result, that cost already remains in the original count and must not be added twice. The restoration estimate now measures `extraHistory[0].parts[1..]` instead of `extraHistory.slice(2)` and is gated on the pending result; switching to `estimateContentTokens` is arithmetically the same as before. The usage-missing path is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Manual `/compress` strips the trailing model function call before composing, so whenever there was anything to restore the snapshot ended `[user(summary), model(ack), user(attachments)]`. The interruption detector treats that trailing user entry as an interrupted prompt, so the idle session showed the "previous request was interrupted" banner after every `/compress`, and "Continue execution" re-sent the attachment tail as a new prompt. The same snapshot is installed as live history and recorded as the `chat_compression` record, so both the live and the resume classification paths were affected. This follows the approach doudouOUC recommended in the issue: fold the attachments into the summary entry so the tail is a model entry, which also avoids two consecutive user entries.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- After a manual compression with restorable files or images, the resulting live history and the history rebuilt from a saved session should both end on a model turn and should not show an interrupted-request state. With plan mode enabled, the compressed prefix should still occupy two turns.
- Automatic compression should preserve a trailing tool call's id, narration and part order. With a pending result, its cost should be added back after the summarization input is subtracted. Without a pending result, it should be counted once. The two cases use a 40 KB call payload and a real restorable workspace file.
- Restoration costs should trigger the inflation guard when they push the new count past the original. On a restoration failure, a plain-text-only model tail should leave only the fixed acknowledgement, while plan-mode and subagent reminders remain present.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change, so no screenshots. The earlier revision reported the following four mutation checks; this follow-up independently checked the new accounting and fallback cases described below.

- With `postCompactAttachments.ts` reverted to `main` (c24e99e9cb), the classification tests get `interrupted_prompt` instead of `none`, and the composed-shape test gets 3 entries instead of 2.
- With the restoration estimate put back to `extraHistory.slice(2)`, both new token-accounting tests fail (the inflated case comes back `COMPRESSED`).
- With the trailing turn reduced to its `functionCall` parts only, the two trailing-text tests fail.
- With the ack built as `[...trailing parts, ack]`, the positional ack test and the `getStartupContextLength` test fail.
- The previous revision reported 399 focused and 833 adjacent tests passing on Linux; those Linux runs were not repeated for this follow-up.
- Follow-up on Windows/Node 24.14.0: 400 passed and 1 failed across the five focused suites; the service plus two adjacent suites had 994 passed, 2 skipped and 1 failed. Both failures are existing `symlinkSync` fixtures receiving EPERM; both also failed in a targeted rerun with the original reviewed service source/tests restored. The affected service suite passes all 164 tests. These broad runs are not fully green.
- The new pending/no-pending cases fail under the original accounting and unconditional-addition mutations respectively. An exact fallback ack assertion also fails when the function-call guard is removed. An independent run of these three cases passed.

- The full build, bundle, repository `lint:ci` and repository `typecheck` passed on Windows. The exact `npm run preflight` then failed its workspace test stage: the CLI had 40,537 passed / 401 failed / 1,237 skipped; core had 36,233 passed / 266 failed / 655 skipped and one unhandled error. The compression service suite passed all 164 tests within that full core run. There are many symlink EPERM errors and other assertion/setup failures; only the two focused EPERM fixtures above were baseline-reproduced, and the remaining failures have not been baseline-verified. The downstream script tests and serve-bundle gate were not reached by the preflight chain. This is not a fully green preflight.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ Previous revision unit tests only   |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node 24.14.0, pnpm 11.24.0, CI=true. No live model or manual CLI/Web Shell session was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: When a trailing function call is preserved, the ack entry now also carries that turn's plain text parts (thought parts are dropped). With a pending tool result the summary already saw that turn, so its text can appear in both the summary and the ack; this is a small duplication rather than a loss. Without a pending tool result (auto compaction after a restored `ask_user_question` or an aborted call), the side-query excludes that turn; in the original implementation without attachments, and in the earlier revision of this PR in all cases, its text ended up in neither the summary nor the composed history.
- Token accounting now also counts the plan-mode reminder and subagent snapshot parts in the summary entry, including on the degraded fallback path, so `newTokenCount` can be slightly higher than before for those sessions.
- Not validated / out of scope: No manual run in the CLI or Web Shell; macOS not run; Windows validation has the focused EPERM limitations and the broader unresolved workspace failures described above. The classifier and recovery code are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Sessions recorded by older builds still carry the `[user(summary), model(ack), user(attachments), model(fc)?]` prefix, and rewind's compressed-prefix detection still recognizes it.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14325

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

压缩后，恢复的文件、图片和会话提醒合入摘要所在的 user 轮次，再接 model 确认轮次。自动压缩保留末尾工具调用时，调用 id 和普通文本依原顺序放在确认文本之后，不保留 thought 内容；恢复组装失败时也使用同样的结构，旧版本保存的会话仍能识别。

usage 计费路径补计恢复内容。有 pending 工具结果时，末尾轮次进入摘要输入并从原计数扣除，因此需要补回；无 pending 时其费用已经留在原计数中，不能重复增加。恢复估算现在度量 `extraHistory[0].parts[1..]`（不再是 `extraHistory.slice(2)`），并受 pending 条件控制；改用 `estimateContentTokens` 在算术上与原来一致。缺失 usage 时的路径未改动。

## 为什么需要

手动 `/compress` 在组合前会去掉末尾的 model 函数调用，所以只要有可恢复内容，快照就是 `[user(摘要), model(ack), user(附件)]`。`detectTurnInterruption` 把末尾的 user 条目判为 `interrupted_prompt`，于是每次 `/compress` 后空闲会话都会显示“上一个请求被中断”横幅，点“继续执行”会把附件尾部当新提示重发。同一份快照既装入实时历史，也记录为 `chat_compression` 记录，所以实时和恢复两条判定路径都受影响。本修法采用 doudouOUC 在 issue 中推荐的方案：把附件并入摘要条目，让结尾是 model 条目，同时避免两个连续的 user 条目。

## 审阅测试计划

### 如何验证

- 手动压缩包含可恢复文件或图片的会话后，实时历史和从保存记录恢复的历史均应以 model 轮次结尾，不显示请求中断状态；plan 模式下压缩前缀仍为两轮。
- 自动压缩保留末尾工具调用的 id、普通文本和 part 顺序。有 pending 结果时，摘要输入被减去后应补回该轮次费用；无 pending 时只计一次。两条路径使用约40 KB调用参数和真实工作区文件。
- 恢复内容导致总量超过原计数时应触发膨胀保护。恢复组装失败时，普通文本尾轮次不应复制进 ack；plan 模式和子代理提醒仍应保留。

### 证据（修改前后）

非 UI 改动，无截图。以下前四项变异结果为上一修订报告；本次独立核验了新增的计费和降级用例。

- 把 `postCompactAttachments.ts` 还原为 `main`（c24e99e9cb）：判定测试得到 `interrupted_prompt` 而不是 `none`，组合结构测试得到 3 条而不是 2 条。
- 把恢复估算改回 `extraHistory.slice(2)`：两个新的 token 计算测试失败（膨胀用例变回 `COMPRESSED`）。
- 末尾轮次只保留 `functionCall` 部分：两个末尾文字测试失败。
- ack 构造成 `[...末尾部分, ack]`：ack 位置测试和 `getStartupContextLength` 测试失败。
- 上一修订报告 Linux 上 399 个目标测试和 833 个相邻测试通过；本次跟进未重跑 Linux。
- 本次 Windows/Node 24.14.0：五个目标套件为 400 通过、1 失败；service 加两个相邻套件为 994 通过、2 跳过、1 失败。两个失败都是已有 symlinkSync fixture 遇到 EPERM；临时恢复被审原始 service 源码和测试后，定向复跑也出现相同错误。受影响的 service 套件 164 个测试全部通过，不将广泛测试称为全绿。
- 新增有/无 pending 用例分别击败原计费和无条件相加的变异；降级 ack 精确断言击败移除 functionCall 守卫的变异。这三个用例也经独立运行通过。

- Windows 上完整 build、bundle、全仓 lint:ci 和全仓 typecheck 通过。原始 npm run preflight 随后在工作区测试阶段失败：CLI 为 40,537 通过 / 401 失败 / 1,237 跳过；core 为 36,233 通过 / 266 失败 / 655 跳过，另有一个未处理错误。压缩服务套件在这次完整 core 运行中 164 个全部通过。广泛失败含多处 symlink EPERM 及其他断言/准备错误；只有前述两处目标 EPERM fixture 做过原始源码基线复现，其余失败尚未逐项核验基线。preflight 链未进入后续脚本测试和 serve-bundle 检查，不将完整 preflight 称为通过。

### 测试环境

上一修订仅报告 Linux 单元测试。本次在 Windows 上运行了单元测试，存在上述两个符号链接权限限制；macOS 未运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：保留末尾函数调用时，ack 条目现在还带上该轮次的普通文本部分（thought 部分丢弃）。有待回工具结果时摘要已经看过该轮次，所以文字可能同时出现在摘要和 ack 中，这是少量重复而不是丢失。没有待回工具结果时（例如恢复的 `ask_user_question` 或被中止的调用之后发生自动压缩），side-query 不包含该轮次；在原实现无附件时、以及本 PR 之前的版本在所有情况下，它的文字既不在摘要里也不在组合历史里。
- token 计算现在也会计入摘要条目中的 plan 模式提醒和子代理快照部分（包括降级兜底路径），因此这类会话的 `newTokenCount` 可能比之前略高。
- 未验证/范围外：未在 CLI 或 Web Shell 中手动运行；macOS 未运行；Windows 验证存在上述目标 EPERM 限制及广泛工作区测试失败。判定器和恢复代码未改动。
- 破坏性变更：无。旧版本记录的会话仍带 `[user(摘要), model(ack), user(附件), model(fc)?]` 前缀，rewind 的压缩前缀检测仍能识别。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14325

</details>

Not run locally: preflight, cli package tests, integration/e2e, and a real-model /compress; 16 core failures also fail on plain main in my environment.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): fall back to English copy when the UI language has no relay dictionary
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In the Web Shell, the "Use this computer" entry (Computer Use, desktop relay) keeps its own copy dictionary with English and Chinese strings and looks it up by the current UI language. The lookup had no fallback: for a locale the shell does not ship a dictionary for, `COPY[language]` is `undefined` and the first string access throws, taking the whole Web Shell down with "Something went wrong" at page load. This change gives that lookup the same dictionary-level fallback the rest of the codebase already uses (`StandaloneAuth` and the root error fallback both resolve `COPY[language] ?? COPY.en`): an unknown locale now renders the English copy instead of crashing. The shipped `en` and `zh-CN` dictionaries are untouched. A regression test renders the control with a locale that has no relay dictionary and asserts the trigger and panel render with the English fallback.

## Why it's needed

Issue #15445: the Web Shell fails to load in browsers whose UI locale resolves to a language the shell does not ship. The i18n provider's `language` is typed to the shipped languages, but the value is not checked at runtime — any host build or distribution that extends the locale set (for example a downstream build that adds a Russian locale) passes that value straight through to every component. The desktop relay control is new in 0.26.0 and is the only component whose own copy dictionary lacks the fallback, so it is the first thing to crash and it crashes the entire render tree, not just one widget. I hit this on a Russian-locale browser (Yandex Browser) against 0.26.0: the page showed "Something went wrong" with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'desktopRelay.trigger')` in the console.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level: the new case `falls back to English when the UI language has no relay dictionary` in `packages/web-shell/client/components/DesktopRelayPanel.test.tsx` renders `DesktopRelayControl` inside the real `I18nProvider` with a language the shell does not ship (`ru`) and asserts the trigger button renders with `aria-label`/`title` = "Use this computer" and the opened panel shows the English status copy ("Relay not detected").

- Before the fix, the same test fails with the exact error from #15445: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'desktopRelay.trigger')`.
- Run it: `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/DesktopRelayPanel.test.tsx` — full file passes on this branch, including the pre-existing zh-CN language case.
- The shipped locales are unchanged: the pre-existing `uses the current Web Shell language` case (zh-CN dictionary) still passes, and the full web-shell client suite (see machine evidence below) is green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (0.26.0, issue #15445): a Russian-locale browser loads the Web Shell into the root error screen — "Something went wrong" — with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'desktopRelay.trigger')` in the console (screenshot attached to the issue). The same failure is reproduced by the new unit test on this branch's base commit (machine evidence below).

After (this branch): the control renders with the English copy for the unshipped locale — the trigger's accessible name and tooltip are "Use this computer", the panel shows the English status/hint strings, and nothing else on the page is affected (unit test, machine evidence below). No screenshot is attached: the locale that triggers the crash is only produced by a downstream locale build and cannot be selected from the upstream UI, so the unit test is the deterministic repro.

Machine evidence (head `7232f855e0`, 2026-10-24):

- 🍏 macOS — Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64) on the macOS host (host node v26.5.0 cannot run vitest-jsdom), fresh container, branch-tree copy, `pnpm install` + workspace builds: `client/components/DesktopRelayPanel.test.tsx` 22/22 — on the base commit the single new case fails with the #15445 error, `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'desktopRelay.trigger')`; full web-shell client suite — 492 files / 13237 tests, 13234 passed, 3 failed, all outside this diff (`file-name-display` fails identically on the base commit — an `@pierre/trees` container artifact; `browser-turn-notifications` and `vite-config` pass on isolated re-runs with this branch's change — full-suite load flakes); `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` — one pre-existing error identical on the base commit (`WorkspaceFileBrowser.tsx` TS2353, the same artifact), the changed files are type-clean; `eslint` on the changed files — 0 errors; `prettier --check` on the changed files — clean.
- 🐧 Linux — the same fresh-container run on the macOS host, same numbers as the macOS row.
- 🪟 Windows — ⏳ pending: the UTM Win11 ARM VM was powered off at publication time; `client/components/DesktopRelayPanel.test.tsx` plus `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` will be run there with `--pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork` and this row updated with the results.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⏳ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment

macOS: Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64) on the macOS host (host node v26.5.0 cannot run vitest-jsdom — `window.localStorage` undefined in jsdom, established environment limitation); fresh container, branch-tree copy, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + workspace builds. Linux: same fresh-container run on the macOS host. Windows (pending): UTM Win11 ARM VM (WinOnArm x64 emulation) was powered off at publication time; the affected test file plus `tsc --noEmit` will be run there with `--pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork` and this row updated with the results.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none expected — the fallback only changes behavior for locales that previously crashed the shell; for `en` and `zh-CN` both dictionaries exist, so the `??` never fires and rendered copy is byte-identical.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live browser repro with a downstream Russian locale (that locale is not reachable from upstream UI settings — `languageSettingToWebShellLanguage` resolves only to `en`/`zh-CN` — so the unit test, which injects the locale into the provider, is the repro); the Windows machine run is pending (see Tested on). Other components with self-contained dictionaries already use the same fallback and are untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No API, config, or data changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15445

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 中，「使用这台电脑」入口（Computer Use，桌面中继）自带一份只含英文和中文文案的字典，并按当前 UI 语言查表。此查表没有回退：对于 shell 未提供字典的语言，`COPY[language]` 为 `undefined`，第一次取字符串就会抛异常，导致整个 Web Shell 在页面加载时以「Something went wrong」崩溃。本变更为该查表加上代码库其他部分已在使用的同一层字典级回退（`StandaloneAuth` 与根错误回退组件都使用 `COPY[language] ?? COPY.en`）：未知语言现在渲染英文文案，而不是让页面崩溃。已发布的 `en` 与 `zh-CN` 字典未做任何改动。回归测试以一个没有中继字典的语言渲染该控件，并断言触发按钮与面板以英文回退文案渲染。

## 为什么需要

Issue #15445：当浏览器 UI 语言解析为 shell 未提供的语言时，Web Shell 无法加载。i18n provider 的 `language` 在类型上限定为已发布的语言，但运行时并不校验该值——任何扩展了语言集的主机构建或发行版本（例如添加俄语语言的下游构建）都会把这个值原样传给每个组件。桌面中继控件是 0.26.0 新增的，也是唯一一份自身文案字典缺少回退的组件，因此它第一个崩溃，并且崩掉的是整个渲染树，而不只是一个小组件。我在俄语浏览器（Yandex Browser）上对 0.26.0 复现了该问题：页面显示「Something went wrong」，控制台报 `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'desktopRelay.trigger')`。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

单元级：`packages/web-shell/client/components/DesktopRelayPanel.test.tsx` 中的新用例 `falls back to English when the UI language has no relay dictionary` 在真实 `I18nProvider` 内以 shell 未提供的语言（`ru`）渲染 `DesktopRelayControl`，并断言触发按钮以 `aria-label`/`title` = "Use this computer" 渲染、打开的面板显示英文状态文案（"Relay not detected"）。

- 在修复前，同一测试以 #15445 中完全相同的错误失败：`TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'desktopRelay.trigger')`。
- 运行方式：`pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/DesktopRelayPanel.test.tsx`——本分支上整个文件通过，包括既有的 zh-CN 语言用例。
- 已发布语言不受影响：既有的 `uses the current Web Shell language` 用例（zh-CN 字典）仍然通过，完整 web-shell client 套件为绿色（见下方机器证据）。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前（0.26.0，issue #15445）：俄语浏览器把 Web Shell 加载到根错误界面——「Something went wrong」——控制台报 `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'desktopRelay.trigger')`（截图已附在 issue 中）。同一失败可由新单元测试在本分支的基线提交上复现（见下方机器证据）。

之后（本分支）：对于未提供的语言，控件以英文文案渲染——触发按钮的可访问名称与提示为 "Use this computer"，面板显示英文状态/提示文案，页面上其他部分不受影响（单元测试，见下方机器证据）。未附截图：触发崩溃的语言只能由下游语言构建产生，无法在上游 UI 中选中，因此单元测试就是确定性复现手段。

机器证据（head `7232f855e0`，2026-10-24）：

- 🍏 macOS — macOS 宿主机上的 Docker `node:22-bookworm`（aarch64）（宿主机 node v26.5.0 无法运行 vitest-jsdom）：全新容器、分支树拷贝、`pnpm install` + 各工作区构建：`client/components/DesktopRelayPanel.test.tsx` 22/22——在基线提交上，唯一的新用例以 #15445 的错误失败，`TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'desktopRelay.trigger')`；完整 web-shell client 套件——492 个文件 / 13237 个测试，13234 通过、3 失败，全部不在此 diff 之内（`file-name-display` 在基线提交上以相同方式失败——`@pierre/trees` 容器环境差异；`browser-turn-notifications` 与 `vite-config` 在带本分支改动的隔离重跑中通过——完整套件负载下的偶发失败）；`tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`——一条与基线提交完全一致的既有错误（`WorkspaceFileBrowser.tsx` TS2353，同一差异），改动文件类型干净；改动文件 `eslint`——0 错误；改动文件 `prettier --check`——干净。
- 🐧 Linux — macOS 宿主机上同一全新容器运行，数字与 macOS 行相同。
- 🪟 Windows — ⏳ 待补：发布时 UTM Win11 ARM 虚拟机处于关机状态；将在其上以 `--pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork` 运行 `client/components/DesktopRelayPanel.test.tsx` 加 `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`，届时更新本行与上表。

### 测试平台

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⏳ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### 环境（可选）

macOS：macOS 宿主机上的 Docker `node:22-bookworm`（aarch64）（宿主机 node v26.5.0 无法运行 vitest-jsdom——jsdom 中 `window.localStorage` 为 undefined，系已知环境限制）；全新容器、分支树拷贝、`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + 各工作区构建。Linux：macOS 宿主机上同一全新容器运行。Windows（待补）：发布时 UTM Win11 ARM 虚拟机处于关机状态；将在其上以 `--pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork` 运行受影响的测试文件加 `tsc --noEmit`，届时更新本行与上表。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：预计无——回退只改变此前会让 shell 崩溃的语言的行为；对 `en` 与 `zh-CN` 两份字典都存在，`??` 永远不会触发，渲染文案逐字节一致。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：未做带下游俄语语言的实机浏览器复现（该语言无法从上上游 UI 设置到达——`languageSettingToWebShellLanguage` 只能解析为 `en`/`zh-CN`——因此向 provider 注入语言的单元测试即为复现手段）；Windows 机器跑批待补（见「测试平台」）。其他自带字典的组件已使用同一回退，未做改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。无 API、配置或数据变更。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15445

</details>
